story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nicer watching it with you, though
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लेकिन, तुम्हारे साथ इसे देखना और भी अच्छा था

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even with my commentary?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरी टिप्पणी के साथ भी?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Future You हमेशा शिकायत करने के लिए कुछ न कुछ ढूंढ लेती है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: खासकर तुम्हारी टिप्पणी के साथ ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यह याद आ रहा है, बस तुम्हारे साथ कुछ बेवकूफी की बातें करना

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हमें इसे फिर से करना चाहिए, लेकिन तुम अगली फिल्म चुनो

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम मेरी वजह से अपनी जासूसी करियर खत्म होने का दोष नहीं दे सकती

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं बिना हार के रिटायर हो रही हूँ, धन्यवाद 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not what happened
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ऐसा नहीं हुआ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the story I'm sticking to
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इसी कहानी पर कायम रहूँगी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं सोने जा रही हूँ इससे पहले कि तुम मुझे कोई बेहतर फिल्म देखने के लिए मना लो

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छी नींद लो

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सिर्फ तब जब Present Me अपने बर्तन धोना छोड़ देती है 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम भी, सुंदर ❤️ मुझे खुशी है कि आज तुम्हारे पैर के लिए थोड़ा आसान था

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमसे प्यार है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमसे भी प्यार है ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How much have you created so far?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अब तक तुमने कितना बनाया है?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक कढ़ाई, एक कटोरा, एक चम्मच

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और एक दूसरी चम्मच क्योंकि मैंने पहली को कहीं बेवकूफी से रख दिया

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Impressive efficiency

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तुम मेरी masterpiece देखोगी तो तुम कम हंसोगी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: देखो, असली खाना है और आग का कोई निशान नहीं है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो अच्छा लग रहा है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Attempting doesn't sound promising
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कोशिश करना इतना promising नहीं लगता

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये भी अच्छा लगता है, मैं लगभग शक कर रही हूँ 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: दूसरी चम्मच ने क्या योगदान दिया?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Moral support
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moral support

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अगली बार जब मैं खाना बना रही हूँ, ये याद रखूँगी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने आज रात ठीक से खाया?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मैंने खा लिया है और मैं सोफे पर बैठी हूँ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा ❤️ मैं बाकी चीज़ें रखकर तुम्हें catch up करूँगी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अब meal prep कर रही हो? तुम सच में बदल गई हो

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसकी आदत मत डालो, मैं ये सिर्फ इसलिए कर रही हूँ क्योंकि मैं कल बाहर जा रही हूँ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ओह, मैं तुम्हें इसके बारे में बताना चाहती थी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने लगभग खाली कढ़ाई चढ़ा दी और पास्ता अलमारी में छोड़ दिया

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उस सहकर्मी के साथ जिसे तुमने पिछले रात बताया था?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
My manager, actually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरे मैनेजर, असल में

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा मैनेजर?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, हमने आज फिर से इसके बारे में बात की

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने पहले सहकर्मी कहा था

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने किया

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे ये स्पष्ट करना चाहिए था कि मैं किसके बारे में बात कर रही थी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या कोई और जा रहा है?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, just us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं, बस हम ही हैं।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So we're having a strong start 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो हमारी शुरुआत मज़बूत है 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सही।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's just a drink after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये तो बस काम के बाद एक ड्रिंक है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Where?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कहाँ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ऑफिस से कुछ गली दूर एक बार है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगभग सात बजे, तो मैं सीधे काम से जाऊँगी।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम जाना चाहते हो?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मैं जाना चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने इस हफ्ते ज्यादातर समय क्लास से काम और फिर घर जाने में बिताया।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कुछ ऐसा करना चाहती हूँ जो इन तीन चीजों में से न हो।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं समझती हूँ कि बाहर जाना क्यों चाहती हो।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe start with the water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शायद पानी से शुरू करो

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अपने मैनेजर के साथ अकेले बाहर जाना मेरे ख्याल से थोड़ा अलग है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है कि ये कैसे लगता है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: खासकर जब तुमने कहा कि वो तुम्हें अलग तरीके से देखता है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शायद मुझे उस पर इतना ध्यान नहीं देना चाहिए था।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने मुझे बताया क्योंकि ये तुम्हें परेशान कर रहा था।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It surprised me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये मुझे हैरान कर गया।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लेकिन मुझे उसके आसपास असहज महसूस नहीं होता।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या उसे पता है कि तुम किसी के साथ हो?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he knows
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, उसे पता है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want to turn this into an argument
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं चाहती कि ये बहस में बदल जाए।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have water, I'm not completely lost
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरे पास पानी है, मैं पूरी तरह से खोई नहीं हूँ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me neither
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी नहीं।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं सिर्फ ये नहीं जानना चाहती कि मैंने सिर्फ आधी कहानी सुनी है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसलिए मैं तुम्हें बता रही हूँ कि हम कहाँ जा रहे हैं और किसके साथ।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें बताऊँगी जब मैं वहाँ पहुँचूँगी।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And when you're home?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और जब तुम घर पहुँचोगी?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do want to spend time with you too, you know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी तुम्हारे साथ समय बिताना चाहती हूँ, जानती हो।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's for dinner?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: डिनर में क्या है?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है। मैं तुम्हें देखने की याद करती हूँ, सिर्फ संदेशों का इंतज़ार करने के बजाय।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे भी तुम्हारी याद आती है ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे देखना है कि अगले कुछ दिनों में मैं कब खत्म करती हूँ और हम कुछ तय कर लेंगे।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे ये पसंद है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और मैं नहीं चाहती कि हमारी पूरी शाम गायब हो जाए जब मैं एक पैन के पास खड़ी हूँ।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं बदलने जा रही हूँ और आरामदायक हो जाऊँगी, फिर मैं इस भयानक फिल्म के लिए तुम्हारी हूँ।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get it ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इसे तैयार कर दूँगी।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ी देर बाद...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, मैंने बचा हुआ खाना रख दिया है और बदल लिया है।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पास्ता, टमाटर की चटनी और जो भी चीज़ हफ्ते में बची है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कोई काम के कपड़े नहीं, मेरे सामने कोई बर्तन नहीं, कोई नंबर नहीं।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you find the first spoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने पहली चम्मच ढूंढ ली?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was in the bowl the entire time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो पूरी समय कटोरे में थी।

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course it was
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल ऐसा ही था

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें उस जानकारी पर भरोसा कर रही हूँ, थोड़ा दयालु बनो 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने तो सोफे का अच्छा हिस्सा भी ले लिया है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where I'd want to be right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अभी वहीं होना चाहती हूँ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There'd be room for you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे लिए जगह होगी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने उस कंबल के साथ सोफे का आधा हिस्सा ले लिया है

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A classic
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक classic

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कंबल बाँट लूँगी, लेकिन अच्छे तकिए को नहीं 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A generous offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक उदार प्रस्ताव

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'd take it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम इसे ले लोगी

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I would
Soon ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जल्द ही ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you at the beginning of the film?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम फिल्म के शुरुआत में हो?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Paused at the first frame
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पहले फ्रेम पर रुकी हुई

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, three, two, one... play
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, तीन, दो, एक... चलाओ

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the film...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिल्म के बाद...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So, about the man with the red scarf
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो, लाल स्कार्फ वाले आदमी के बारे में

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कल के लिए भी काफी बना रही हूँ, ताकि Future Me शिकायत न कर सके

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: पर्याप्त HAK अंक जमा हो गए हैं

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: यह उन लोगों की निगरानी करके अन्य जगहों पर हो रही बातचीत को कैप्चर करता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm still stressed enough without your commentary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मैं तुम्हारी टिप्पणियों के बिना भी काफी तनाव में हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yesterday you were sending me certain pictures
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: कल तुम मुझे कुछ तस्वीरें भेज रही थी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And today you're waiting for grades like a responsible student
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: और आज तुम जिम्मेदार छात्र की तरह ग्रेड्स का इंतज़ार कर रही हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll text you when I get the results
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: जब मुझे रिजल्ट मिलेंगे, मैं तुम्हें टेक्स्ट करूंगी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I should get my grades today
Having a private tutor who knows people has its advantages 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: एक प्राइवेट ट्यूटर होना जो लोगों को जानता है, इसके फायदे हैं 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But not as much as before

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हे 😊 बिना कास्ट के पहली सुबह, कैसा लग रहा है?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I walked straight into it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और मैं सीधे उसमें चला गया

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for making this possible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: इसको संभव बनाने के लिए धन्यवाद

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कोई बात नहीं, दुर्भाग्यवश 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But seriously, are you comfortable?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लेकिन सच में, क्या तुम आरामदायक हो?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ज्यादातर। जब मैं उठता हूँ तो अभी भी कड़ा लगता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सड़क पर दौड़ने के लिए बिल्कुल तैयार नहीं हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अच्छा, क्योंकि मैं तुम्हें नहीं दौड़ाने वाला था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not even a little?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: थोड़ा भी नहीं?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हारे पीछे बहुत निराश चेहरे के साथ चलूँगा

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: रुको, ये वो चेहरा है जो तुम्हें मिलेगा

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Strange actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वास्तव में अजीब

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Terrifying
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: डरावना

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It works on you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये तुम्हारे लिए काम करता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It really does
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये सच में बुरा लगता है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं बस खुश हूँ कि ये आखिरकार हट गया ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जब मैंने कल तुम्हारा संदेश देखा, तो मैं तुम्हारे पास आकर तुम्हें गले लगाना चाहता था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That offer still available?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या वो ऑफर अभी भी उपलब्ध है?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: स्पष्ट रूप से

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे भी तुम्हारे साथ एक दोपहर चाहिए, जहाँ हम में से कोई भी आधा समय तुम्हारे पैर के बारे में नहीं पूछे।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जब मैं ठीक महसूस करूँगी, हम कहीं एक छोटा कैफे ढूंढ सकते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं जागा और कंबल को ऐसे हिलाया जैसे मुझे अभी भी इसके लिए जगह बनानी हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे ये पसंद है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे तुम्हारे सामने बैठकर तुम्हारी प्लेट से कुछ चुराना याद आता है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सुंदर। यही तो तुम्हें मुझसे याद आता है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Among other things
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अन्य चीजों के अलावा।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लेकिन ज्यादातर तुम्हारी ये बुरी आदत कि तुम हमेशा मेरी तुलना में कुछ बेहतर ऑर्डर करते हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always say you're not hungry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम हमेशा कहते हो कि तुम भूखे नहीं हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not hungry until your food arrives
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं तब तक भूखी नहीं होती जब तक तुम्हारा खाना नहीं आता।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Completely different situation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल अलग स्थिति है 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: खाने की बात कर रहे हैं, क्या तुमने नाश्ता किया?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कॉफी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You got attached to it 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम इससे जुड़ गई हो 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a drink
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये तो एक पेय है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look who's suddenly responsible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: देखो, कौन अचानक जिम्मेदार हो गया।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I learned from a very strict woman
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने एक बहुत सख्त महिला से सीखा।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वह बहुत प्यारी लगती है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Annoying. Very pretty though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: परेशान करने वाली। लेकिन बहुत खूबसूरत।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That saved you ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसने तुम्हें बचा लिया ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: रुको, मैं साबित करूँगी कि मैं खा रही हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 मिनट बाद

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: टोस्ट, कॉफी, और एक महिला जो निश्चित रूप से लेट होने वाली है अगर वह तुम्हें टेक्स्ट करती रही।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हमने एक साथ बहुत समय बिताया

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम बहुत खूबसूरत लग रही हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हें टोस्ट पर ध्यान देना चाहिए था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने दोनों पर ध्यान दिया

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll allow it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं इसे मंजूर कर लूंगी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes all day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सारा दिन क्लासेस?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: आज सुबह, फिर लंच के बाद अपने ग्रुप के साथ कुछ काम

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हमने कल बीस मिनट बिताए यह तय करने में कि किसे वह दस्तावेज़ भेजना था जो सबके पास पहले से था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उम्मीद भरा शुरुआत

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल। मैं स्नैक्स लाने वाली हूँ और अपनी उम्मीदें कम कर रही हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लगता है तुम ही एकमात्र तैयार हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Should I be jealous?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या मुझे जलन होनी चाहिए?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Emotionally, absolutely not
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: भावनात्मक रूप से, बिलकुल नहीं

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और मैंने वो नहीं भुलाया जो हमने कल रात बात की थी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं पहले कदम के बारे में सही से सोचना चाहती हूँ, न कि जब मैं अपनी दूसरी जूती ढूंढने की कोशिश कर रही हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं जूती के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करना नहीं चाहूंगी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वह फिलहाल जीत रही है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 मिनट बाद

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मिल गई। दोनों जूते पहन लिए हैं, अब मेरे पास कोई बहाना नहीं है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जाने से पहले एक आखिरी तस्वीर, क्योंकि तुम यहाँ मुझे व्यक्तिगत रूप से ध्यान भंग करने के लिए नहीं हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम मुझे जाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना बहुत मुश्किल बना रही हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह एक बहुत सहायक रिश्ता था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हें मुझे शुभकामनाएँ देनी चाहिए, न कि मुझे तुम्हारी याद दिलानी चाहिए

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं दोनों कर सकती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you can ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है कि तुम कर सकते हो ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जब तुम्हारे पास थोड़ा समय हो, मुझे टेक्स्ट करना

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और उस गले लगाने के लिए अपने शेड्यूल में थोड़ा जगह रखना

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं सोफे के साथ अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट कैंसल कर दूंगा

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell it I'm sorry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसे बताना कि मुझे खेद है 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh my god
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हे भगवान

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने वो कल से बचाकर रखा था, है ना?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जब से डॉक्टर ने इसे हटाया है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मेरी छोटी छात्रा ने सच में पढ़ाई की

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तुम्हें रास्ते में कुछ बहुत दिलचस्प इनाम भी मिले

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैंने सबसे महत्वपूर्ण परीक्षा पास कर ली

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तो तकनीकी रूप से मुझे अब इतनी मेहनत से पढ़ाई करने की जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: फिर भी तुम्हें बाकी परीक्षाएँ पास करनी चाहिए ताकि सुरक्षित रहो। एथन को थोड़ा और रखना एक जीत-जीत है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तुमने काफी मेहनत की है। शायद अब कुछ समय के लिए किताबों के अलावा कुछ करना चाहिए।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: क्या यह सच में परीक्षाओं के बारे में है...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: या क्या तुम चाहती हो कि मैं एथन से मिलती रहूँ? 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just thinking about your diploma
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं बस तुम्हारे डिप्लोमा के बारे में सोच रही हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं कभी-कभी अच्छी इंसान बन सकती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: लेकिन जब मैं होती हूँ, तो मैं सही होती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं एथन को अगले एग्जाम के लिए रखूंगी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You are the one who will be happy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तू ही वो है जो खुश होगा
क्या किताबों के अलावा कुछ और?
{{name:aiden}} ने फिर से ट्रेनिंग सेशंस शुरू कर दिए हैं
तू भी हमारे साथ जुड़ सकता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तू हफ्तों से पढ़ाई में फंसा हुआ है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: थोड़ा हिलना-डुलना तुझे मार नहीं डालेगा

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: खासकर अगर तू गर्मियों के लिए अपनी बॉडी को फिट रखना चाहता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: सावधान रह, मैं छोटी हो सकती हूं लेकिन मैं तेरा बैंड बजा सकती हूं 😌
तू सच में गलत नहीं है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मुझे सच में फिर से हिलने की जरूरत महसूस हो रही है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हे, मुझे आखिरकार खाने का समय मिल गया है बिना किसी के हमारे ग्रुप प्रोजेक्ट के बारे में पूछे 😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: इसमें निश्चित रूप से अधिक जानकारी उपलब्ध थी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कठोर

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सटीक 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लेकिन इसने मुझे कुछ समझने में मदद की

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं पहले किसी से सामान्य रूप से बात करना चाहती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं किसी को सिर्फ इसलिए नहीं चुनना चाहती क्योंकि हम कुछ नया करने के लिए उत्साहित हैं

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं नहीं चाहती कि तुम भी ऐसा करो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: और मैं चाहती हूँ कि उसे पता चले कि मैं एक रिश्ते में हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं नहीं चाहती कि बातचीत के बीच में आकर ऐसा लगे कि मैंने महत्वपूर्ण बात छिपा ली है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सहमत

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे नहीं पता कि इसे कैसे लिखूं बिना यह लगे कि मेरा प्रोफ़ाइल बहुत गंभीर घोषणा की तरह है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: नमस्ते से शुरू करो। शायद अपने बॉयफ्रेंड का औपचारिक परिचय छोड़ दो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हारा मतलब है कि तुमने एक भी तैयार नहीं किया?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं संदर्भ शामिल कर सकती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल नहीं 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लेकिन मैं चाहती हूँ कि तुम जो मैं लिखूं वो पढ़ो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: किसी को मेरे लिए चुनने के लिए नहीं। बस क्योंकि यह नया है और मैं इसे करते समय अकेला नहीं महसूस करना चाहती

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: और जब मैंने कहा कि कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसे हम नहीं जानते, शायद आसान हो, तो मेरा मतलब यह नहीं था कि तुम्हें पहले व्यक्ति पर भरोसा करना है जो जवाब दे

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुमने कहीं धूप में जगह ढूंढ ली

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हमारे दोस्तों के बीच कम अजीब होना यह नहीं है कि मैं उसके साथ सहज महसूस करूंगी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो आज रात मैं कुछ लिखूंगी और एक सामान्य फोटो चुनूंगी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कल मैं तय कर सकती हूँ कि क्या मैं इसे डालने और बातचीत शुरू करने के लिए खुश हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह सच में एक योजना की तरह लगता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: थोड़ी नर्वस योजना, लेकिन हाँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह मंजूर है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तुम्हें खराब प्रोफाइल के बारे में शिकायत करने का अधिकार भी रखती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उस हिस्से में कभी संदेह नहीं था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अच्छा है, क्योंकि मैं अभी भी खाना ऑर्डर करने से पहले फोन कॉल्स की प्रैक्टिस करती हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं यह जरूर करना चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं चाहती हूँ कि पहला कदम ऐसा लगे जैसे मैंने इसे चुना है, न कि ऐसा लगे कि मैं जल्दी में थी क्योंकि हमारी अच्छी बातचीत हुई थी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: शानदार कंपनी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो हम वहीं से शुरू करते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे वापस जाना है। उन्होंने स्लाइड्स पर चर्चा करने का एक और कारण ढूंढ लिया है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मजबूत रहना।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं अपना बाकी का लंच अपने साथ ले जा रही हूँ। यही एक चीज़ है जिस पर मुझे अभी भरोसा है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम अगली बार आमंत्रित हो। बशर्ते तुम अपने खुद के फ्राई लाओ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुख्य रूप से इस बारे में कि मैं पहले क्या करने में वास्तव में सहज महसूस करूंगी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुम कहीं पहुंची?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। बस वहाँ बैठकर यह सोचने से थोड़ा आगे बढ़ी कि तुम क्या चाहोगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुम भाग गए?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हारा {{name:aiden}} का जिक्र करने से बहुत साधारण चीजें कम साधारण लगने लगी हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कौन सी चीजें?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसने पूछा कि क्या मेरे पास हमारी आखिरी क्लास के नोट्स हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: आमतौर पर मैं बस उन्हें भेज देती।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: आज मैंने उस संदेश को बेवकूफी से काफी देर तक देखा, फिर याद आया कि वह सच में क्लास के नोट्स मांग रहा था।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कृपया मुझे बताओ कि तुमने उसे कोई रहस्यमय जवाब नहीं भेजा।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: नहीं 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अस्थायी रूप से

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसे नोट्स मिल गए। बहुत रोमांचक विकास।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: धीरे चलो, तुम खुद से आगे बढ़ रही हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: चुप रहो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लेकिन यही तो बात है। वह पहले से ही मेरी सामान्य जिंदगी का हिस्सा है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अगर हम इसके बारे में बात करते हैं और बाद में अजीब लगता है, तो भी मैं उसे कैंपस में देखूंगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। मैंने अगले सामान्य लंच के बारे में सच में नहीं सोचा था।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने सोचा है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे नहीं लगता कि इसका मतलब है कि हमें उससे बात नहीं करनी चाहिए।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं बस यह नहीं चाहती कि इसे ऐसे समझा जाए जैसे हम उसे हमारे साथ खेल में शामिल होने के लिए कह रहे हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं समझता हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने कहा कि मुझे लंच चाहिए और किसी ने पूछा कि क्या हम स्लाइड्स पर चर्चा कर सकते हैं जब मैं खा रहा था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम इसे कैसे उठाना चाहोगी?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अकेले, शुरुआत के लिए।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं थोड़ा अजीब बातचीत करना पसंद करूंगी बजाय इसके कि मैं कुछ व्यक्तिगत समझाने की कोशिश करूं जबकि मेरे दोस्त सुन रहे हों।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: और शायद ऐसी सलाह देना जो किसी ने नहीं मांगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सही है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: रुको

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वह आ रहा है। जब मुझे थोड़ा समय मिलेगा, मैं तुम्हें मैसेज करूंगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक पल बाद

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या यहाँ कोई बैठा है?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: इस पर निर्भर करता है। क्या तुम यहाँ मेरा लंच चुराने आई हो?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुमने उन पर स्लाइड्स फेंकी?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक अप्रत्याशित सीट

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं नोट्स के बारे में पूछने वाला था, लेकिन अब जब तुमने लंच का जिक्र किया है...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हारे पास नोट्स हैं। यही तुम्हारा आज का तोहफा है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हमेशा की तरह उदार।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम ठीक हो? तुम पहले बहुत दूर लग रहे थे।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। बस कुछ सोच रहा था।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या ऐसा कुछ है जिसमें मैं मदद कर सकता हूँ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: शायद। मैं इसे तब बात करना चाहूंगा जब यहाँ शांति हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बातचीत जारी है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ध्यान दूसरे बोलने वाले की ओर है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने इस पर विचार किया

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कहने के लिए कुछ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ओह। ठीक है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तब तक परेशान नहीं था जब तक तुमने ये नहीं कहा

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वाह, अब मैंने इसे नाटकीय बना दिया

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब तुम तैयार हो, तब मुझे बता देना। मैं बस धन्यवाद कहने आई थी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: नोट्स के लिए?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे ये स्वीकार करने से बचाने के लिए कि मैंने इनमें से कुछ भी नहीं लिखा था

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वो रहा। मैं सोच रही थी कि तुम इतने अच्छे क्यों हो रहे हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं बिना कुछ चाहें भी अच्छी हो सकती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लेकिन मैंने बाहर एक टेबल ढूंढ ली, इसलिए मैं व्यक्तिगत विकास चुन रही हूं

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सच में, हाँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो मैं फोटो रख लेती हूँ 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं वही इस्तेमाल करूँगी और कल फिर से परिचय पढ़ूँगी, इससे पहले कि मैं कुछ डालूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर मैं देख सकूँगी कि क्या कोई है जिससे मैं सच में बात करना चाहती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम पर किसी से बात करने का कोई कर्ज नहीं है बस इसलिए कि उन्होंने तुम्हें मैसेज किया

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है। मैं जिज्ञासु हूँ, पूरे इंटरनेट से आवेदन नहीं ले रही

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अब ये एक अच्छा प्रोफ़ाइल टाइटल है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम अब और मदद नहीं कर रहे हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम अगली बार कुछ ले आना।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कल के लिए नर्वस हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लेकिन मुझे ये पसंद है कि ये एक छोटी सी चीज़ है जो मैं सच में करना चाहती हूँ, न कि कोई बड़ा कदम जिसके लिए मैं तैयार होने की कोशिश कर रही हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम मुझे बता सकती हो अगर ये तुम्हारी उम्मीद से अलग महसूस होता है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आप भी

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं चाहती कि तुम ये दिखाओ कि तुम ठीक हो बस इसलिए कि तुमने इसे उठाया

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं करूंगा

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अब, बहुत महत्वपूर्ण सवाल

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: देखो, तुम मेरी समस्याएँ सुलझा रहे हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं सुन रहा हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब मैं तुम्हें पास्ता लाऊँगी, क्या हम कुछ अच्छा देखेंगे, या तुम मुझे फिर से एक फिल्म देखने पर मजबूर करोगी जिसमें कोई लाइट नहीं जलाता?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये तो माहौल है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये दो घंटे हैं जब मैं पूछ रही हूँ कि दरवाजे पर कौन खड़ा है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम इस बार चुन सकती हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। लेकिन मैं शिकायत करने का अधिकार रखती हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अगर तुम नहीं करती, तो मैं चिंतित होती

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे तुम्हारे साथ वो दोपहर चाहिए, तुम जानती हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर से कोई गंभीर चर्चा करने के लिए नहीं। बस बहुत सारा खाना खाने और तुम्हारे पास बैठने के लिए

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रुको, मुझे आराम से बैठने दो पहले कि तुम मुझे फिर से भटका दो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे वो भी चाहिए

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो मत भूलना। मैं अभी भी सोफे पर अपनी जगह मांग रही हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये तुम्हारा है

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रुको, मैं सोफे से बिस्तर पर जा रही हूँ इससे पहले कि मैं यहाँ सो जाऊँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 मिनट बाद

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वहाँ। मैं तुम्हारे लिए दूसरा तकिया बचा रही हूँ

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम सच में मेरी तुम्हारी याद को और बढ़ा रहे हो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो जब तुम आ सको, आकर इसे ले लो

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं आऊँगी ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 मिनट बाद

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि, सुंदर ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि। मेरे लिए थोड़ा पास्ता बचा लेना

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यहाँ इतना पास्ता है कि ये हम दोनों से ज्यादा समय तक चलेगा। सो जाओ 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हो गया। बाल अभी भी गीले हैं, लेकिन मैं फिर से नहीं हिलने वाली।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम ऐसे लग रहे हो जैसे तुम सोने वाले हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कई बार किचन गई और वापस आई।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं। मैं तो अभी बैठी हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यही तो आमतौर पर शुरू होता है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत मजेदार।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: असल में, कल से पहले मुझे कुछ चेक करना था।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जाओ आगे।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पिछली रात, जब मैंने पूछा था कि अगर मैं किसी और को तस्वीर भेजूं तो तुम क्या जानना चाहोगे।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे तुम्हारा जवाब याद है। मैं बस यह नहीं मानना चाहती कि यह सब कुछ शामिल करता है जो हम कर सकते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह सही है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक अनुभवी यात्री।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने कहा था कि तुम जानना चाहोगे, और तस्वीर भी पाना चाहोगे।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। मुझे यह पसंद है कि मैं उन चीज़ों में शामिल रहूँ जो तुम साझा करने का चुनाव करती हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है। लेकिन अगर मैं किसी से बात कर रही हूँ, तो मैं जरूरी नहीं कि पूरे समय अपने फोन पर देख रही हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुमसे हर पांच मिनट में अपडेट देने के लिए नहीं कह रही हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अगर तुम शेयर करने का फैसला करती हो तो मैं तस्वीर देखना चाहूंगा। बातचीत तो अलग होती है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मैं नहीं चाहता कि तुम किसी मैसेज का इंतज़ार करो और सोचो कि कुछ गलत है क्योंकि मैं टाइप नहीं कर रहा।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तुम फ्री हो, मुझे बताना, फिर हम सच में बात कर सकते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बाहर भी थोड़ा समय बिताया।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यह ज्यादा पसंद है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तस्वीरों के बारे में अभी ज्यादा उत्साहित मत हो। मैंने तो पहली बातचीत भी नहीं की है 😌।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं बहुत धैर्य रख रहा हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम इसका बहुत अच्छा नाटक कर रही हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने कहा था कि तुम जानना चाहोगी, लेकिन जरूरी नहीं कि खुद तस्वीर चाहोगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। यह अभी भी सही है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं यह तुमसे सुनना चाहता हूँ। मुझे तुम्हारे द्वारा दिखाने के लिए चीजें इकट्ठा करने की जरूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह सच में राहत की बात है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर मैंने बैठ गई इससे पहले कि मुझे अपनी महत्वाकांक्षा पर पछतावा होने लगे।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें यह बताना चाहूंगा कि किसी चीज़ का कैसा अनुभव हुआ, बजाय इसके कि मैं इसे साबित करने की चिंता करूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हारा होमवर्क नहीं चेक कर रहा।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मुझे आज इसका काफी हो गया है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और अगर तुम व्यस्त हो, तो हम बाद में बात कर सकते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है। मैं तुम्हें बताऊंगा जब मेरे पास थोड़ा समय होगा, बजाय इसके कि मैं अपने फोन पर दूसरी बातचीत करने की कोशिश करूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वैसे, तुम अभी भी मेरी आम तस्वीरें पाते हो। तुम मेरे चेहरे से इतनी आसानी से नहीं बच सकते 😌।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं ऐसा करने का सोच नहीं रहा था।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह तो वाकई में समझदारी की बात लगती है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने कहा था कि तुम जानना नहीं चाहोगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हारा मतलब था कि तुम हर एक चीज़ के बारे में नहीं जानना चाहती, या जब यह हो रहा है तब अपडेट नहीं चाहिए?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने सच में उन चीज़ों को अपने दिमाग में अलग नहीं किया था।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसलिए मैं पूछ रही हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं समझ सकती हूँ कि सरप्राइज के लिए जगह छोड़ना ठीक है। बस मैं नहीं चाहती कि हम बिना समझे दो अलग-अलग चीज़ें सोचें।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: चलो सीमाओं पर सहमत होते हैं, लेकिन कुछ चीज़ों को सरप्राइज के लिए छोड़ देते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे इसके दौरान कोई अपडेट नहीं चाहिए, फिर बाद में बात करेंगे।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं पहले इस पर सहमत होना चाहूंगी कि हम क्या कोशिश कर रहे हैं, फिर तुम्हें हर छोटी बात बताने के लिए जगह छोड़ दूंगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है। जो हमने सच में बात की है, उसके भीतर एक सरप्राइज, न कि मैं यह अनुमान लगाऊं कि वह जवाब कितना दूर जाता है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम हैरान लग रहे हो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अभी के लिए, हम सिर्फ संपर्क बनाने और यह देखने की बात कर रहे हैं कि क्या पहली डेट सही लगती है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है। मैं इसे इस तरह नहीं ले रही कि हमने पहले से ही सब कुछ तय कर लिया है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और अगर कुछ गलत लगता है, तो मैं तुम्हें बताऊंगी। मैं इसे अपने पास रखकर रहस्य बनाए रखने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल। मेरे लिए भी यही।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है। अब यह मेरे लिए ज्यादा समझ में आता है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे लगता है कि मैं इसे होते हुए नहीं देखना चाहूंगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लेकिन बाद में, मैं जानना चाहूंगी कि यह कैसा रहा और तुम्हें कैसा लगा।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो मैं अपना फोन रख देती हूँ, बातचीत करती हूँ, और जब मैं फ्री होती हूँ, तब हम बात करते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इस पल को खराब नहीं करना चाहती।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। यह उस चीज़ के करीब लगता है जो मैं कहना चाहती थी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है। मैं यह कर सकती हूँ।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और अगर मुझे तुमसे जल्दी बात करने की ज़रूरत पड़ी, तो मैं जरूर करूंगी।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल। जब तुम्हें मेरी ज़रूरत हो, तो तुम्हें किसी योजना पर टिके रहने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि हमने अब इस बारे में बात की।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं बार-बार सोच रही थी कि क्या मुझे तुम्हें कुछ भेजना चाहिए।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं चाहती कि तुम इस बारे में चिंता करो।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आपका बाकी दिन कैसा रहा?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है। अब जब हमने इसे कह दिया है, तो यह आसान है।
