story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो कल तुम क्या करना चाहते हो?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं {{name:aiden}} से पूछूंगी कि क्या हम क्लास के बाद कुछ मिनट बात कर सकते हैं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं यह बताना चाहती हूं कि हम इस बारे में बात कर रहे थे कि मैं किसी और के साथ डेट पर जाने का सोच रही हूं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और वह एक ऐसा व्यक्ति है जिसके साथ मैं यह बातचीत करने पर विचार कर रही हूं।

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हें लगता है कि वह तुम्हारी बात पर विश्वास करेगा?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हमने प्रोजेक्ट का अपना हिस्सा खत्म कर लिया, तो अब मैं आखिरकार इसके बारे में सोचना बंद कर सकती हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: तुम सच में मुझे व्यस्त रखने की कोशिश कर रही हो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: मैंने उम्मीद नहीं की थी कि तुम ऐसा कुछ सुझाओगी पिछले रात के बाद।
हम इसे सरल रख सकते हैं।
लेकिन तुम बैग उठाने वाली हो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: बहुत देर मत लगाना, वरना मैं तुम्हारे बिना शुरू कर दूँगी और सिर्फ जंक फूड खरीद लूँगी।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: मैं पिछले बीस मिनट से एक ही पन्ने को देख रही हूँ।
क्या बाद में कुछ करना चाहोगी?
हम आज रात टाकोस बना सकते हैं।
शॉपिंग + घर का बना टाकोस। तुम तैयार हो?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: क्या तुम मेरे साथ पकाने की पेशकश कर रही हो?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: सुबह ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: She has a permanent invitation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: उसका तो हमेशा का निमंत्रण है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: अच्छा। इसे याद रखना 🤍

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How's your leg after yesterday?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: कल के बाद तेरा पैर कैसा है?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: जब मैं उठा तो थोड़ा अकड़ा हुआ था, लेकिन थोड़ा चलने के बाद बेहतर हो गया

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि हम जब रुके तब रुके

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं भी। मैं आज सुबह आराम से रहूँगा

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तू क्या योजना बना रही है?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: आज सुबह घर के कुछ काम, फिर शायद बाद में कुछ गेम्स

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तेरा क्या?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm spending the afternoon with my family
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं दोपहर अपने परिवार के साथ बिता रहा हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैंने अपने बैग के लिए हाथ बढ़ाया और याद आया कि वो कहाँ था

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: पहले लंच। फिर लगता है हम ताश खेलेंगे

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: लगता है?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मुझे बताया गया था। मेरी भागीदारी वैकल्पिक नहीं थी 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: कोशिश कर कि अपनी इज़्जत के साथ वापस आना

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं ऊँचा लक्ष्य रखूँगा। मैं जीतने जा रहा हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's the spirit
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: यही तो जज़्बा है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: और फिर मैं उन्हें मुझे सराहने की अनुमति दूँगी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बहुत ही दयालु

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बिल्कुल

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay, I need to get ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ठीक है, मुझे तैयार होना है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: It's still beside the sofa
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: वो अभी भी सोफे के पास है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मेरी बैग को सुरक्षित रखना। जब मैं तुमसे मिलूंगी, तब ले लूंगी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बिल्कुल। आज मज़े करो ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too love
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुम भी, प्यार

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: कम से कम हम में से एक को कल रात तेरे घर रुकने का मौका मिला

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तेरा बैग बहुत चुपचाप साथ था

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then don't get too attached to it 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तो फिर इससे ज़्यादा लगाव मत कर 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बहुत देर हो चुकी है। हम पहले ही नाश्ता कर चुके हैं

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मेरे बिना? कितनी बेअदबी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ये है वो शख्स जिसे तुझे बुलाना चाहिए था

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ठीक है, आओ मुझे किचन में मदद करो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to just supervise
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुम्हें सिर्फ पर्यवेक्षण करने की अनुमति नहीं है।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: कुछ समय बाद, किचन में खाना बनाते हुए।
तुम सच में काटने में ठीक हो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मैं अभी भी मसाले डालने वाली हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुम ही सबसे बड़ा गंदगी फैला रहे हो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: और मैंने सिर्फ तीन बेकार चीजें खरीदीं।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: क्या तुमने अभी मेरी फोटो ली?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: While I have sauce on my face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: जब मेरे चेहरे पर सॉस है?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: जब मैं टैको मसाले में लिपटा हूं, तब तुम ऐसा नहीं कह सकते
मैं वो फोटो रख रही हूं
कल के बाद ये हल्का महसूस होता है
तुमने चौथी चीज खरीदने के करीब पहुँच गए थे।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मुझे इस शांतिपूर्ण स्थिति की आदत मत डालो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मैं बस इसलिए शांत हूं क्योंकि टैको लगभग तैयार हैं
खाना सब कुछ ठीक कर देता है
क्या ये अजीब बातचीतों के लिए भी है?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: अब बात करना बंद करो और मेरी मदद करो प्लेटिंग खत्म करने में

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: कुकीज़ मुझ पर अजीब तरीके से देख रही थीं।
ये सच में बहुत अच्छे थे

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मैं 10 तब बचा रही हूं जब हम धुएं का अलार्म नहीं बजाते

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुम्हारा मतलब है जब तुम धुएं का अलार्म नहीं बजाते

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: खैर... मैं थोड़ी सफाई करूँगी और फिर सो जाऊँगी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मैं सबसे अच्छे तरीके से थकी हुई हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It helped more than I expected
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: यह मेरी उम्मीद से ज्यादा मददगार रहा

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मैं शायद हर हफ्ते टाको नाइट्स की मांग करने लगूँगी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: खैर... मैं थोड़ी सफाई करूँगी और फिर सो जाऊँगी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: सबूत है कि मैंने कम से कम एक बैग उठाया।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: अपडेट: लंच शानदार था

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मेरी तरफ से अपनी माँ को नमस्ते कहना

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: She sends you a kiss back 😘
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: वह तुम्हें एक किस भेजती है 😘
मेरी मदद करो
क्या हो रहा है?
मैंने अपने कार्ड्स लगभग खत्म कर लिए हैं

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: लेकिन हर बार जब मैं खुश दिखती हूँ, कोई मुझे और खींचने के लिए कहता है
तो खुश दिखना बंद करो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ऐसे करो जैसे तुम्हारा हाथ खराब है
क्या यही तुम्हारा शानदार सलाह है?
उन्हें तुम्हें कमतर आंकने दो
कार्ड्स तो बर्बाद हैं

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ठीक है। मैं अपनी प्रतिष्ठा तुम्हारे हाथ में छोड़ रही हूँ
कुछ मिनट बाद
मैं फिर से हार गई

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you keep a straight face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: क्या तुमने सीधा चेहरा रखा?
लगभग दस सेकंड के लिए

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: फिर किसी ने पूछा कि मैं ऐसा क्यों दिख रही थी जैसे मैं कोई अपराध छिपा रही हूँ
तो ये धोखा देने की कला पर काम करने की जरूरत है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मुझे लगता है मुझे एक नए सलाहकार की जरूरत है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: कठोर। मैं सीमित जानकारी के साथ काम कर रही थी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: उन्होंने पूछा कि मैं किससे टेक्स्ट कर रही थी
पहले से ही?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: क्या तुमने उन्हें बताया कि तुम विशेषज्ञ सहायता ले रही थी?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैंने कहा कि मेरा बॉयफ्रेंड मुझे हारने में मदद कर रहा है
ये तो चोट करता है
बस इसलिए क्योंकि ये सही है 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: तुम्हें उन्हें तुम्हारी याद करने का मौका देना चाहिए। एक ब्रेक लो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैंने लिया है। मैं एक और टुकड़ा केक ले रही हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: कम से कम मैं मिठाई में जीत रही हूँ
एक मजबूत वापसी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैं आज दोपहर बाद घर आऊँगी
क्या तुम आज रात फ्री हो?
मैं दो बार हार चुकी हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मेरे पास एक आइडिया है। जब मैं घर पहुँचूँगी तो बताऊँगी ❤️
अब मैं उत्सुक हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: अच्छा। पहले मुझे अपना बहुत महत्वपूर्ण केक खत्म करने दो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: जब मैं जीतने वाली होती हूँ, तो सब अचानक बहुत प्रतिस्पर्धी हो जाते हैं
क्या तुम भी?
वो तो अलग है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: जिसे अन्याय किया जा रहा है, उसके चेहरे को देखो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: तुम ऐसा लग रहा है जैसे तुम बदला लेने की योजना बना रही हो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: देर शाम — तुम घर लौट आए हो और तुम्हें अपने लिए थोड़ा सुकून भरा समय मिला है।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: सच में?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: हाँ। मैं तुम्हारे साथ खेलना चाहूँगा

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम हमेशा मज़े करती हुई लगती हो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने सोचा कि मैं तुम्हारे साथ इसे आजमाना चाहूँगी, सिर्फ इसके बारे में सुनने के बजाय

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तो चलो कुछ ढूँढते हैं जो हम दोनों को पसंद आए

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: उस रेसिंग गेम के बारे में क्या जो तुमने बताया था?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: यह ठीक रहेगा। हम एक प्राइवेट रेस कर सकते हैं

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है। लेकिन पहले तुम्हें कंट्रोल समझाने होंगे

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है। जब तुम तैयार हो जाओगी तो मैं तुम्हें एक इनवाइट भेज दूँगी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: थोड़ी देर बाद — तुम दोनों रेसिंग गेम शुरू करते हो। शुरू करने से पहले, तुम कंट्रोल समझाते हो और {{name:lena}} को प्रैक्टिस लैप करने देते हो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं घर आ गई हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तैयार। कृपया मेरी एकाग्रता की सराहना करो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बहुत प्रोफेशनल। प्रैक्टिस लैप कैसा चल रहा है?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने तीन बार उसी दीवार से टकराया है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: कोने से पहले ब्रेक लगाओ, फिर मुड़ो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम दोनों काम एक साथ पूरी स्पीड में करने की कोशिश कर रही हो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे लगा कि स्पीड ही मुख्य बात है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: सड़क पर रहना भी मदद करता है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है। एक और प्रैक्टिस लैप

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: पहली रेस के बाद

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: और मेरे पास एक बहुत गंभीर सवाल है

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम मुझसे बहुत आगे निकल गई 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने इसे बहुत बार खेला है। अपनी पहली रेस की तुलना उससे मत करो

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं भी गलत दिशा में फँस गई थी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: लेकिन तुमने आखिरी कोने को साफ-सुथरा पार किया

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: यही वो दीवार है जिससे तुम प्रैक्टिस में बार-बार टकरा रही थी

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने वो देखा।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: देखा? तुम पहले ही टाइमिंग समझ रहे हो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है। फिर से।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: वही ट्रैक?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: हाँ। मेरे पास इसके साथ अधूरा काम है।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं सुन रही हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: दूसरे रेस के बाद — {{name:lena}} अभी भी तुम्हारे पीछे खत्म होती है, लेकिन कम क्रैश के साथ ट्रैक पूरा करती है।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: फिर भी हार गई।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: लेकिन अपना टाइम चेक करो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम पहले रेस से बहुत तेज़ खत्म हुए।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: और मैं सिर्फ दो बार घूमी।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बिल्कुल। तुमने तेज़ मोड़ों से पहले धीमा होना याद रखा।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं अपने दिमाग में तुम्हारी निर्देशों को दोहरा रही थी।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: वे काम कर गए। वो एक बहुत बेहतर लैप था।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम अच्छे हो क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारी गर्लफ्रेंड हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: अगर तुम बेहतर नहीं हुई होतीं, तो मैं तुम्हें बता देता

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: क्या तुम आज रात मेरे साथ कुछ खेलोगी?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तेज़ लैप इसलिए है क्योंकि तुमने बेहतर ड्राइव किया।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है, ये एक अच्छा जवाब है ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: रुकना है या कोई दूसरा ट्रैक आजमाना है?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: इस पर एक और।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं देखना चाहती हूँ कि क्या मैं बिना क्रैश किए कर सकती हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: एक आखिरी रेस के बाद।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने लगभग कर लिया।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुमने सिर्फ अंत में बैरियर को छुआ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: क्योंकि मैं उत्साहित हो गई और ब्रेक लगाना भूल गई।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हारा पहला आधा बहुत अच्छा था। ऐसा करते रहो और बाकी सब आ जाएगा।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: रुको। तुम मुझसे खेलने के लिए पूछ रही हो?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं किसी और रात रीमैच चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं इससे बहुत खुश होऊँगी।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम अब भी मेरी पूछने पर मुस्कुरा रहे हो, है ना?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे ये तुम्हारे साथ साझा करना पसंद है।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे भी। भले ही तुम पकड़ने में परेशान करने वाले हो।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: अब तुम समझते हो कि मैं हमेशा एक और राउंड क्यों चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: दुर्भाग्यवश, हाँ 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: क्या तुम छोटे थे जब ऐसे गेम खेलते थे?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: हाँ। मैं कंट्रोलर के साथ ऐसे झुकता था जैसे इससे मुझे मोड़ने में मदद मिलेगी।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने आज रात वो किया 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तो तुम्हारे पास बेहतरीन इन्स्टिंक्ट्स हैं।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: लगता है कि कार को छोड़कर सबको समझ में आया कि मैं क्या चाहती थी।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: हम अगली बार कार को शामिल करने पर काम करेंगे।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: आज रात मेरे साथ धैर्य रखने के लिए धन्यवाद।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे बहुत अच्छा लगा। तुम्हें जीतने की ज़रूरत नहीं है, मैं तुम्हारे साथ खेलकर भी मज़ा लेता हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे भी मज़ा आया ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है। कल के लिए तैयार हो रही हूँ, फिर सोने जा रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: शुभ रात्रि, प्यार। मुझे खेलने के लिए बुलाने के लिए धन्यवाद।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: शुभ रात्रि ❤️ हम फिर से करेंगे।

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम इतनी हैरान क्यों हो?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम कभी ऐसा नहीं कहती। आमतौर पर मैं तुम्हें अपने खेलों के बारे में बताती हूँ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: सच में, मुझे खुशी है कि तुमने पूछा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: सुबह

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today I’ve got the whole day free
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: आज मेरा पूरा दिन फ्री है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Miraculously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: चमत्कारिक रूप से।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Want to come shopping with me then?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: क्या मेरे साथ शॉपिंग पर चलोगी?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shopping?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: शॉपिंग?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मुझे नई पैंट चाहिए। डॉक्टर ने दो दिन पहले मेरा प्लास्टर हटा दिया था, तो अब मैं फिर से सही नाप की पैंट पहन सकता हूँ।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: अरे वाह, आखिरकार!

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yes, with pleasure
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: हाँ, खुशी से

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मैंने बिना पढ़ाई की guilt के घर से बाहर जाने का बहाना ढूंढने का इंतज़ार किया है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: जाग गई?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मुझे तीस मिनट दो, ताकि मैं थोड़ी कम बिखरी हुई लगूं।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: अपना समय लो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Don’t start without me 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मेरे बिना मत शुरू करना 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yeah. How are you feeling today?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: हाँ। आज तुम कैसी महसूस कर रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Better than yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: कल से बेहतर।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: अभी भी थोड़ा थकी हुई हूँ लेकिन मेरा दिमाग अब पूरी तरह से गंदा नहीं है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: अच्छा। तुम अपने प्रोफेसर से फिर कब मिल रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: शायद दो में से एक दिन।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: कभी-कभी हर दिन, अगर उसे लगे कि मुझे ज़रूरत है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: वो इस "अतिरिक्त सत्र" वाली बात को बहुत गंभीरता से ले रहा है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: आज भी?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हे ❤️ मैंने तय किया है कि हमने वो फिल्म कभी नहीं देखी और मेरी इज़्ज़त अभी भी बरकरार है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अच्छा, तो यह सिर्फ मेरे साथ नहीं हुआ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा क्या? रात बेहतर थी?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बहुत बेहतर, और मैंने उठकर नाश्ता बनाया पहले कि मैं अपना फोन चेक करूं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने वो चीजें गिराए बिना किया?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक चम्मच, लेकिन मैंने उसे उठा लिया

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हारी बहुत महत्वाकांक्षी सुबह पर गर्व महसूस कर रही हूँ ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने दोनों जूते भी पहन लिए हैं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बैठ रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बैठ रहा हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: देखो, तुम सिखाई जा सकती हो 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हें भी शुभ प्रभात, जासूस

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा नाश्ता कैसा चल रहा है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ठीक है, लेकिन मेरा बैग पैक करना समस्या है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं कल रात का पास्ता ले जा रही हूँ ताकि मुझे एक और सैंडविच से लूट न मिले

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: भविष्य का तुम आखिरकार उस डिनर से कुछ लेकर जा रही हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसे खाना मिला और एक बहुत भरा बैग

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: खाना ऊपर रखो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: फिर मुझे किताब ले जानी होगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: किताब ले जाओ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जब तुम इस ज़िप को बंद करने की कोशिश नहीं कर रहे होते, तो तुम सब कुछ इतना आसान लगाते हो 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम घर पर कुछ छोड़ सकती हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: शुरू मत करो, मैंने तो अभी तक नाश्ता भी नहीं किया 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे सब कुछ चाहिए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या इसमें वो सब भी शामिल है जो तीन हफ्तों से नीचे पड़ा है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम नहीं जानती कि नीचे क्या है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या तुम जानती हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह मुद्दा नहीं है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: रुको, मुझे लगता है कि मैंने समझ लिया है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कृपया सराहो कि मैं अंतिम मिनट से पहले तैयार हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम बहुत अच्छी लग रही हो ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: धन्यवाद खूबसूरत 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या एक लाल स्कार्फ तुम्हें बेहतर महसूस कराएगा?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बैग ऐसा लग रहा है जैसे यह एक लड़ाई हारने वाला है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लड़की की तारीफ करो, सामान की नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लड़की प्यारी है। सामान पर मेरी सहानुभूति है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बहुत बेहतर 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या आज सुबह फिर से क्लास है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हाँ, फिर सीधे काम पर

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं चाहती हूँ कि सब कुछ बिना घड़ी को देखे खत्म हो जाए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक उचित लक्ष्य

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम अपने दिन के साथ क्या कर रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं उस किचन के अलमारी को साफ करने जा रहा हूँ जिसे मैं टाल रहा था

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं अगली बार जब आऊँगी, तुम्हारा रिमोट छिपा दूँगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वो जिसमें चीजें तुम्हारे ऊपर गिरती हैं जब तुम इसे खोलते हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं इसे एक सरप्राइज फीचर की तरह सोचना पसंद करती हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम इसमें कम चीजें भी रख सकते हो 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं अच्छे कॉफी मग के लिए जगह बना रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये ज़रूरी है, मैं नहीं चाहती कि हमारी पहली सही कॉफी एक मापने वाले जग से बने

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने मेरी पूरी प्रेजेंटेशन बर्बाद कर दी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कॉफी के लिए मेहनत बचा लो, मैं मग को ज्यादा नहीं जज करूंगी ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें जल्दी ही बाहर ले जाना चाहूंगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे ये पसंद है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ठीक है, मुझे निकलना होगा वरना जल्दी पहुंचने का मतलब बस छूटना हो जाएगा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये तो एक इकरार की तरह लगता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: शायद मैं इस दोपहर अपने फोन पर ज्यादा नहीं रहूंगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: इतनी मेहनत के बाद अपना लंच मत भूलना

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये पहले से ही मेरी तरफ दबा रहा है, मैं इसे भूल नहीं सकती 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें आज रात बार पहुंचते ही टेक्स्ट करूंगी, जैसे मैंने कहा था

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ठीक है, तुम्हारा दिन शुभ हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम भी खूबसूरत हो ❤️ प्यार करती हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमसे भी प्यार है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये तो एक चेतावनी की तरह लगता है 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने कम से कम अच्छी नींद ली?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हाँ, जब मैंने ये समझना बंद किया कि असली अंत कैसे समझ में आता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह नहीं हुआ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: दूसरा वाला कम दुखद लगता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks for the vote of confidence
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: आपका भरोसा रखने के लिए धन्यवाद
मैं सच बोल रही हूँ, मतलब नहीं।
तू सही है, B बेहतर है
देखो, मेरा स्वाद तो अच्छा है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैंने प्रवेश द्वार के पास कुछ बहुत अच्छा देखा।
{{name:hailey}} फ़िटिंग रूम में गायब हो जाती है।
पहले से ही पुरुषों के सेक्शन में हूँ
ये तुम पर बहुत अच्छा लग रहा है
यह सच में बहुत अच्छा लग रहा है।
मैं एक और कोशिश कर रही हूँ।
मुझे पहला वाला ज्यादा पसंद आया

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं ये वाला तो ले ही रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: हम पहले पे कर सकते हैं और फिर खाना ले सकते हैं।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हे ❤️ हम बार में हैं, और मैंने आखिरकार कहीं बैठ गई हूँ जो ऑफिस की कुर्सी नहीं है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम मेरी सिफारिशों का मजाक उड़ाते रह सकती हो, लेकिन तुम्हें यह पसंद आता है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यहाँ पसंद है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, that wasn't difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: देखो, यह मुश्किल नहीं था।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम इस पर पूरी रात बर्दाश्त नहीं कर पाओगी, है ना?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बस तब तक जब तक तुम यह मानना बंद नहीं कर देती कि मेरे पास अच्छा स्वाद है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें वह नहीं देने वाली।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें करने की जरूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम? जब तुम उस ऑफिस में नहीं होती, तब तुम वास्तव में क्या करती हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बाहर जाओ, कहीं अच्छा खाने के लिए ढूंढो, जब मेरे पास फ्री दिन हो तो कहीं चलो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और जब तुम वहाँ पहुँचोगे तो सबको बताना कि कहाँ बैठना है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा है, अभी ज्यादा भीड़ नहीं है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: किसी को तो उन्हें टॉयलेट के पास की टेबल चुनने से रोकना होगा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम तो इसे नकार भी नहीं रहे हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why would I?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं ऐसा क्यों करूँगी?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे नहीं पता कि यह आत्मविश्वास है या शर्म की पूरी कमी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तुम अपना मन बना लो तो मुझे बता देना

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जैसे ही संगीतकार कमरे के दूसरे छोर पर सेटअप कर रहे हैं...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या वे आज रात यहाँ खेल रहे हैं?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks like it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ऐसा लगता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे लगा कि यह तो किसी और रात का उपकरण है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा एक ड्रिंक लगभग खत्म हो गया है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हमारे पास साइड दीवार के पास एक छोटी सी टेबल है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम मुझे टाइम कर रहे हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं यह तय कर रही हूँ कि खाना मैन्यू मांगना है या नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यहाँ एक है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने नोटिस किया है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं पूरे दिन बचे हुए पास्ता को लेकर घूम रही हूँ। मुझे कुछ और देखने दो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा फोन फिर से?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm checking the time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं समय देख रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हारा बॉयफ्रेंड तुम्हारे संदेश का इंतज़ार कर रहा है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने कहा था कि मैं उसे बताऊँगी कि मैं क्या कर रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसे बताना कि खाना अच्छा है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why?
So he knows why you're staying
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ताकि उसे पता चले कि तुम क्यों रुक रही हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने अभी तक नहीं कहा कि मैं रुक रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम उस मैन्यू को पाँच मिनट से देख रहे हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शायद मैं भूखी हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो फिर मेरे साथ रहो और खाओ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, मैं भी थोड़ी संगीत सुनना चाहती हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लेकिन मैं खाना चुन रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd say that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे लगा तुम ऐसा ही कहोगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे एक मिनट दो, मैं उसे बताने जा रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो सच में अच्छा लग रहा है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हम जाने से पहले कुछ खाने जा रहे हैं, यहाँ एक बैंड शुरू हो रहा है 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो तुम थोड़ी देर और रुक रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मुझे नहीं पता था कि आज रात यहाँ लाइव संगीत है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम क्या ले रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक फ्लैटब्रेड और फ्राई, कुछ खास नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पूरे शाम अपने लंच को लेकर घूमने से बेहतर है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वह कंटेनर अब खाली है, इसे मेरी निर्णयों का न्याय करना बंद कर देना चाहिए 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे लगा तुम सिर्फ एक ड्रिंक के लिए जा रही हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने भी ऐसा ही सोचा था, लेकिन हम अच्छा समय बिता रहे हैं और मैंने लंच के बाद कुछ नहीं खाया है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और कुर्सी मेरी पीठ को नहीं तोड़ने की कोशिश कर रही है, इसके लिए मैं आभारी हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब मैं घर पहुँचूँगी, तब भी तुम्हें टेक्स्ट करूँगी ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When the food arrives...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब खाना आएगा...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: डिनर, पहले मैं सारी फ्राइज़ खाने से पहले 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा लग रहा है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसकी खुशबू भी अच्छी है, मैं इसे गर्मागर्म खा रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अपने खाने का मज़ा लो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk in a bit ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ी देर में बात करते हैं ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या अब फ्राइज़ खाने की इजाज़त है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you ordered?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने ऑर्डर किया?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I took one photo, you'll survive
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने एक फोटो ली, तुम बच जाओगे

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वे हमारे बीच फोन के बिना बेहतर लग रहे थे

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम बिना ड्रामा किए मेरी ध्यान पा सकते हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो इसे रख दो और वो कोशिश करो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The flatbread?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रोटी?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, the tablecloth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं, मेज़पोश

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बात करते रहो, मैं तुम्हारा आधा भी खा जाऊँगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने एक वजह से अतिरिक्त फ्राइज़ मंगवाई हैं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे भी कुछ काम हैं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सावधान, ये लगभग एक और तारीफ है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अभी नहीं, मैं अभी भी देख रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few songs into the set...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कुछ गानों के बाद...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you say?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने क्या कहा?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अपनी कुर्सी यहाँ लाओ, मैं मेज़ के पार चिल्ला नहीं रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम बस मुझसे कह सकते थे कि मेरे पास बैठ जाओ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने अभी किया

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In the most bossy way possible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सबसे हुक्म चलाने वाले तरीके से

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you're moving the chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और फिर भी तुम कुर्सी हिला रहे हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्योंकि मैं तुम्हें सुन नहीं पा रही, इतना खुश मत दिखो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें रोक नहीं रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे अपना बैग हटा लेने दो, पहले तुम उसमें पैर मत डालो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें इसे करने दूंगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या किताब को भी अपनी कुर्सी मिल रही है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसके पास तुमसे बेहतर शिष्टाचार है, इसे एक मिलना चाहिए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} अपने मैनेजर के पास कुर्सी खिसकाती है ताकि वह संगीत के ऊपर उसे सुन सके

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वह उसे जवाब देने के लिए करीब झुकती है, उसका हाथ थोड़ी देर के लिए उसके कलाई पर रखता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: दृश्य कैप्चर संग्रहित

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसके बाज़ू पर रखा हाथ मुझे चुभता है। इतना छोटा-सा इशारा, और मैं यहाँ बैठा सोच रहा हूँ कि वे और कितने करीब आएँगे।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Little Closer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ा करीब

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know this one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम इसे जानते हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मुझसे इसे गाने के लिए मत कहो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to risk the evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं शाम को जोखिम में नहीं डालने वाली थी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excuse you, I might be very good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें माफ करना, मैं बहुत अच्छी हो सकती हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम हो सकती हो। मैं इसे इतना मज़ेदार पा रही हूँ कि जानने की जरूरत नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम बहुत बुरे हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the cupboard survive you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या अलमारी तुम्हें सहन कर पाई?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम हँसे

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इससे तुम कम भयानक नहीं हो जाते

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यहाँ तुम अलग हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या मैं छह बजे से कम थका हुआ हूँ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तुम मुझसे बात कर रहे हो, तुम सच में मेरी नजरें थाम लेते हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शायद तुम बहुत घूरते हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like looking at you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे तुम्हें देखना पसंद है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम थोड़ी चतुराई से काम ले सकते हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कर सकता हूँ। मुझे इसका कोई मतलब नहीं दिखता

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने देखा।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह फिलहाल रसोई में कई ढेरों में बंटी हुई है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पहले से ही सुधार है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the set, with the plates cleared...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सेट के बाद, जब प्लेटें साफ हो गईं...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should check the bus times
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे बस के समय चेक करने चाहिए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get the bill
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं बिल लाऊँगा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can pay for my food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अपने खाने का भुगतान कर सकता हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I invited you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने तुम्हें बुलाया था

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि मैं भुगतान नहीं कर सकता

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसका मतलब है कि मैं आज रात भुगतान कर रहा हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really are like this everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम सच में हर जगह ऐसे ही हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारी शाम बोरिंग नहीं रही, है ना?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं, मैं तुम्हें यह देता हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो तुम उस बिंदु पर हो जहाँ तुम शुरू करने पर पछता रहे हो 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इसे ले लूँगा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगभग बीस मिनट में एक बस है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: काफी समय है। अपना जैकेट पहन लो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कृपया?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get your jacket, please
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अपना जैकेट पहन लो, कृपया

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, you can learn
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: देखो, तुम सीख सकते हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Deeply
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: गहराई से

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कम से कम मुझे एक उपयोगी मग छोड़ दो, ठीक है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कोई वादा नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं थोड़ी देर के लिए अपना फोन रख रही हूँ, जब मैं घर पहुंचूंगी तो तुम्हें टेक्स्ट करूंगी ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, बाद में बात करते हैं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At their table, a little later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उनकी टेबल पर, थोड़ी देर बाद...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बार में {{name:lena}} के पास एक बातचीत हो रही है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने कहा था, काम के बाद एक ड्रिंक है। मैं मानना चाहता हूँ कि इससे घबराने की ज़रूरत नहीं, पर बार-बार स्क्रीन देख रहा हूँ।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//लाइव ट्रांसक्रिप्शन

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तू अच्छी लग रही है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तूने मुझे एक घंटे पहले काम पर देखा था

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यहाँ खाना भी है, तो ये बहुत अच्छा है 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तू तब भी अच्छी लग रही थी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या इसी वजह से तू बार-बार देख रही थी?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुझे लगा कि मैं देख रही थी कि तूने रिपोर्ट खत्म की या नहीं?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुझे तो ऐसा ही होना चाहिए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The report got finished, didn't it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रिपोर्ट खत्म हो गई, है ना?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work talk tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आज रात काम की बात नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तूने ही इसे उठाया

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पहले से ही पता है कि तू थकाने वाली होने वाली है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम अपने बॉस से ऐसे बात करते हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या मैं तुम्हें याद दिलाऊं कि मेरे बॉस ने मेरे साथ क्या किया?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम समय पर खत्म कर पाए?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ..what good weather we have today
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ..आज कितना अच्छा मौसम है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah I thought so
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मुझे भी ऐसा लगा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तू बैठते ही मुस्कुरा रही है। मैं अपनी किस्मत आजमाता हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तू हमेशा इतनी खुश रहती है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: On a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक अच्छे शाम पर

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've barely started
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हमने तो अभी शुरुआत ही की है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, तेरे सिर और बड़ा होने से पहले, तू क्या लेगी?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अदरक वाला ले, यहाँ अच्छा है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तू हर जगह निर्देश देती है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगभग, मुझे लंच कंटेनर को बहुत सावधानी से अपने बैग में रखना पड़ा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सिर्फ तब जब मुझे पता हो कि मैं क्या कह रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो तेरी राय में, हर जगह

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're getting to know me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तू मुझे जानने लगी है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unfortunately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: दुर्भाग्यवश

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm having the orange one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं संतरे वाला ले रही हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just to disagree with me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तू सिर्फ मुझसे असहमत होने के लिए ऐसा कर रही है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्योंकि मुझे यह पसंद है। चौंकाने वाला है, मुझे पता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, लेकिन जब तू अपना मन बदले तो मेरा मत मांगना

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: चिंता मत कर, मैं तुझे संतोष नहीं दूँगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब उनके पेय आएंगे...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still carrying the book too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम अभी भी किताब ले जा रहे हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, the table was a good choice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, टेबल एक अच्छा चुनाव था

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So was the bar
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बार भी ऐसा ही था
