story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तू एक तारीफ स्वीकार कर सकती है बिना बाकी इकट्ठा किए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक पर क्यों रुकें?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you come here a lot?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तू यहाँ अक्सर आती है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: काफी बार आती हूँ ताकि पता हो कि कौन सी टेबल स्पीकर के पास नहीं है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत रणनीतिक

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने पिछले महीने उसके जन्मदिन के लिए एक दोस्त को यहाँ लाया। उसने छह लोगों को बुलाया और कहीं बुक नहीं किया।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह तो बहुत व्यवस्थित लगता है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने इसे स्वाभाविक होना कहा। मैंने मालिक को बुलाया।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, इसे एक पूरा कामकाजी दिन बिना खोले बिताना पड़ा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो तुम्हारी शाम बचाने की कहानी असल में किसी को जानने की कहानी है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हमने खाया, है ना?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे उम्मीद है कि उसने उसके बाद तुम्हारा खाना खरीदा।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल। अगर मैं इसे आयोजित कर रही हूँ और इसके लिए भुगतान कर रही हूँ, तो हम मेरी जन्मदिन मनाने के लिए भी कर सकते हैं।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वहाँ है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो हिस्सा जहाँ तुम खुद को मुख्य आकर्षण बनाते हो।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम अगली कहानी बताने के लिए स्वागत हो।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे नहीं लगता कि मैं तुम्हारी नायकी टेबल बुकिंग से मुकाबला कर सकती हूँ।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम कोशिश कर सकती हो।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A useful contribution
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक उपयोगी योगदान

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, कल मेरे प्रोफेसर ने दस मिनट तक गलत स्लाइड समझाई।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: किसी ने कुछ नहीं कहा?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हम सब इसे लिख रहे थे। मेरे पास आधा पन्ना था जब किसी ने आखिरकार पूछा।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें उसे रोकना चाहिए था।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं व्यस्त थी यह मानने में कि उसे मुझसे ज्यादा पता है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम हर किसी के साथ ऐसा गलती करती हो जो जिम्मेदार होता है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाल ही में कम और कम।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That wasn't a compliment to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह तुम्हारे लिए कोई तारीफ नहीं थी।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने इसे ऐसा नहीं लिया।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Emotional support literature 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: भावनात्मक समर्थन साहित्य 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes a change
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह एक बदलाव है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} अपने मैनेजर के साथ अपने पेय पर हंसती है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: दृश्य कैप्चर संग्रहित

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वह मुस्कान उम्मीद से ज़्यादा दुख देती है। पहले उसे देखकर लगता था कि वह मेरे साथ रहना चाहती है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Away From the Office
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ऑफिस से दूर

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing when classes finish?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्लास खत्म होने पर तुम क्या कर रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तक मुझे अपना अलार्म नफरत नहीं हो जाता, तब तक सो रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसके बाद।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं एक किताब के साथ समुद्र तट पर एक दिन चाहती हूँ और कोई समय सारणी नहीं।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कोई बड़ा व्यवस्थित कार्यक्रम नहीं, बस इतना समय कि मुझे अपना फोन चेक नहीं करना पड़े।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे मुख्य समुद्र तट से दूर एक अच्छा स्थान पता है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल तुम्हें पता है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's the place like?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वहाँ का माहौल कैसा है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: मुझे उम्मीद है कि तुम्हारा प्रोफेसर तुम्हें कल ढेर सारे सजा के एक्सरसाइज देगा।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: मुझे इससे कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Extra work with him is… fine
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: उसके साथ थोड़ा काम करना... ठीक है
मुझे अभी एक बात समझ आई

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: वैसे, मैं सोने जा रही हूँ इससे पहले कि तुम मुझे फिर से पूछताछ करने लगो।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: हम मेरी पैंट के लिए शॉपिंग गए और तुमने मुझसे ज्यादा सामान खरीद लिया।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: तू शॉपिंग इंडस्ट्री के लिए खतरा है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And yet you still invited me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: नौ बजे के थोड़ी देर बाद, बार के बाहर...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम मेरी तरह लग रहे हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Someone has to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: किसी को तो करना होगा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ठीक है, मैं इसे एक मिनट में ले आऊँगी 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम्हारा दोपहर कैसा गया? क्या तुमने अलमारी खत्म कर ली?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: इसे खत्म कर दिया और फिर किसी तरह नीचे के दराज पर शुरू कर दिया।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ऐसे ही ये तुम्हें पकड़ लेता है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे इतना टेकअवे कटलरी मिला कि एक रेस्टोरेंट खोल सकूं।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: कृपया बताओ कि तुमने इसका कुछ फेंक दिया।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ज्यादातर।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ज्यादातर?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't make me regret saying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे यह कहने पर पछताने मत दो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: एक अचानक चम्मच की आपात स्थिति हो सकती है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: अगर मेरा गायब हो गया तो मैं इसे ध्यान में रखूंगी 😌।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: असल में, इसे व्यवस्थित करना अच्छा है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: अब तुम मग्स बिना किसी चीज़ के गिरने के ढूंढ सकते हो।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम प्रभावित हो जाओगे।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to ask about that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं इसके बारे में पूछने वाला था।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: My collection of forks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मेरे चम्मचों का संग्रह?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Coming over, idiot ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: आ रही हूँ, बेवकूफ ❤️।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैंने आज जाने से पहले कल के घंटे चेक किए। मैं पांच बजे खत्म करती हूँ।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या मैं काम के बाद आ सकती हूँ? लगभग छह बजे?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बहुत देर हो चुकी है, मैं इसे रख रहा हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, of course
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हाँ, बिल्कुल।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You don't have somewhere else to be?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुम्हारे पास कहीं और जाने का नहीं है?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: नहीं, मैं तुम्हारे साथ शाम बिताना चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे भी ये पसंद है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हम कुछ खाने के लिए बना सकते हैं, और तुम एक फिल्म चुन सकते हो जो हमें दोनों को अपमानित न करे।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुम बिना अपराध सुलझाए सहन कर सकोगे?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं इसके बजाय किचन की अलमारी की जांच करूंगी।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: एक बहुत ही खतरनाक असाइनमेंट।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll bring protective equipment 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं सुरक्षा उपकरण लाऊंगी 😭।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed having you here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे तुम्हारी यहाँ कमी महसूस हुई।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Obviously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: स्पष्ट रूप से

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed it too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे भी इसकी कमी महसूस हुई।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: और मैं एक असली गले लगाना चाहती हूँ, न कि इसके बारे में एक और संदेश।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ये व्यवस्थित किया जा सकता है।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: अच्छा ❤️ मैं तुम्हें बताऊंगी जब मैं कल काम से निकलूंगी।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं यहाँ रहूँगी।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम्हें यहाँ होना चाहिए, मैं एक पूरा दिन बर्दाश्त नहीं करूँगी सिर्फ ये जानने के लिए कि तुम बाहर चले गए हो 😌।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं सोफे पर जगह बना दूंगी।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't take the good cushion
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: अच्छा कुशन मत लो।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: अपने ही घर से मांगें कर रही हो।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हमेशा ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your stop is down here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम्हारा स्टॉप यहाँ है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ठीक है, मैं बिस्तर पर जा रही हूँ इससे पहले कि मैं लाइट जलाकर सो जाऊं।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुमने लंच बॉक्स निकाल लिया?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हाँ, ये सिंक में है। तुम अब मुझे देखना बंद कर सकती हो 😭।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं इसे विचार करूंगी।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: शुभ रात्रि खूबसूरत, तुमसे प्यार है ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Love you too, see you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुमसे भी प्यार है, कल मिलते हैं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: See you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: कल मिलते हैं ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know where it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे पता है यह कहाँ है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: संगीत अच्छा था। मैं और भी देर तक रुकता अगर मुझे कल कुछ नहीं करना होता

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हम अगली बार के लिए जानेंगे

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're already deciding there's a next time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुम पहले से ही अगली बार का फैसला कर रही हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं कह रही हूँ कि मैं तुम्हें फिर से बाहर ले जाऊँगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम थोड़ी अनिश्चितता के लिए जगह छोड़ सकती हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बातचीत जारी रहती है जब दोनों विषय बस स्टॉप की ओर चलते हैं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: वे साथ बाहर निकल रहे हैं। शाम खत्म होने पर मुझे खुश होना चाहिए, पर लगता है जैसे किसी और बुरी बात का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//लाइव ट्रांसक्रिप्शन

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Why? I know what I want
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्यों? मुझे पता है कि मुझे क्या चाहिए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That must be nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ये तो अच्छा होना चाहिए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम भी दरवाजे की तरफ भाग नहीं रही थी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I wasn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: नहीं, मैं नहीं थी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: वे एक शांत कोने पर रुकते हैं, जहाँ बस स्टॉप सड़क के आगे दिखाई दे रहा है...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैंने पूरे शाम तुम्हें फिर से चूमने की इच्छा की है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम सच में कुछ भी अपने पास नहीं रखती

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Not that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: वो नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't get ahead of yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: अपने से आगे मत बढ़ो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then stop looking at my mouth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तो फिर मेरे मुँह की तरफ देखना बंद करो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे नहीं पता था कि अंदर कितना शोर था जब तक हम बाहर नहीं आए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं नहीं करती

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मेरे पास एक बॉयफ्रेंड है। ये कल से नहीं बदला है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे पता है। मैं ये नहीं दिखावा कर रही कि मैंने तुम्हें सिर्फ काम की बात करने के लिए बुलाया है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: नहीं, तुमने ये बहुत स्पष्ट कर दिया है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: एक बार के लिए, क्या तुम इतना आत्मसंतुष्ट दिखना बंद कर सकती हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम इसे मुश्किल बना रही हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: {{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: {{name:lena}} उसे अपनी जैकेट से और करीब खींचती है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैनेजर उसके करीब झुकता है और उसे चूमता है; वह भी चुम्बन का जवाब देती है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: दृश्य कैप्चर संग्रहित

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: इस बार वह उसे अपने करीब खींच रही है। अब खुद से यह नहीं कह सकता कि यह बस उसने उसके साथ किया था।

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Before the Bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बस से पहले

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't say it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ये मत कहो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Say what?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या कहें?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You were managing to make yourself heard
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम खुद को सुनाने में सफल हो रहे थे

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: जो भी आत्मसंतुष्ट बात तुम कहने वाली हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं ये कहने वाली थी कि मेरा शाम अच्छा था

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: किसी तरह तुमने इसे फिर भी आत्मसंतुष्ट बना दिया

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम इसकी आदत डाल लोगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't push your luck
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: अपनी किस्मत को मत आजमाओ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Worth a try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: कोशिश करने लायक है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I need to go now
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे अब जाना है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your bus isn't here yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम्हारी बस अभी तक नहीं आई है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे पता है, लेकिन मैं स्टॉप पर इंतज़ार करने वाली हूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ठीक है। कल मिलते हैं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: सिर्फ इसलिए कि तुम मुझे जवाब देने के लिए झुकने पर मजबूर कर रहे थे

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: काम पर

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's where I'll be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं वहीं रहूँगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: शुभ रात्रि

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night, {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: शुभ रात्रि, {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little later, on the bus home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: थोड़ी देर बाद, घर की बस में...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं बस में हूँ ❤️ मैं जल्दी घर पहुँच जाऊँगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुम्हें सीट मिली?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हाँ, और मेरा बैग आखिरकार मेरे कंधे से उतार दिया गया है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: किताब को राहत मिलेगी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: इसने एक बहुत ही रोमांचक दिन बिताया है, जितना इसे मिलना चाहिए था 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम्हें कोई परवाह नहीं लगती थी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Was it a long walk to the stop?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या बस स्टॉप तक लंबा चलना पड़ा?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: नहीं, वह मेरे साथ कोने तक चला, फिर मैं बस का इंतज़ार करने चली गई

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ठीक है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Once she is home...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हे ❤️ मैं घर आ गई, क्या तुम जागते रह सके?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे खेद है कि हम जितना सोचा था उससे ज्यादा देर तक रुके

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुम्हारा अच्छा समय बीता?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम बहुत जल्दी तय कर लेते हो कि मुझे क्या पसंद है और क्या नहीं

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हाँ, मुझे अच्छा लगा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: खाना अच्छा था और बैंड ने पूरा सेट खेला

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ज्यादातर कवर थे, कुछ मुझे पता थे और कई ऐसे थे जिनके बारे में मैंने दिखावा किया कि मुझे पता है 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुम ऐसा करती हो?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: एक बहुत ही विश्वसनीय सिर हिलाना तुम्हें काफी दूर ले जाता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं इसे अगली बार याद रखूँगी जब तुम मुझे कुछ खेलते देखोगे

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: यह पूरी तरह से अलग है, मैं हमेशा तुम्हारे जटिल गेम निर्णयों को समझती हूँ 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बिल्कुल, तुम ऐसा करते हो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बार अच्छा था। मैं पहले वहाँ नहीं गई थी

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तो मुझे बताओ। क्या तुम्हारी शाम अच्छी रही?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: क्या तुम्हारे मैनेजर ने इसे चुना?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हाँ, और उसने शाम का एक अच्छा हिस्सा यह सुनिश्चित करने में बिताया कि मैं उसकी बेहतरीन पसंद की सराहना करूँ

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तो लगता है कि वह काम के बाहर भी ऐसा ही है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: वह निश्चित रूप से अपनी मर्जी चलाना पसंद करता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: और तुम?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैंने उसे 'कृपया' जोड़ने के लिए कहा जब उसने मुझे जैकेट लेने के लिए कहा

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बड़ी उपलब्धि

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm choosing to count it 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैं इसे गिनने का फैसला कर रही हूँ 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: तुम ऐसा लग रहा है कि तुमने अच्छा समय बिताया

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मैंने किया, थोड़ी देर बाहर जाना अच्छा था

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: हाँ, रही

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm glad you're home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुम घर आ गए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Me too ❤️
Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: मुझे बदलने के लिए एक मिनट दो, मैं इन कपड़ों में और नहीं बैठना चाहती

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ठीक है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A few minutes later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: कुछ मिनट बाद...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: वहाँ, न तो जूते और न ही कुछ ले जाने के लिए

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: यह ज्यादा आरामदायक लग रहा है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Much. The bag can wait until morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बहुत। बैग सुबह तक इंतज़ार कर सकता है

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At least take the lunch box out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: कम से कम लंच बॉक्स निकाल लो

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There we go
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: बस, हो गया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: बहुत देर हो चुकी है, मैं तो आ रही हूं 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: तो, भविष्य की ग्रेजुएट आज कैसा महसूस कर रही है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मुझे अपने डिप्लोमा को हाथ में लेने का इंतजार नहीं हो रहा।
मैं भूल गई थी कि वह अमीर है 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: जब वह हमेशा स्पोर्ट्सवियर में होता है तो भूलना आसान है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मुझे ज्यादातर अपनी गर्मियों की बॉडी चाहिए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That comment yesterday really got to you, huh?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: कल का कमेंट तुम्हें बहुत छू गया, है ना?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to look good in a bikini this summer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: इस गर्मी में मुझे बिकिनी में अच्छा दिखना है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I need to start now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: तो मुझे अब से शुरू करना होगा।
मैंने पहले ही {{name:aiden}} से बात की।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: We have a session planned today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: हमारा आज एक सत्र तय है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm not completely sure about the diploma yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मैं डिप्लोमा के बारे में पूरी तरह से सुनिश्चित नहीं हूं अभी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you're the one who suggested I keep him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: और फिर भी तुम वही हो जिसने मुझे उसे रखने का सुझाव दिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But I'm going to keep pushing until the end
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: लेकिन मैं अंत तक धक्का देती रहूंगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I didn't think studying with Ethan would give you this much motivation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मुझे नहीं लगा था कि ईथन के साथ पढ़ाई करने से तुम्हें इतनी प्रेरणा मिलेगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The carrot at the end of the stick is very motivating 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: लकीर के अंत में गाजर बहुत प्रेरणादायक है 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're not even trying to hide it anymore
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: तुम तो अब इसे छिपाने की भी कोशिश नहीं कर रही हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can come down whenever you want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: तुम कभी भी नीचे आ सकती हो।
तुम आज सुबह बहुत अच्छी हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सुप्रभात ❤️ मैंने एक बालियाँ खो दी हैं और किसी तरह इसे तुम्हारी गलती मान लिया है, तुम्हारा सुबह कैसा चल रहा है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जो अभी उठी है, उसके लिए ये बहुत ही चिकना था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been awake a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं थोड़ी देर से जागी हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Couldn't sleep?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सो नहीं पाई?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं जल्दी उठ गई और फिर से आराम नहीं कर पाई।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कोई ड्रामा नहीं, बस तकियों से बहस हो गई।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could have messaged me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तू मुझे मैसेज कर सकती थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तू जवाब देती और फिर मुझे थका हुआ होने के लिए दोष देती।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये गहनों के लिए तुझे दोष देने से बिल्कुल अलग है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, found it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: रुको, मिला!

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह नाश्ते से पहले एक प्रभावशाली आरोप है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये पूरी समय मेरी आस्तीन में फंसा हुआ था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that apology in writing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे वो माफी लिखित में चाहिए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: प्रिय सुंदर, मुझे खेद है कि सबूत मेरी बहुत ही उचित आरोप का समर्थन नहीं कर सके।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Accepted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: स्वीकृत।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: शानदार, अब मेरी मदद कर कि क्या ये सब एक साथ ठीक लग रहे हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 मिनट बाद

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: दोनों बालियां, दोनों जूते, बैग में असली लेक्चर नोट्स।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक ऐसी महिला का बहुत ही विश्वसनीय प्रभाव जो अपनी जिंदगी को संभालती है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it took several attempts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: धन्यवाद, इसमें कई प्रयास लगे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was reading your messages while putting them on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं उन्हें पहनते समय तुम्हारे संदेश पढ़ रही थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And yes, they look good together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और हाँ, ये एक साथ अच्छे लगते हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I'm not changing again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अच्छा, क्योंकि मैं फिर से नहीं बदलने वाली।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never going to listen to me, were you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम कभी मेरी बात सुनने वाली नहीं थी, है ना?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not if you were wrong 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अगर तुम गलत होती तो नहीं 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling about today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: आज के बारे में तुम्हें कैसा लग रहा है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने तैयार होने से पहले {{name:aiden}} को मैसेज किया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: फिर मैंने हंसते हुए एक गिरा दिया, और अब मेरे पास एक बहुत ही सुंदर कान है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Asked if he had a few minutes after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: पूछा कि क्या उसके पास क्लास के बाद कुछ मिनट हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What did he say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसने क्या कहा?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हाँ, और फिर उसने पूछा कि क्या उसे वो नोट्स लाने चाहिए जो उसने उधार लिए थे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least he remembers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कम से कम उसे याद है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He still has no idea what I want to talk about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसे अभी भी नहीं पता कि मैं किस बारे में बात करना चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जिससे मैं चाहती हूँ कि सब कुछ टेक्स्ट में समझा दूं ताकि पहली लाइन खत्म हो जाए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would that actually make it easier?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या इससे वाकई आसान होगा?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For about ten seconds
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लगभग दस सेकंड के लिए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: फिर मैं पूरा सुबह इस बारे में सोचते हुए बिताऊँगी कि क्या वो अपने फोन पर हंस रहा है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're allowed to open with something awkward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हें कुछ अजीब से शुरुआत करने की इजाजत है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let me see the damage
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे नुकसान दिखाओ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है, लेकिन मैं चाहती थी कि सीधे आकर्षक बनने पर पहुँच जाऊं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You managed with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने मेरे साथ कर लिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम एक असामान्य रूप से क्षमाशील दर्शक थी ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You had me at the first insult
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: पहले अपमान पर तुमने मुझे जीत लिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तो शायद मुझे उसे बताना चाहिए कि वो परेशान करने वाला है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might not realize this is a special conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसे शायद यह नहीं पता कि यह एक खास बातचीत है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly my concern
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल मेरी चिंता

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं क्लास के बाद उससे सही से बात करूंगी, पहले खुद को एक और बहाना देने से पहले

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sound much too pleased about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम इस बारे में बहुत खुश लग रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I published the profile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने प्रोफ़ाइल प्रकाशित कर दी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Already?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: पहले से?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: छठी बार परिचय फिर से लिखने से पहले

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कल रात की फोटो, रिश्ते में होने की बात, और मेरा बहुत आकर्षक पास्ता समस्या

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A strong introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक मजबूत परिचय

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने जोड़ा कि मेरा मतलब एक असली कैफे में असली कॉफी है, न कि कोई मेरे घर आने का आमंत्रण दे रहा हो

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये तो तुम जैसा लगता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने फोन को उल्टा रख दिया जैसे वो मुझे निर्देश देने लगेगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You know you don't have to answer anything during class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हें पता है कि क्लास के दौरान तुम्हें कुछ भी जवाब देने की जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं जानती हूं, और मैं इसे अपने ब्रेक तक अकेला छोड़ रही हूं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ज्यादातर इसलिए क्योंकि मैं नहीं चाहती कि मेरी पहली प्रतिक्रिया आज की लेक्चर से एक वाक्य हो

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Depends on the lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये लेक्चर पर निर्भर करता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कोई भी आदमी मेरे शोध विधियों के नोट्स को परिचय के रूप में नहीं ले सकता

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find someone with very specific interests
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम शायद किसी को बहुत विशिष्ट रुचियों के साथ पाओगे

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already have one of those 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मेरे पास पहले से ही एक ऐसा है 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Fair enough
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल सही

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It feels strange that it's actually there now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये अजीब लगता है कि अब ये सच में वहां है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लेकिन मैं खुश हूं कि मैंने बटन दबाया, न कि एक और दिन अल्पविराम को समायोजित करने में बिताया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I see the problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे समस्या समझ में आ गई।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What time do you finish?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा क्लास कब खत्म होता है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: दोपहर के आसपास, जब तक कोई सवाल नहीं खोज लेता जैसे हम निकल रहे हैं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और मुझे एक किताब लौटानी है इससे पहले कि लाइब्रेरी मुझे बहुत ही शिष्टता से धमकी देने वाले ईमेल भेजना शुरू कर दे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A busy day of facing your enemies
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे दुश्मनों का सामना करने का एक व्यस्त दिन।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You, university, the library
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम, विश्वविद्यालय, लाइब्रेरी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm on the list?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या मैं लिस्ट में हूँ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने मुझे तुम्हारी याद दिला दी जब मैं कपड़े पहनने की कोशिश कर रही थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: आपका स्वागत है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That wasn't a thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये धन्यवाद नहीं था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वैसे, मैंने तुम्हारी पास्ता एक अलग कंटेनर में रख दी है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: आखिरकार।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तो अब मेरे पास जल्दी आने का एक बहुत ही व्यावहारिक कारण है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You already have several very impractical ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे पास पहले से ही कई बहुत ही अव्यावहारिक कारण हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Those are my favorites ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वो मेरे पसंदीदा हैं ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ठीक है, अब जा रही हूँ इससे पहले कि मैं तुम्हारे साथ एक और बातचीत शुरू कर दूं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good luck today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: आज के लिए शुभकामनाएँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: धन्यवाद, खूबसूरत।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और कुछ ऐसा नाश्ता करो जो पैकेट से बाहर नहीं आया हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've narrowed down my options considerably
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने मेरे विकल्पों को काफी सीमित कर दिया है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तू अभी भी खूबसूरत लग रही है, जो मेरे खिलाफ तेरे मामले को कमजोर कर देता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तुम जानबूझकर ऐसा कर रही हो

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have a crush on him, don't you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तुम्हें अभी भी उस पर क्रश है, है ना?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm ready, let's go before you say something even worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं तैयार हूँ, चलो इससे पहले कि तुम कुछ और बुरा कहो

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're going to be late for {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: हम {{name:aiden}} के लिए लेट होने वाले हैं
मैं अभी भी अपना आउटफिट चुन रही हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're not going to a party
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तुम पार्टी में नहीं जा रही हो
तुम ट्रेनिंग के लिए जा रही हो

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I know… but I still want to look good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मुझे पता है... लेकिन मैं फिर भी अच्छा दिखना चाहती हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But with that outfit he's only going to be looking at your ass the whole time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: लेकिन उस आउटफिट में वो सिर्फ तुम्हारी बॉटम पर ही ध्यान देगा
मैं तो पहले से तैयार हूं 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still can't believe you're continuing after the main exam
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मुझे अभी भी विश्वास नहीं हो रहा कि तुम मुख्य परीक्षा के बाद भी जारी रख रही हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a really good supervisor
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मेरे पास एक बहुत अच्छा सुपरवाइजर है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or rather… really good punishments and rewards 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: या कहूं… बहुत अच्छे दंड और पुरस्कार 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have to actually study though
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: लेकिन तुम्हें वास्तव में पढ़ाई करनी होगी।
मुझे पता है, मुझे पता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It's hard to focus when you do that…
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: जब तुम ऐसा करती हो तो ध्यान लगाना मुश्किल होता है…
अध्ययन सत्र की अखंडता प्रभावित हुई

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So the reward came before the work this time, and my feelings about that are harder to joke away.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तो इस बार मेहनत से पहले इनाम मिल गया, और इस बारे में अपनी भावनाएँ मज़ाक में उड़ा देना मुश्किल है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of physical reward during study session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK ने अध्ययन सत्र के दौरान भौतिक इनाम का सबूत संग्रहित किया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll do my best to make sure you get the best grade possible then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए अपनी पूरी कोशिश करूंगी कि तुम सबसे अच्छा ग्रेड पाओ
मुझे यकीन है कि ऐसा ही था

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Ethan is coming to pick me up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ईथन मुझे लेने आ रहा है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why doesn't he just come to the house?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: वह बस घर पर क्यों नहीं आता?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're more comfortable at his place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: हम उसके घर पर ज्यादा आरामदायक होते हैं।
मैं बस इतना कह रही हूं 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हे 😊 क्लास खत्म हो गई, मैंने लाइब्रेरी की किताब लौटाई, और मैंने सीढ़ियों पर एक धूप वाला स्थान चुरा लिया है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्योंकि अगर हम ऐसा कुछ करने जा रहे हैं, तो मैं चाहूंगी कि यह किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के साथ हो जिस पर हम भरोसा करते हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Both of you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम दोनों?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। वह तुम पर भरोसा करता है, और मैं भी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है कि तुम किसी भी चीज़ पर मजाक कर सकते हो, लेकिन मुझे यह भी पता है कि मैं तुम्हें बता सकती हूँ जब कुछ महत्वपूर्ण हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ओह

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was that the part that finally shut you up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या यही वह हिस्सा था जिसने तुम्हें चुप कर दिया?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For a second, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक सेकंड के लिए, हाँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह सच में बहुत मायने रखता है। मैंने भी उस हिस्से की उम्मीद नहीं की थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: इतना हैरान मत दिखो। मैं कभी-कभी तुम्हारे बारे में अच्छी बातें कहती हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: आमतौर पर मुझे तुरंत बाद में बेवकूफ नहीं कहे बिना नहीं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did the morning go?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सुबह कैसी रही?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can still do that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं अभी भी ऐसा कर सकती हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वह रही।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं प्रभावित हूँ। सच में। यह अजीब है कि मेरे दोस्त को यह ठीक लगता है कि मैं उसकी गर्लफ्रेंड के साथ डेट पर जा रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम प्रभावित हो सकते हो और इसे अजीब भी मान सकते हो। मैं एक साथ जिज्ञासु और शर्मिंदा महसूस कर रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed the embarrassed part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने शर्मिंदा होने वाला हिस्सा देखा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल, तुमने देखा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुमने यहाँ आकर मुझे डेट पर पूछने के बाद पांच मिनट मेरी आँखों से बचते हुए बिताए हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं उम्मीद कर रही थी कि तुम ये नहीं कहोगे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुमने मुझे चुप रहने की क्षमता के लिए नहीं चुना।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly that was an oversight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ये तो साफ-साफ एक गलती थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fine once I actually started listening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक थी, जब मैंने सुनना शुरू किया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लेकिन क्या तुम सच में ये चाहती हो? सिर्फ इसलिए नहीं कि उसे ये आइडिया पसंद है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अगर मुझे सिर्फ उसे खुश करना होता, तो मैं यहाँ नहीं आती।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे तुम्हारे आस-पास रहना पसंद है। मैं जानना चाहती हूँ कि अगर हम ये दिखावा करना बंद कर दें कि सब कुछ मजाक है, तो कैसा लगेगा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो तुमने नोटिस किया है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not nearly as subtle as you think
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम उतने चतुर नहीं हो जितना तुम सोचते हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to be charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तो बस आकर्षक बनने की कोशिश कर रहा था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कभी-कभी ये काम करता है। मुझे ये कहने पर पछताने मत दो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम इसे सामान्य दिखाने में बहुत मुश्किल बना रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुमने पहली वाक्य के बाद से सामान्य नहीं रहा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सही। और हाँ, मैं तुम्हें कॉफी पर ले जाना चाहूँगा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हालांकि मैंने तारीख गलत जगह तीन बार लिखी, जब तक मैंने देखा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुम सच में सुनिश्चित हो?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हैरान हूँ, लेकिन अनइंटरेस्टेड नहीं। इसमें फर्क है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अच्छा, क्योंकि एक पल के लिए तुम ऐसे लग रहे थे जैसे तुम बाहर निकलने की कोशिश कर रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं सोच रही थी कि तुमसे पूरी बात तीसरी बार दोहराने के लिए कहने से कम शर्मनाक क्या हो सकता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तुम्हारी कोशिश की सराहना करता हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like you. An awkward conversation hasn't suddenly made that difficult to admit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे तुम पसंद हो। एक अजीब बातचीत ने इसे स्वीकार करना अचानक मुश्किल नहीं बना दिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of us needed a little longer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हममें से कुछ को थोड़ा और समय लगा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने नोटिस किया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And before you start feeling too pleased with yourself, I'm asking about a first date. Nothing beyond that is decided
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: और इससे पहले कि तुम अपने आप से बहुत खुश होने लगो, मैं पहले डेट के बारे में पूछ रही हूँ। इसके आगे कुछ तय नहीं हुआ है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. A coffee, then we see how it feels
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है। एक कॉफी, फिर देखते हैं कैसा लगता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A distracted student? Doesn't sound like you at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक ध्यान भटका हुआ छात्र? ये तो तुम नहीं हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Even if it feels weird?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अगर ये अजीब लगे तो?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then it feels weird. I'm still going to complain about the coffee and steal your fries next week
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो ये अजीब लगेगा। मैं फिर भी कॉफी की शिकायत करूंगी और अगले हफ्ते तुम्हारी फ्राई चुरा लूंगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Ideally without telling the entire table why we went out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: आदर्श रूप से बिना ये बताए कि हम बाहर क्यों गए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm teasing you, not announcing it to everyone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल। मैं तुम्हारा मजाक उड़ा रही हूँ, सबको नहीं बता रही।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Or making him regret being honest with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: या उसे मेरे साथ ईमानदार होने पर पछताने पर मजबूर करना।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I might need a second not to grin next time I see him, but I'm not going to make him feel bad about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है। अगली बार जब मैं उसे देखूंगी, तो मुस्कुराने में एक सेकंड लग सकता है, लेकिन मैं उसे इसके लिए बुरा नहीं महसूस कराऊंगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really won't?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम सच में नहीं करोगे?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He trusts me. You've just told me you do too. I'm not going to be an idiot about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वह मुझ पर भरोसा करता है। तुमने अभी कहा कि तुम भी करते हो। मैं इस बारे में बेवकूफ नहीं बनने वाली।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only about everything else?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सिर्फ बाकी सब चीजों के बारे में?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let's not expect miracles
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: चलो चमत्कारों की उम्मीद न करें।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm choosing to ignore that 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं इसे नजरअंदाज करने का फैसला कर रही हूँ 😌।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you. Seriously
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: धन्यवाद। सच में।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: आपका स्वागत है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Coffee tomorrow? There's that place near the campus with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कल कॉफी? कैंपस के पास वो जगह है जहाँ असमान कुर्सियाँ हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The one where you complained the cups were too small?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वो जहाँ तुमने शिकायत की थी कि कप बहुत छोटे थे?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They were too small
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वो सच में बहुत छोटे थे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is already sounding like our normal conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ये तो पहले से ही हमारी सामान्य बातचीत की तरह लग रहा है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to ease you in
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तुम्हें धीरे-धीरे लाने की कोशिश कर रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow could work
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कल काम कर सकता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने उसे इसलिए चुना क्योंकि उसने मुझे हंसाया, जो शुरू करने के लिए एक अच्छा कारण लगा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसका पहला संदेश था कि क्या वो काल्पनिक लोग, जिनके लिए मैं खाना बनाती हूँ, कभी बर्तन धोने में मदद करते हैं?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better than asking whether you're single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह तो बेहतर है कि वो ये पूछे कि क्या तुम सिंगल हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sentence at a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक वाक्य में।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A significant improvement
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह एक बड़ा सुधार है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने उसे बताया कि वे भयानक मेहमान थे और उसने कहा कि उसके एकमात्र डिनर मेहमान ने एक बार मजाक में अग्निशामक लाया था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because of the pizza?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या ये पिज्जा के कारण है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लगता है कि फोटो में पिज्जा से पहले कई प्रयास हुए थे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं नहीं जानती कि क्या उसकी मेहनत सराहनीय है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to let him cook for you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हें उसे तुम्हारे लिए खाना बनाने की जरूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने ये कहा और उसने तुरंत कहीं ऐसा जगह सुझाई जहाँ असली स्टाफ हो 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds sensible of him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ये तो उसके लिए समझदारी की बात है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वह छब्बीस साल का है, शहर के दूसरी तरफ काम करता है, और हमारे विश्वविद्यालय के सर्कल का हिस्सा नहीं है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं उसे अभी नहीं जानती, लेकिन मुझे ये पसंद आया कि वह बिना हर दूसरी बात में मुझे प्रभावित करने की कोशिश किए बात कर सकता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's annoyingly sensible
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ये तो बहुत समझदारी की बात है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुम्हें उससे बात करने में आरामदायक लगता है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अब तक, हाँ, और उसने मुझे बिना ज्यादा कोशिश किए हंसाया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं कुछ छोटी-छोटी बातें अपने पास रख रही हूँ, लेकिन ये कोई नया है, हमारे दोस्तों में से कोई नहीं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's enough for now, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो अभी के लिए यही काफी है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे यह भी अच्छा लगा कि मैं बिना यह पूछे कि मैं कहाँ गायब हो गई, जवाब देने के लिए कुछ मिनट ले सकती थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हारे फोन को होमवर्क जैसा महसूस न कराना एक अच्छी शुरुआत है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सही है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं अब अपना फोन रख रही हूँ, नहीं तो मैं तुमसे बात करती रहूँगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब हम रुके, तब हम कल कॉफी पीने की बात कर रहे थे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already picked somewhere?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुमने कहीं चुन लिया?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने मुख्य खरीदारी की सड़क के पास वाले कैफे का सुझाव दिया, जिसमें बड़े खिड़कियाँ हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कहीं ऐसा जहाँ मैं जानती हूँ, दोपहर में, और बस एक ड्रिंक ताकि देख सकें कि हम आमने-सामने कैसे हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Does that feel like something you want to do?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या यह ऐसा लगता है जो तुम करना चाहोगे?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने खुद को सुझाव टाइप करते हुए पाया, इससे पहले कि उसने पूछा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जो मुझे पहले स्थान पर संदेश मिलने से ज्यादा आश्चर्यचकित करता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You sound happy about that
