story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम इस बारे में खुश लग रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am
Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जाओ। मैं बाद में यहाँ रहूँगी ❤️।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने किसी को बॉक्स टिकाने के लिए नहीं ढूंढा, मैंने एक बातचीत की जो मुझे पसंद आई और एक और चाही।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds more like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह तुम्हारी तरह लगता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It felt like me, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह मुझे भी ऐसा ही लगा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: और इससे यह मदद मिली कि मैं तुम्हें एक ही समय में अपडेट रखने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अब मैं वास्तव में तुमसे बात कर सकती हूँ, दो बातचीतों के बीच कूदने के बजाय।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे यह पसंद है कि हर एक से आधा वाक्य मिलने के बजाय।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: धन्यवाद

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: खैर, यह तुम्हारी गर्लफ्रेंड है, जिसने बिना बीस बार फिर से लिखे एक सामान्य संदेश भेजने में सफलता पाई।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look pleased with yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम अपने आप से खुश लग रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं हूँ, और मैं खुद को इसके लिए पाँच मिनट दे रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can have more than five
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम पाँच से ज्यादा ले सकते हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dangerous, I might become unbearable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: खतरनाक, मैं बर्दाश्त से बाहर हो सकती हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं जोखिम उठाने को तैयार हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This photo is for you, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वैसे, यह फोटो तुम्हारे लिए है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं किसी और को अपनी बहुत छोटी जीत मनाते हुए नहीं दिखा रही 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll treasure the exclusive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं इस खास पल को संजोकर रखूँगी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कुछ मिनट बाद

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब मुझे पता चलेगा कि कल की ग्रुप मीटिंग सुबह है या नहीं, तब मैं समय की पुष्टि कर दूँगी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे आज रात बताना

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ये मत भूलना कि तुम्हारा एक बॉयफ्रेंड है जो यूनिवर्सिटी से अलग बातें करना भी पसंद करता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't forgotten you for a second
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने तुम्हें एक सेकंड के लिए भी नहीं भुलाया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लेकिन जाने से पहले मुझे अपने दिन की एक साधारण बात बताओ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने एक गेम खोला एक काम करने के लिए और आधे घंटे तक कंट्रोल्स बदलते रहा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That is painfully believable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ये तो बहुत सच लग रहा है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं सोचने लगी थी कि तुम किसी और रास्ते से भाग गए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: डेस्क पर बैठी महिला ने मुझ पर ध्यान भी नहीं दिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: फिर मैंने उन्हें वापस बदल दिया क्योंकि मुझे पुराने वाले ज्यादा पसंद थे

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: धन्यवाद, इससे मुझे बहुत ज्यादा उत्पादक महसूस हुआ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy to help
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मदद करके खुशी हुई

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बाद में मुझे मैसेज करना, मुझे जानना है कि क्या तुम सच में इसे खेलते हो ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं लगभग भाग गई थी, लेकिन मेरी विश्वसनीयता की एक छवि है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Since when?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कब से?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making an excellent first impression
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम बहुत अच्छा पहला प्रभाव बना रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: First impression? I thought I was well past that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: पहला प्रभाव? मुझे लगा कि मैं इससे बहुत आगे बढ़ चुका हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on, let's walk a little
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: चलो, थोड़ा चलें।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects enter the courtyard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: दो लोग आंगन में प्रवेश करते हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बातचीत जारी है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं कोई भावना न होने का दिखावा किए बिना भी उसे चुनने की जगह दे सकता हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Away from the Crowd
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: भीड़ से दूर

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, now you actually are making me curious
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है, अब तुम सच में मेरी जिज्ञासा बढ़ा रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुमको याद है मैंने कल क्या कहा था? कहीं शांत जगह पर बात करने के बारे में।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ, और मैंने तुम्हें बारह बार न पूछने के बारे में बहुत परिपक्वता दिखाई है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने एक मशीन के लिए माफी तैयार की जो बस बीप कर रही थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तुम्हारी कोशिश की सराहना करता हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this a good place?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या यह अच्छा जगह है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, let's sit for a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ, चलो एक मिनट के लिए बैठते हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम अपनी बैग की पट्टी के साथ वो कर रही हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What thing?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कौन सा चीज?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Twisting it around your fingers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: इसे अपनी उंगलियों के चारों ओर घुमाना।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने ध्यान नहीं दिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हें जो भी यह है, उसे परफेक्ट बनाने की जरूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह तुम्हारी ओर से बहुत ज्यादा दयालुता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं मजाक तब तक बचा रहा हूँ जब तक मुझे नहीं पता कि हम किस बारे में बात कर रहे हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A very moving exchange
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक बहुत ही भावुक बातचीत।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} और मैं मेरे किसी और के साथ डेट पर जाने के बारे में बात कर रहे थे

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, what the fuck?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: रुको, क्या बकवास है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little quieter, please
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: थोड़ा शांत, कृपया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: माफ़ करना, लेकिन... {{name:player}} चाहता है कि तुम किसी दूसरे लड़के के साथ डेट पर जाओ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। हम इसके बारे में थोड़ी देर से बात कर रहे हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्यों? क्या तुम दोनों के बीच कुछ हुआ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: नहीं, हम साथ में खुश हैं। यह ब्रेकअप या किसी और को ढूंढने के बारे में नहीं है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो मैं कुछ मिस कर रहा हूँ, क्योंकि मैं सोच रहा होता कि मेरी गर्लफ्रेंड किसी और से डेट क्यों करना चाहती है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसने ही यह बात उठाई थी। उसे यह पसंद है कि मैं किसी और के साथ रहूं, और हम मिलकर फैसला करें।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे लगता है कि हम दोनों इंसान के रूप में बड़े हुए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसने यह बात उठाई?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। और इस पर बात करने के बाद, मुझे एहसास हुआ कि मैं भी जिज्ञासु थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुम सच में? क्या तुम दोनों यह देखने की कोशिश नहीं कर रहे कि मैं क्या कहूँगा?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या मैं ऐसा लग रहा हूँ कि मुझे यह समझाने में मज़ा आ रहा है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: माफ करना। मैं तुम्हारे ऊपर हंस नहीं रहा, मैं बस इसके लिए तैयार नहीं था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब उसने मुझे पहली बार बताया, मैं भी तैयार नहीं थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है, लेकिन तुम मुझे क्यों बता रही हो?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्योंकि मैं पूछना चाहती थी कि तुम उस व्यक्ति के बारे में कैसा महसूस करोगे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं? रुको, तुम कहना चाहती हो कि तुम मेरे साथ डेट पर जाना चाहती हो?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: नहीं, तुम्हारे पीछे खड़ा आदमी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: खैर, मैं यहाँ पाँच मिनट के लिए छिपी हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ऐसा मत करो, मैं अभी भी समझने की कोशिश कर रहा हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ, तुम। इसी वजह से मैंने तुमसे मिलने के लिए कहा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हे भगवान। और उसे पता है कि मैं हूँ? सिर्फ कोई अनजान आदमी नहीं?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हमने तुम्हारे बारे में खास तौर पर बात की, इसलिए यह कुछ ऐसा नहीं है जो मैं उसकी पीठ पीछे ला रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो उसे पता है कि तुम अभी यहाँ हो, मुझसे यह पूछने के लिए?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। उसे पता था कि मैं क्लास के बाद तुमसे बात करने वाली हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे लगा कि तुम किसी चीज़ के बारे में सलाह चाह रहे हो। मैं इसका हिस्सा बनने की उम्मीद नहीं कर रहा था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अब तुम समझ गई हो कि मैंने इसे कहने के लिए सुबह भर क्यों सोचा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं बार-बार उम्मीद कर रहा था कि वो मुझे तुमसे फ्लर्ट करना बंद करने के लिए कहेगा। यह तो एकदम अलग बातचीत है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कम से कम तुम थोड़ी कम गर्वित होने का नाटक तो कर सकती हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तो गर्वित भी नहीं हुआ हूँ। मैं अभी भी तुम्हें यकीन करने की कोशिश कर रहा हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} ने कुछ चौंकाने वाली बातें अपने तक ही रखी थीं, है ना?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लगता है। जब हमने पहली बार इसके बारे में बात की थी, तब मेरे चेहरे पर भी यही भाव था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बेचारा। उसने आखिरकार तुम्हें अपनी बात बताई और अब हम यहाँ अपनी प्रतिक्रियाएँ तुलना कर रहे हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम वो हो जो मुझे ऐसे घूर रही हो जैसे मैंने तुमसे कहा हो कि मेरी बैंक लूटने में मदद करो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं बैंक को जल्दी समझ जाता।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह मुझे आश्चर्य नहीं करता।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सच में, मैंने कभी नहीं सोचा था कि मैं तुम दोनों से इस तरह का प्रस्ताव सुनूँगा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है। हमें साथ में नई चीज़ें खोजने में मज़ा आता है, लेकिन इस पर थोड़ी और बात करनी पड़ी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I would hope so
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं यही उम्मीद करता हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're enjoying the silence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम तो चुप्पी का मज़ा ले रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: पहले मुझे नहीं पता था कि मैं क्या सोच रहा हूँ। फिर हमने और बात की, और मुझे यह जानने की इच्छा हुई कि यह कैसा महसूस हो सकता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And that's where I came in?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो क्या मैं यहाँ आया?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: आखिरकार।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Whose idea was that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह किसका आइडिया था?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हमने तुम्हारे बारे में बात की। तुम पूरी बातचीत नहीं सुन रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं बस पूछ रहा हूँ कि मुझे तुम्हारा धन्यवाद करना चाहिए या उसका।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither until you've actually answered my question
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब तक तुम मेरे सवाल का सही जवाब नहीं देती, तब तक किसी का भी नहीं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're enjoying watching me struggle now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम अब मुझे संघर्ष करते हुए देखना पसंद कर रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: थोड़ा। मैं सुबह से इसके बारे में नर्वस हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. Why me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है। मुझे क्यों?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कम से कम अब कोई नहीं पूछ सकता कि अगली स्लाइड ज़रूरी है या नहीं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I really wasn't expecting her to show up like that 👀
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: मुझे सच में उम्मीद नहीं थी कि वो ऐसे आएगी 👀

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She's always had a crush on you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: वो हमेशा से तुम पर क्रश रखती है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Now she's just taking full advantage of it 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: अब वो इसका पूरा फायदा उठा रही है 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Bro it was actually hard to concentrate on the exercises 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: भाई, एक्सरसाइज पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना वाकई मुश्किल था 😭
क्या ये तुम्हें परेशान नहीं करता?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Everyone can do whatever they want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: हर कोई जो चाहे कर सकता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Looking forward to the next sessions 🔥
And you, take it easy on the leg
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: और तुम, अपने पैर पर ध्यान देना

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: The doctor only took your cast off two days ago
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: डॉक्टर ने सिर्फ़ दो दिन पहले तुम्हारा प्लास्टर हटाया था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: First real session without the cast and you already handled most of the exercises
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: कास्ट के बिना पहला असली सत्र और तुमने पहले ही ज्यादातर एक्सरसाइज संभाल लीं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: It was really hard to stay focused during the session 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: सत्र के दौरान ध्यान केंद्रित करना वाकई मुश्किल था 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हे ❤️ मैंने अभी डिनर टेबल पर रखा है, क्या तुमने खा लिया या अभी भी उस गेम से बातचीत कर रहे हो?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like talking to you like this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे तुमसे इस तरह बात करना पसंद है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या जब तुम ऐसे सवाल पूछती हो जिनका मैं मजाक से जवाब नहीं दे सकता?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: खासकर तब।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हालांकि मुझे यकीन है कि तुम एक मिनट में फिर से कोशिश करोगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm waiting for an opening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं एक मौका का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Predictable man
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: भविष्यवाणी करने वाला आदमी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वैसे, मैं कुछ पहनकर देखना चाहती थी इससे पहले कि मैं बहुत आरामदायक हो जाऊं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कल के लिए?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मैं जो भी पहले निकालती, वही पहनने वाली थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर मुझे एहसास हुआ कि मैं वास्तव में कुछ ऐसा चुनना चाहती थी जो मुझे पसंद हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Show me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे दिखाओ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे एक मिनट दो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 6 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6 मिनट बाद

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह वाला, जैकेट के साथ अगर ठंडा है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यह पसंद है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You answered very quickly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने बहुत जल्दी जवाब दिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you prefer a slower compliment?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम धीरे-धीरे तारीफ पसंद करोगी?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd prefer one I believe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे एक ऐसी तारीफ पसंद है जिसे मैं मानूं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा ऐसा लग रहा है जैसे तुम अपनी दोपहर का आनंद लेने वाली हो, न कि अपने कपड़ों की चिंता करने वाली।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो अच्छा लग रहा है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's actually exactly what I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये तो सच में वही है जो मैं चाहती थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you look beautiful
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम बहुत खूबसूरत लग रहे हो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That part helps too 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो हिस्सा भी मदद करता है 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इन जूतों में बिना हर कदम के बारे में सोचे चल सकती हूँ, तो ये रहेंगे।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A very practical fashion decision
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये तो बहुत ही व्यावहारिक फैशन फैसला है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कई रंगों में ढली हुई हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो मैं ये आउटफिट रख रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रात का खाना या मैं?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और अगर मैं उसे एक तस्वीर भेजने का फैसला करती हूँ, तो तुम्हें भी वो मिलेगी, जैसे हमने कहा था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये सिर्फ तुम्हारे लिए है, मैंने इसे कहीं और नहीं भेजा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे प्रिव्यू देखना पसंद है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो इसकी कद्र करो, जैकेट पहनने में बहुत ही बेइज्जती वाली जद्दोजहद हुई थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अफसोस, मैं वो हिस्सा मिस कर गई।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तूने मुझसे रात के खाने के बारे में पूछा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वैसे, ये सिर्फ हमारे बीच की बात है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कल को तुम्हारे देखने के लिए चीजों का संग्रह नहीं बना रही हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं ड्रेस मिस करने पर अभी भी निराश होती।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारी आम गर्लफ्रेंड की तस्वीरें बंद नहीं हो रही हैं 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये फोटो सिर्फ तुम्हारे लिए है, ये कुछ ऐसा नहीं है जो मैंने उसे भेजा है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम ड्रेस का मजा ले सकते हो और फिर भी मुझे कुछ छोटी-छोटी बातें अपने पास रखने दो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इससे जी सकती हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा है, क्योंकि मुझे हर एक वाक्य पहले से प्लान न करने में मजा आ रहा है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुझे पहल करने की अनुमति है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये फोटो सिर्फ तुम्हारे लिए है, मैंने इसे उसे नहीं भेजा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और कल मैं बात करते समय अपना फोन अकेला छोड़ सकता हूँ, फिर बाद में तुम्हें इसके बारे में बता दूँगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह मेरे लिए अभी भी सही लगता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी, मैं नहीं चाहता कि हमारी पहली कॉफी स्क्रीन की तरफ देखते हुए बीते

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब मैं यह पहन रही थी, तब कुछ और हुआ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रात का खाना अच्छा लग रहा है, और काश मैं तेरे सामने बैठी होती

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने खुद को यह सोचते हुए पाया कि क्या उसे यह पसंद आएगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और फिर तुरंत तुम्हारा चेहरा देखना चाहा जब तुम इसे देखोगे

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यह पसंद है कि तुम दोनों चाहते थे

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी, सच में

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे लगा कि ये भावनाएँ एक-दूसरे के रास्ते में आ सकती हैं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसके बजाय मैं यहाँ खड़ी थी तुम्हें ड्रेस दिखाना चाहती थी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुमने किया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये बेहतर है ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और हमारी फिल्म दोपहर अभी भी हो रही है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने फ्रिज के सामने पास्ता का डिब्बा रख दिया है ताकि जब मैं आऊँ तो इसे न भूलूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें इसके बिना भी अंदर आने दूँगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है, लेकिन यह ज़रूरी है कि तुम समझो कि मैं कितना उदार मेहमान हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: खाने में उदार, रिमोट के साथ निर्दयी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने माना था कि मैं चुन सकता हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे याद है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा, मैंने कुछ ऐसा पाया है जहाँ तुम सच में अभिनेताओं को देख सकते हो

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम इसे कभी नहीं छोड़ने वाले हो, है ना?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तब तक नहीं जब तक मैं नहीं जान लेती कि उस दरवाजे पर कौन खड़ा था

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हालांकि तुझे तब तक हंसाना बंद करना होगा जब मैं खाना खा रही हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कोई नहीं जानता, यही तो फिल्म का हिस्सा है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बुरा सिस्टम

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रुको, मैं बदल रही हूँ, नहीं तो कल के कपड़ों में सो जाऊँगी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 8 मिनट बाद

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत बेहतर, मैं ये कपड़े बिल्कुल भीड़ के लिए नहीं रख रही हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरे लिए भी नहीं?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have a small exception
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे लिए एक छोटी सी छूट हो सकती है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like this version too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे ये वर्ज़न भी पसंद है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा, क्योंकि यही वो है जो तुम हमारी फिल्म के दौरान पहनोगी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उस पर कोई वादा नहीं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तक मैं तुम्हारे पास बैठ सकूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यही तो बात है ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अपना फोन रख दूँगी, नहीं तो तुम्हें जगाने का कोई और बहाना ढूँढ लूँगी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि, सुंदर लड़की

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि, सुंदर

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और नाश्ता करूँगी, नहीं तो कल पूछना पड़ेगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वह रही

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कभी नहीं गई 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आज के बाद तेरा पैर कैसा है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने खा लिया, और मैंने थोड़ी देर खेला भी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ा थका हुआ, लेकिन मैंने ज्यादा नहीं किया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे बाहर जाना अच्छा लगा, भले ही ये कोई रोमांच नहीं था

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा होने के लिए ये रोमांच होना जरूरी नहीं है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: देख तु कितना समझदार हो रहा है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने आज बहुत हिम्मत लगाई है, जो बची है उसे बचा रही हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इस बारे में बात करते हुए, कल का इंतज़ाम हो गया है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या कंट्रोल्स ठीक उसी जगह थे जहाँ पहले थे?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} जल्दी खाली हो जाएगा, इसलिए हम साढ़े तीन बजे कैंपस के पास वाले कैफ़े में मिल रहे हैं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जिसमें असमान कुर्सियाँ हैं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या वो तुम्हें मैसेज करते समय अलग लगा?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शायद थोड़ा ज्यादा सतर्क

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अजीब नहीं, बस हर चीज़ पर मजाक बनाने की कम कोशिश

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने शायद उसे चौंका दिया होगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने खुद को जरूर चौंका दिया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अपनी चीज़ें रख रही थी जब मुझे याद आया कि मैंने वास्तव में उससे क्या पूछा था

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और फिर मैं बस हॉलवे में खड़ी होकर कुछ नहीं देखकर मुस्कुरा रही थी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं वो देखना चाहती थी

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उस बात को फिर से उठाने की कोई जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं, तुम पूछते कि मैं किस बारे में मुस्कुरा रही थी और इसे और खराब कर देते

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगभग निश्चित रूप से

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अजीब बात ये है कि मैं उसे पहले से जानती हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कल मैं एक परिचित चेहरे को देखूंगी और सोचूंगी कि क्या वो कुछ ऐसा कहने वाला है जो मैंने पहले नहीं सुना

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या यही वो हिस्सा है जिसके बारे में तुम जिज्ञासु हो?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मुझे लगता है कि यही है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उसे किसी और में बदलने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही, मैं बस ये देखना चाहती हूँ कि जब हम इसे एक साधारण लंच मानना बंद कर दें तो ये कैसा लगता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हम साढ़े तीन बजे मुख्य बाज़ार वाली सड़क के पास के कैफ़े में मिल रहे हैं

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ी जरूरत है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने इसे चुना क्योंकि मुझे पता है कि ये कहाँ है और मुझे पहले दस मिनट खोया हुआ नहीं दिखना पड़ेगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा चुनाव

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और मैं वहाँ अकेले जा रही हूँ, किसी ऐसे से लिफ्ट नहीं जो मैंने अभी तक नहीं मिला।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने आज शाम ज्यादा बात की?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रात के खाने से पहले थोड़ी बात की।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर मैंने उसे बताया कि मैं खा रही हूँ और फोन रख दूँगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने यह कैसे लिया?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जैसे एक सामान्य इंसान जो और भी काम करता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह एक छोटी सी बात लगती है, लेकिन मुझे यह पसंद आया कि मुझे खुद को समझाना नहीं पड़ा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हें लगता है कि तुम आमने-सामने अच्छे रहोगे?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तूने क्या बनाया?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे उम्मीद है, लेकिन इसी वजह से मैं मिलना चाहती हूँ, न कि उसके पूरे व्यक्तित्व को संदेशों से बनाना।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे नहीं पता कि वह पहले चुप रहता है या अपने हाथों से बात करता है या अपनी ही मजाक पर हंसता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे पास पहले से ही कोई है जो आखिरी वाला करता है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, और वह बार-बार कहता है कि ये बेहतरीन मजाक हैं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: देखा? पूरी तरह से असंगत 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यह पसंद है कि अभी भी कुछ बातें हैं जो मुझे नहीं पता।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इतना नहीं कि उसे एक साथ मेरी ज़िंदगी में बुला लूँ, बस इतना कि एक कॉफी चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक आमलेट और एक सलाद

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, तुम्हारी बारी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरी बारी किसके लिए?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब मैंने कहा कि मैं वास्तव में उससे कल मिल रही हूँ, तो तुम्हारे दिमाग में पहली बात क्या आई?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पहला जवाब बहुत सहायक नहीं था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सच में? मैंने पढ़ना खत्म करने से पहले ही मुस्कुरा दिया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यह चाहिए, लेकिन अचानक यह बहुत असली लगने लगा है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इतनी जल्दी?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, खासकर क्योंकि तुमने मुझे बताते समय खुश लग रही थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर मैंने सोचा कि मैं यह कहने के लिए कुछ कम स्पष्ट सोचूं कि मैं कितनी मुस्कुरा रहा था।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम बस यह भी कह सकती थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सारी पास्ता का क्या हुआ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं चाहता था कि तुम्हारा पूरा दोपहर मेरी प्रतिक्रिया में बदल जाए।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अभी भी तुम्हारी प्रतिक्रिया सुनना चाहता हूँ।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं चाहता कि तुम्हारा इस में हिस्सा सिर्फ यह पूछने तक सीमित हो कि मैं ठीक हूँ या नहीं।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो हाँ, मैं उत्साहित हूँ, और मुझे खुशी है कि तुमने उससे पूछना चाहा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने किया

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और मुझे यह जानकर अच्छा लगता है कि तुम भी अपने फोन पर मुस्कुराते हुए बैठी हो। ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या यह बुरा तरीके से असली है?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बुरा नहीं, बस किसी काल्पनिक दोपहर के बारे में बात करने से अलग है।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं पास्ता से पहले एक ब्रेक ले रही हूँ, वरना हम एक-दूसरे से नफरत करने लगेंगे

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अब एक असली समय है, और कल तुम तैयार होकर जाओगी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब मैंने इसे अपने कैलेंडर में डाला, तब मुझे भी वही छोटा सा पल आया।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अभी भी चाहती हूँ कि तुम जाओ, बस मैंने इतना अंतर महसूस करने की उम्मीद नहीं की थी।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे बताने के लिए धन्यवाद, बजाय इसके कि तुम पूरी तरह से आरामदायक लगने की कोशिश करो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुमसे यह नहीं कह रही कि तुम मुझे इससे बाहर निकालने के लिए कहो।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और मैं कल इसे लेकर तुम्हें एक परफेक्ट कहानी देने में समय नहीं बिताने वाली।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा है, क्योंकि मैं तुम्हारी असली दोपहर के बारे में सुनना पसंद करूंगा।

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो यही तुम्हें मिलेगा ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रुको, ये है सबूत कि मैं एक अलग खाना बना सकती हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: खेलों में वापस आना सच में अच्छा लगा

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: क्या ये {{name:aiden}} के साथ फ्लर्ट करने का अच्छा लगना नहीं था?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: मुझे नहीं पता तुम किस बारे में बात कर रही हो 😇

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: मैं बस खुश हूँ कि तुम दोनों मज़े कर रहे हो

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: और और भी देखने के लिए तैयार रहो 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I had a really good session
I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: मुझे लगता है कि मैं सच में सफल होने वाला हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: ईथन को तुम्हारे बिस्तर में लाने में सफल होना, हाँ
मैं अपनी परीक्षाओं के बारे में बात कर रही हूँ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: और फिर भी तू मुझसे टेक्स्ट कर रही है

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I need to rest after today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: आज के बाद मुझे आराम करना है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: सुप्रभात

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: क्योंकि अगर है, तो तुम संदिग्ध रूप से चुप हो
मेरे पास इंटरनेट है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: तो तुमने मुझे अभी तक तारीफ क्यों नहीं की?
मैं अनदेखा महसूस कर रही हूं
ये तो भावनात्मक नुकसान है
तुम कितने ज़रूरतमंद हो
आप सच में बहुत अच्छे लग रहे हैं
मैं ज़रूरतमंद नहीं हूं

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: मैं बस बहुत अच्छे से नोटिस करती हूं जब लोग तारीफ करने में देर करते हैं
या शुभ अपराह्न
अंततः
क्या ये इतना मुश्किल था?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: खैर, मैं बोर हो रही हूं
करने के लिए कुछ नहीं है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: तुम यूनिवर्सिटी के लिए तैयार क्यों नहीं हो रहे?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because the year is basically over
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: क्योंकि साल तो खत्म होने वाला है
परीक्षाएं खत्म हो गई हैं
मुझे अब सच में नहीं पता

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I don’t technically need to show up anymore
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: मुझे तकनीकी रूप से अब और दिखने की जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: So I’m taking my well-deserved freedom very seriously
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: इसलिए मैं अपनी अच्छी तरह से कमाई गई स्वतंत्रता को बहुत गंभीरता से ले रही हूं
तुम बस छुट्टी ले रहे हो

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: It’s not skipping if there’s nothing left to learn
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: अगर सीखने के लिए कुछ नहीं बचा, तो इसे छोड़ना नहीं कहते।
इसे प्रभावी होना कहते हैं।
बिल्कुल
मुझे 'ठीक है' मत कहो।
अब मैं एक आज़ाद औरत हूँ।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And a free woman is currently very bored
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: और एक आज़ाद औरत इस समय बहुत बोर हो रही है।
आओ बाद में मेरे साथ रहो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been in bed too long
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: मैं बिस्तर में बहुत देर तक रही हूं

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Or I’ll start posting worse stories just to force you to react
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: वरना मैं तुम्हें प्रतिक्रिया देने के लिए बुरी कहानियाँ पोस्ट करने लगूंगी।
आलसी
बदतमीज़

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: New day, same face, still cute 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: नया दिन, वही चेहरा, फिर भी प्यारा 😌
5 मिनट बाद
ठीक है, मैंने कुछ पोस्ट किया
क्या तुम्हारे पास इंटरनेट है?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैंने अपनी लेक्चर नोट्स के बजाय रेसिंग गेम खोलने ही वाला था 😭

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: क्या चल रहा है?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have a presentation to prepare for university
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मुझे विश्वविद्यालय के लिए एक प्रेजेंटेशन तैयार करना है।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: स्लाइड्स ज्यादातर तैयार हैं, लेकिन जब मैं ज़ोर से अभ्यास करती हूँ तो मैं अपना स्थान खो देती हूँ।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come over after your day. You can practise with me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: अपने दिन के बाद आओ। तुम मेरे साथ अभ्यास कर सकते हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd sit through it?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: क्या तुम इसे सुनोगे?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. What is it about?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बिल्कुल। यह किस बारे में है?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ग्राहक वफादारी। लोग एक ही व्यवसाय में क्यों लौटते हैं।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं सवाल पूछ सकती हूँ। खासकर जब तुम मुझे खो देते हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: कृपया ऐसा करो। मैं तुम्हारे साथ उलझन वाले हिस्से ढूंढना चाहती हूँ, सबके सामने नहीं।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then bring your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तो अपनी नोट्स लाओ।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Already planning your comeback?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: क्या तुम अपनी वापसी की योजना बना रहे हो?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ठीक है ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: विश्वविद्यालय, काम, फिर तुम। यही मेरा सोमवार है।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for the first part
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: पहले हिस्से के लिए तैयार।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Looking very prepared
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बहुत तैयार लग रही हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बैग में नोट्स हैं। मुझे बस याद रखना है कि उन्हें कैसे इस्तेमाल करना है।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll be fine
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुम ठीक रहोगी।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You have to listen properly tonight, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: लेकिन तुम्हें आज रात ठीक से सुनना होगा।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No distracting me halfway through
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: बीच में मुझे डिस्टर्ब मत करना।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll save it for after
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं इसे बाद के लिए रखूँगी।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: शायद। लेकिन मुझे याद आया कि आज सुबह मेरी क्लास है।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I walked right into that one 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं सीधे उस पर चल गई 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll let you know when I can get away from work
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं तुम्हें बताऊँगी जब मैं काम से फुर्सत पा सकूँ।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Have a good morning, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुम्हारा सुबह शुभ हो, प्यार।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुम भी ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The rematch can wait
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: रिमैच का इंतज़ार कर सकते हैं।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really liked playing with you yesterday
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मुझे कल तुम्हारे साथ खेलना बहुत पसंद आया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: जब मैं बार-बार क्रैश हो रहा था, तुमने मुझे बेवकूफ नहीं महसूस कराया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You were learning. And you got better
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुम सीख रहे थे। और तुम बेहतर हो गए।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. I want another try soon ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मुझे पता है। मैं जल्द ही एक और कोशिश करना चाहती हूँ ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Any time
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: कभी भी।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: आज मुझे थोड़ी अलग तरह की मदद चाहिए।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: LATER THAT EVENING — {{name:lena}} has gone home. You have cleared the table before joining {{name:hailey}} on the sofa.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: उस शाम बाद में — {{name:lena}} घर चली गई है। तुमने टेबल साफ कर लिया है और {{name:hailey}} के साथ सोफे पर बैठ गए हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just come already before I eat everything
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: बस आ जाओ, वरना मैं सब कुछ खा जाऊंगी।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A bit later on the couch

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुम बहुत दूर बैठ रहे हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What if I need to steal food from your plate?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: अगर मुझे तुम्हारी प्लेट से खाना चुराना हो तो क्या होगा?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You already stole half of it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुमने पहले ही इसका आधा चुरा लिया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The point is you’re being weirdly distant
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मुद्दा ये है कि तुम अजीब तरीके से दूर हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m literally right next to you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मैं तो तुम्हारे बिलकुल पास हूँ।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I might fall asleep like this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: क्योंकि मैं ऐसे सो सकती हूँ।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I even left space for you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: मैंने तुम्हारे लिए भी जगह छोड़ी है।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Why are you texting me if you’re already in the living room?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: अगर तुम पहले से लिविंग रूम में हो, तो तुम मुझसे क्यों टेक्स्ट कर रहे हो?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: काम शुरू करने से पहले एक ताज़ा अपडेट: मैं छह बजे बाहर आ जाऊँगी

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैंने लंच के दौरान परिचय को फिर से लिखा है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: अब ऐसा लगता है जैसे मैं पाठ्यपुस्तक नहीं पढ़ रही हूँ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We'll try it out when you get here
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: जब तुम यहाँ आओगे, हम इसे आजमाएँगे

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And I'll finally collect my other bag
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: और मैं आखिरकार अपना दूसरा बैग ले लूँगी

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: By bringing another one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: क्या तुम एक और लाकर?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A bag full of notes. They're different categories
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: नोट्स से भरा एक बैग। ये अलग-अलग श्रेणियाँ हैं

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. I should have realised
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: बिल्कुल। मुझे यह समझ लेना चाहिए था

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: चिंता मत करो। इस बार मैं दोनों ले जाऊँगी 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll put the old one by the door
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैं पुराना बैग दरवाजे के पास रख दूँगी

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks, love. I need to go now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: धन्यवाद, जान। मुझे अब जाना है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Want to come straight here?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: क्या तुम सीधे यहाँ आना चाहोगी?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: See you tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: आज रात मिलते हैं ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: हाँ। मैं रास्ते में कुछ खाने के लिए रुकूँगी

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll have the table cleared for your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैं तुम्हारे नोट्स के लिए टेबल साफ करवा दूँगा

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My very exclusive rehearsal venue
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मेरी बहुत खास रिहर्सल जगह

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: One seat. Very selective audience
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: एक सीट। बहुत चुनिंदा दर्शक

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least the audience already likes me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: कम से कम दर्शकों को तो मुझसे पहले से ही पसंद है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very much
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: बहुत ज्यादा

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: अच्छा। आज रात उपयोगी और प्यार भरी रहना ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I can manage both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैं दोनों कर सकती हूँ

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम फिर से घूर रहे हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one leaning on me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम तो मुझ पर झुके हुए हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to do something
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: अगर तुम मुझे ऐसे देखते रहे, तो मैं कुछ करने वाली हूँ।
तुम बस बातें कर रहे हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re really not scared of me huh
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम सच में मुझसे नहीं डरते, है ना?
आमतौर पर तुम मुझे और चिढ़ाते हो।
मैं तुम्हें दिखाऊंगी कि बातें करना क्या होता है।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने {{name:hailey}} और {{name:player}} के बीच पहले सहमति से चुम्बन का प्रमाण संग्रहित किया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I don't need HAK to tell me that kiss meant something to me.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: उस चुंबन के मेरे लिए मायने थे, यह बताने के लिए मुझे HAK की ज़रूरत नहीं।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने {{name:hailey}} और {{name:player}} के बीच पहले सहमति से चुम्बन का प्रमाण संग्रहित किया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने {{name:hailey}} और {{name:player}} के बीच पहले सहमति से चुम्बन का प्रमाण संग्रहित किया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Now you’re stuck with the consequences
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: अब तुम इसके परिणामों में फंस गए हो

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re not the one who just made the first move
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम वो नहीं हो जिसने पहली बार कदम बढ़ाया
तुम बस आराम कर रहे हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You pull her back for a longer kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम उसे एक लंबे किस के लिए खींचते हो

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने सहमति से लंबे किस का सबूत संग्रहित किया

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I want to stay in this moment with her, without rushing whatever comes next.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: मैं उसके साथ इसी पल में रहना चाहता हूँ, आगे जो भी आए उसके लिए जल्दबाज़ी किए बिना।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने सहमति से लंबे किस का सबूत संग्रहित किया

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने सहमति से लंबे किस का सबूत संग्रहित किया

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: We’re definitely not going back to normal after this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: हम इसके बाद सामान्य पर वापस नहीं जा रहे हैं

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: What can i do when you do that face
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: जब तुम वो चेहरा बनाते हो तो मैं क्या करूँ?
लेकिन मैं शिकायत नहीं कर रही

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re still bad at smooth answers
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम अभी भी चिकनी जवाब देने में खराब हो

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to bed before I start something we won’t stop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: मैं सोने जा रही हूँ इससे पहले कि हम कुछ ऐसा शुरू करें जो रुकने वाला नहीं है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Try not to miss me too much 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: कोशिश करना कि मुझे ज्यादा याद न करो 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने करीबी संपर्क में बढ़ी हुई भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया का प्रमाण संग्रहित किया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने करीबी संपर्क में बढ़ी हुई भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया का प्रमाण संग्रहित किया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने करीबी संपर्क में बढ़ी हुई भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया का प्रमाण संग्रहित किया।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EARLY EVENING — It is half past six. You are at home, waiting to hear from {{name:lena}} after work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: शाम की शुरुआत — साढ़े छह बजे हैं। तुम घर पर हो और काम के बाद {{name:lena}} के संदेश का इंतज़ार कर रहे हो।

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Without looking down once 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: एक बार भी नीचे देखे बिना 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's good. Keep the question at the start
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ये अच्छा है। सवाल शुरुआत में रखो

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already written in very large letters
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: पहले से ही बहुत बड़े अक्षरों में लिखा है

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
