story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं घर जा रही हूँ 😊 सब कुछ अच्छा रहा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हें कैसा लग रहा है?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अच्छा। जब मैं ड्रिंक मेनू पढ़ रही थी जैसे कोई टेस्ट होने वाला हो, उससे बेहतर।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: पूरी बातचीत खुद नहीं करनी पड़ी, ये अच्छा था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे वो मुस्कान पसंद है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was he like you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या वह तुम्हारी उम्मीदों के जैसा था?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: शुरुआत में थोड़ा शांत था, वास्तव में। इससे मुझे नर्वस होने पर कम बेवकूफी महसूस हुई।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: फिर उसने कहा कि उसने खुद से वादा किया था कि पहले दस मिनट पिज्जा की तस्वीर समझाने में नहीं बिताएगा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या वह इसे कर पाया?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For about four minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: लगभग चार मिनट तक।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने इसलिए पूछा क्योंकि मैं कहानी सुनना चाहती थी, न कि इसलिए कि उसके पास कहने के लिए कुछ नहीं था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह एक बेहतर कारण है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हम बाद में इधर-उधर घूमने गए। मैं एक सेकंडहैंड किताब के साथ घर आया, जिसे खरीदने का मेरा कोई इरादा नहीं था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक उत्पादक दोपहर

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने दो ली थीं। पहली में ऐसा लग रहा था जैसे मैं याद करने की कोशिश कर रही थी कि मैंने दरवाजा बंद किया था या नहीं।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक पूरी तरह से अनावश्यक खरीदारी, लेकिन मुझे यह पसंद है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुम्हें वहाँ रहना अच्छा लगा, जब नर्वसनेस कम हो गई?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ। मैंने यह तय करने की कोशिश करना बंद कर दिया कि सब कुछ ठीक चल रहा है या नहीं और बस अच्छा समय बिताया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं छोटी-छोटी बातें अपने पास रख रही हूँ, लेकिन मैं चाहती थी कि तुम वह हिस्सा जानो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुम गए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I ❤️
I took this after we said goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने यह तब लिया जब हमने अलविदा कहा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Had you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुमने किया था?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं इसे नहीं बदल रही। बस इसे बेवजह ध्यान से देख रही हूं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम खुश लग रहे हो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am. And hungry again somehow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं हूँ। और किसी तरह फिर से भूखी हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अगर ठीक है तो मैं घर जाकर खाना खाना चाहती हूँ, पहले कि हम ठीक से बात करें।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm not going anywhere
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल। मैं कहीं नहीं जा रहा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to hear about your day too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तुम्हारे दिन के बारे में भी सुनना चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: इसे दिलचस्प होने के लिए मेरे साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करने की जरूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने मशीन के साथ कोई अंतरराष्ट्रीय घटना शुरू किए बिना कपड़े धो लिए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was still inside. So no 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं अभी भी अंदर थी। तो नहीं 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's progress
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह प्रगति है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sock may have been lost in the process
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: इस प्रक्रिया में एक मोजा खो गया हो सकता है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll remember its sacrifice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हम इसके बलिदान को याद रखेंगे।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अगर मैंने यह नहीं किया होता, तो तुम जरूर शिकायत करती।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं शिकायत नहीं कर रही। मैं यह तय कर रही हूँ कि तुम्हें कितनी तारीफ मिलनी चाहिए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कम से कम थोड़ी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो बहुत अच्छा, प्यारे। मैं तुम्हें आज रात लंबी कहानी सुनाऊँगी ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वैसे, मैंने उसे एक जल्दी फोटो भेजी है ये बताने के लिए कि मैं आ रही हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बस मैं दरवाजे पर, कुछ खास नहीं।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to send it twice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हें इसे दो बार भेजने की जरूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है। वैसे भी तुमने मेरी पूरी आईने की जांच कर ली है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं अब जा रही हूँ इससे पहले कि मुझे फिर से हॉलवे में खड़े होने का कोई और कारण मिल जाए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Completely different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल अलग

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अच्छा समय बिताना। जब तुम फ्री हो, हम बात करेंगे।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: इस सुबह के लिए धन्यवाद।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हें डेट पर ये सोचने की जरूरत नहीं है कि मैं अगला क्या चाहूँगी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है। मैं वो हिस्सा अपने साथ ले जा रही हूँ ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before crossing the road. It looks much nicer without the lunch crowd
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने ये सड़क पार करने से पहले लिया। ये लंच भीड़ के बिना बहुत अच्छा लग रहा है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सही है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm outside the café. {{name:aiden}} is already here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं कैफे के बाहर हूँ। {{name:aiden}} पहले से ही यहाँ है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He looks far too pleased about being the one who arrived first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वो पहले आने वाले होने पर बहुत खुश लग रहा है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't let him get an entire conversation out of five minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसे पांच मिनट में पूरी बातचीत करने मत दो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, he's pointing at his wrist
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बहुत देर हो गई, वो अपनी कलाई की ओर इशारा कर रहा है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away before he starts waving at that too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं अपना फोन रख रही हूँ इससे पहले कि वो उस पर भी हाथ हिलाना शुरू कर दे

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five whole minutes early. I was about to become concerned
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: पूरे पाँच मिनट पहले। मैं चिंतित होने वाली थी

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not wearing a watch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुमने घड़ी नहीं पहनी है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know what time it is without one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे बिना घड़ी के भी समय पता है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The group meeting finished on time, so I even managed a proper lunch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ग्रुप मीटिंग समय पर खत्म हो गई, तो मैंने सही लंच भी कर लिया

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you know I'm early too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो तुम जानते हो कि मैं भी जल्दी आई हूँ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do. I just wanted to enjoy being first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ, मुझे पता है। मैं बस पहले आने का मज़ा लेना चाहती थी

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this how the entire date is going to be?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या पूरा डेट ऐसा ही होने वाला है?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to think I've got a little more to offer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे लगता है कि मेरे पास और भी कुछ है देने के लिए

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll see
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: देखते हैं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look really nice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम सच में बहुत अच्छे लग रहे हो

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: धन्यवाद

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's all. You don't have to prepare a comeback to that one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बस इतना ही। तुम्हें इसके लिए कोई जवाब तैयार करने की ज़रूरत नहीं है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं नहीं थी

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम थोड़े थे

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. You won't spend the entire date staring at the cake display
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अच्छा। तुम पूरी डेट के दौरान केक की प्रदर्शनी को नहीं घूरोगी

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me consider one now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम मुझे अब एक सोचने पर मजबूर कर रहे हो

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on. I found two chairs that don't wobble
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: चलो। मैंने दो कुर्सियाँ ढूंढी हैं जो हिलती नहीं हैं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's unusually thoughtful of you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह तुम्हारी तरफ से असामान्य रूप से विचारशील है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait until you see the cups. They've done nothing about the cups
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब तुम कप देखोगे तब तक रुको। उन्होंने कप के बारे में कुछ नहीं किया है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Would you mind taking a photo with me before the drinks arrive?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या तुम मेरे साथ एक फोटो खींचने में कोई आपत्ति नहीं करोगे जब तक ड्रिंक्स नहीं आ जाते?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Taking it, or being in it?
