story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शब्दों को ढूंढना थोड़ा अजीब था। लेकिन चुम्बन नहीं था

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बाद में मैं ज्यादातर खुश थी कि मैंने पूछा, बजाय इसके कि घर की पूरी यात्रा यह सोचते हुए बिताऊं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुम ऐसा करने में सहज महसूस कर रही थी

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी। मुझे नहीं पता था कि क्या मैं सुबह एक और ड्रिंक के लिए रुकना चाहूंगी

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं यह नहीं कहने वाली कि मैं उसे एक दोपहर के बाद अच्छे से जानती हूँ, लेकिन मुझे हमारी दोपहर बहुत पसंद आई

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें आज रात कुछ बड़ा तय करने की ज़रूरत नहीं है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है। मैंने उसे बताया कि मुझे उससे मिलकर अच्छा लगा, और हम फिर बात करेंगे

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं हर पल का वर्णन नहीं करने वाली, जैसे हमने कहा था

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आप आरामदायक लग रहे हैं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें ज़रूरत नहीं है। मुझे बताओ तुम कैसे हो

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: खुश। थोड़ा विचारशील, लेकिन परेशान नहीं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं वहाँ रुक गई क्योंकि मैं वहाँ रहना चाहती थी, और जब मुझे घर जाने का मन हुआ, तब चली गई

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उस दोपहर को किसी निश्चित समय तक खींचने या इसे कुछ बड़ा बनाने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही थी

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने जो चाहा वो कहने में सहज महसूस किया?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। जब मैंने अपने दिमाग में सब कुछ दोहराना बंद किया, तब और भी सहज महसूस किया

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कुछ बातें हैं जिन्हें मैं अभी अपने पास ही रखना चाहती हूँ, लेकिन ऐसा कुछ नहीं है जो मुझे परेशान कर रहा हो और मैं तुम्हें बताने से बच रही हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यही मेरे लिए मायने रखता है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे ये पसंद है कि मैं तुम्हें बता सकती हूँ कि मुझे ये अच्छा लगा बिना हर छोटी वजह समझाए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हारे लिए खुश रह सकती हूँ बिना हर एक डिटेल जाने।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल। वो जूते एक अच्छा फैसला थे, लेकिन जब मैं अंदर आई तो मैं उन्हें उतारना चाहती थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा। क्योंकि मैं खुश हूँ ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम? आज तुम्हारे लिए दिन कैसा था?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब मुझे पता था कि तुम मिलने वाले हो, तो मैंने समय पहले से ज्यादा देखा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर मैंने फोन रख दिया और अपनी दोपहर में लग गई।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम परेशान थीं?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुमने वो नहीं चुने जिनमें तुम सिर्फ पाँच कदम चल सकते हो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ज्यादातर ये महसूस कर रही थी कि ये असली था, जैसे हमने कल रात बात की थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लेकिन मैं यहाँ बैठकर ये नहीं सोच रही थी कि मुझे तुम्हें कैंसिल करने के लिए कहना चाहिए था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुम ये कह रही हो, न कि ये दिखाने की कोशिश कर रही हो कि तुमने कुछ महसूस नहीं किया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और ये सुनकर कि तुम्हारा समय अच्छा बीता, मदद करता है। मुझे पसंद है कि तुम अपने जैसा लग रही हो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अभी भी वही हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है। मैं तुम्हें कल देखने का इंतज़ार कर रही हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम? क्या आज वैसा ही था जैसा तुमने सोचा था?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे नहीं पता था कि मुझे क्या उम्मीद करनी चाहिए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कभी-कभी अपनी गलतियों से सीखती हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी थी कि तुम गईं, फिर मैंने पाया कि मैं तुम्हारे संदेश का इंतज़ार कर रही थी, खेल से ज्यादा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये तो एक बड़ी उपलब्धि है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक विशाल उपलब्धि।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे ज्यादातर ये पसंद आया कि तुम जब वापस आए तो तुम कैसे लग रहे थे। तुम बस वो बातें नहीं बता रहे थे जो तुम्हें लगता था कि मुझे सुनना चाहिए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं। मैं तुमसे बात करना चाहती थी क्योंकि मेरा दोपहर अच्छा गुजरा था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यही चीज़ मुझे खुश करती है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम मुझे फिर से तुम्हें गले लगाने का मन करवा रहे हो ❤️।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें और कुछ बताने से पहले, जो तुमने आज सुबह कहा, उसने सच में मदद की।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हें कैफे में साथ ली गई फोटो पसंद आई?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पसंद आई। ये अच्छा था कि तुमने उस पल में मुझे शामिल करना चाहा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वैसे, मैंने पहले उससे पूछा था। इसे लेने और तुम्हें भेजने के बारे में।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है, तुमने मुझे बताया था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और फिर मैंने फोन रख दिया। मैं पूरी डेट पर अगली चीज़ भेजने में नहीं लगना चाहती थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें ऐसा करने की जरूरत नहीं थी। मुझे वो चीज़ पसंद आई जो तुम सच में साझा करना चाहती थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अपने लिए चुनने के बारे में?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि मैं तुम्हें इसके बारे में अपनी शब्दों में बाद में बता सकी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यही तो मैं चाहती थी। तुम्हें मेरे लिए चीज़ें इकट्ठा करने में डेट बिताने की जरूरत नहीं थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम्हारे पास अभी भी तुम्हारी गर्लफ्रेंड की घर लौटते समय की तस्वीर है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे वो हिस्सा खासतौर पर पसंद आया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे बहुत साधारण विशेषाधिकार सुरक्षित हैं 😌।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तक हमने अलविदा नहीं कहा, तब तक मेरा फोन अकेला छोड़ना मददगार था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसलिए नहीं कि मैं तुमसे बात नहीं करना चाहती थी। मैं बस एक साथ दो बातचीत में नहीं रहना चाहती थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे अब सही से बात करना पसंद है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे भी। मैं तुम्हारा ध्यान चाहती थी जब मेरे पास इसे एंजॉय करने का समय था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे ये पसंद है कि कुछ पलों को अपने पास रखना का मतलब ये नहीं है कि मुझे आज रात तुमसे दूर रहना पड़ेगा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं दूरी नहीं चाहता था। मैं चाहता था कि तुम खुद को होने की जगह पाओ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अब ये अलग लगता है, जब मैंने सच में वो अनुभव किया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुरुआत में मैं अभी भी सोचती थी कि तुम मेरे अगले कदम के बारे में क्या सोचोगी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, मैं फ्री हूँ। क्या तुम ठीक से घर पहुँच गई?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम कल लंच के बाद फ्री हो?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक फिल्म और अनियंत्रित मात्रा में पास्ता के साथ एक महिला के लिए? हाँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मैं तुम्हें देखना चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कंटेनर लाऊँगी, और तुम ये न दिखाना कि तुम्हें मेरी फिल्म के चुनाव पर सहमत होने की याद नहीं है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे याद है। मैंने तो सोफे पर जगह भी बनाई।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरे लिए या पास्ता के लिए?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तुम आओगी, हम प्राथमिकताओं पर चर्चा कर सकते हैं।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: गलत जवाब।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे लिए। पास्ता के लिए एक कुर्सी हो सकती है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत बेहतर

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर मुझे याद आया कि तुम घर पर बैठकर मेरी हिदायतों का इंतज़ार नहीं कर रही थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आज तुम्हारे पास बैठने की कमी महसूस हुई।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कल तुम जितना चाहो उतना ले सकती हो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं ऐसा ही करने का इरादा रखती हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम अब थकी हो?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ा। वो दुखी करने वाला नहीं, बस स्क्रीन को देखना बंद करने के लिए तैयार।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे बिस्तर में जाने दो, नहीं तो मैं यहाँ सो जाऊँगी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7 मिनट बाद

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं पहुँच गई। मैंने तो फोन को चार्ज में लगाना भी याद रखा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक संगठित महिला।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: संक्षेप में

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं नहीं थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह तुम्हारे लिए है, इससे पहले कि मैं इसे रख दूं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: काश मैं वहाँ होता

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कल। और फिर तुम मेरी फिल्म पर बेहतरीन टिप्पणी खुद सुन सकोगे

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या यह दौरे में शामिल है?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम इसे बंद नहीं कर सकते

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं ऐसा नहीं करने वाला था

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि, सुंदर ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शुभ रात्रि, खूबसूरत लड़की। मुझे खुशी है कि तुम्हारा दिन अच्छा रहा

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी। तुम्हें देखने का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे ये पसंद था कि मैं कुछ चाह सकती थी बिना इसे तुरंत तुमसे सवाल में बदलें।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यही मैं चाहती थी कि तुम्हारे पास हो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और मैं आगे बढ़ने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही थी सिर्फ इसलिए कि तुमने कहा था कि मैं कर सकती हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इससे भी फर्क पड़ा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मेरी तरफ से कोई सीमाएँ नहीं थीं, ये तुम्हारे लिए एक लक्ष्य नहीं बनना चाहिए था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं बना। एक बार तो मैं सही जवाब पाने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही थी 😌।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। मैंने सब कुछ रखा और उस फोन को खोजने में पाँच मिनट बिता दिए जो मैंने अभी अपनी जेब में रखा था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कैफे के बाद, हम थोड़ी दूर एक छोटे से बाग में गए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब तुम सच में डेट पर गई, वो कैसा था?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो वही था। उसने कपों के बारे में शिकायत की इससे पहले कि हमने ऑर्डर किया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लेकिन जब उसे ये नहीं पता था कि क्या कहना है, तो वो पहले से ज्यादा ईमानदार था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने स्वीकार किया कि उसने इतना समय तुम्हारे नाराज़ होने की उम्मीद में बिताया कि वो अब भी इस पर अभ्यस्त होने की कोशिश कर रहा था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं कल्पना कर सकता हूँ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने उसे हमारी पूरी बातचीत नहीं बताई। बस उसे बताया कि मैं उन चीज़ों की सूची का पालन नहीं कर रही थी जो तुमने अनुमति दी थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम ध्यान भटक गई थी?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने यह कैसे लिया?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो फिर से हैरान था। फिर उसने समझा कि उसे मुझसे पूछना चाहिए कि मैं क्या चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसके बाद हमने स्थिति के बारे में बात करना बंद कर दिया और सच में एक डेट पर गए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुमने इसे समझाने से आगे बढ़ गए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भी। उसने मेरे बारे में कई छोटी-छोटी बातें याद रखी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और मैंने उसे कुछ अच्छा कहते सुना बिना इसे तुरंत मजाक में बदलें।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये अपने आप में दूसरी कॉफी के लायक है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसे मत बताना। वो हर तारीफ का ऐलान करने लगेगा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर हम बगीचे में रुके, और {{name:aiden}} ने मुझे चूमा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने पहले तुम्हें चूमा?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ा

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। इससे पहले कि मैं तय कर पाती कि मुझे क्या कहना है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने उसे थोड़ा पीछे धकेल दिया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम ठीक थी?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, वो मुझे अचानक पकड़ लिया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने एक सेकंड चाहा। वो रुका, फिर तुरंत खुद पर बहुत खुश दिखने लगा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह उसकी तरह लगता है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगता है उसने तय कर लिया था कि मैं उसे चूमने वाली हूँ, तो वो बस मुझसे आगे बढ़ गया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल, उसने खुद को सही साबित करने का तरीका ढूंढ लिया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो इस बारे में मुझे चिढ़ाता रहा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या खोई हुई मोज़ी मिल गई?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो मैंने खुद उसे चूम लिया ताकि वो चुप हो जाए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और क्योंकि तुम चाहती थी?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। परेशान करने वाली बात ये है कि ये दोनों बातें एक साथ हुईं।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या उसे चुप कराने का काम किया?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: चुम्बन के दौरान तो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर उसने पूछा कि किसका चुम्बन बेहतर है, उसका या तुम्हारा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या उसने सच में तुमसे ये पूछा?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। लगता है ये एक बहुत महत्वपूर्ण सवाल था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने उसे बताया कि वो हर चीज को प्रतियोगिता बना देता है। खेल, क्लास, लगता है ये भी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या इससे उसे रोक दिया?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक आस्तीन के अंदर। कोई नहीं समझता कि यह वहाँ कैसे पहुँची।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल नहीं

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो मैंने उसे बताया कि अभी के लिए वह बहुत पीछे है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अभी के लिए?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ओह, तुम मत शुरू करो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने एक प्रतिस्पर्धी बेवकूफ के साथ दोपहर बिताई। मुझे आज रात एक और नहीं चाहिए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं बस अपनी बढ़त का आनंद ले रहा हूँ।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और अपना पॉइंट साबित कर रहा हूँ 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने इसे कैसे लिया?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वह हँसा और तय किया कि मैंने उसे एक चुनौती दी है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने कहा कि यह एक चुनौती नहीं थी। लगता है कि इससे कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारी वॉशिंग मशीन का हास्य बहुत छोटा है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds about right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह सही लगता है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd recognize the behavior
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता था कि तुम इस व्यवहार को पहचानोगी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम जानती हो कि तुम्हें मेरे लिए इसे और खराब नहीं बनाना चाहिए।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं ऐसा नहीं कर रही। मुझे उसे चूमना पसंद था, भले ही वह बाद में असंभव था।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you can tell me that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि तुम मुझे यह बता सकती हो।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और दूसरी बार, मैं हैरान नहीं थी या यह सोचने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही थी कि मुझे क्या करना चाहिए। मैं बस करना चाहती थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was it strange afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या बाद में अजीब था?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बस एक पल के लिए। फिर वह फिर से बहुत बात कर रहा था और मैंने इसे ज्यादा सोचने से रोक दिया।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हम थोड़ी देर छाँव में बैठे। मैंने उसे अकेले बैठने की धमकी दी अगर वह हर चीज़ पर टिप्पणी करता रहा।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Romance is alive and well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: रोमांस ज़िंदा है और ठीक है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd appreciate the update
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे लगा तुम इस अपडेट की सराहना करोगी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें वही औरत पसंद है। तुम जानते हो कि तुमने क्या साइन अप किया है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने फिर से प्लान बनाने के बारे में पूछा, लेकिन मैं इस डेट पर रहते हुए अगली डेट की योजना नहीं बनाना चाहती थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes sense
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह समझ में आता है

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह उसे टालने का तरीका नहीं था। मैं बस घर जाना चाहती थी और आज के दिन को थोड़ा सैटल होने देना चाहती थी।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told you we went for a walk after the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने तुम्हें बताया था कि हम कैफे के बाद टहलने गए थे।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वहाँ एक किताबों की दुकान थी जिसमें वह देखना चाहता था, इसलिए हम सेकंडहैंड शेल्व्स पर घूमने लगे।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where the book came from?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो वहीँ से किताब आई थी?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I picked it because the description sounded ridiculous and I wanted to know whether the story could possibly be worse
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। मैंने इसे इसलिए चुना क्योंकि इसका विवरण बेवकूफी भरा था और मैं जानना चाहती थी कि क्या कहानी और भी खराब हो सकती है।

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. I'm interested in your very uneventful adventures too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं करती हूँ। मैं तुम्हारी बहुत साधारण रोमांचों में भी रुचि रखती हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’m not that kind of person

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: एक बार के लिए अच्छी नींद आई 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re allowed to compliment me again by the way
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: वैसे, तुम मुझे फिर से तारीफ करने की अनुमति दे सकते हो
तुम बहुत लालची हो रहे हो
तुम आज सुबह बहुत नरम लग रही हो
मैं बस मानकों को बनाए रख रही हूँ
मैं अभी भी बिस्तर में हूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not getting up anytime soon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: और मैं जल्दी उठने वाली नहीं हूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Planning to stay there all day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: क्या तुम वहाँ पूरे दिन रहने की योजना बना रही हो?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Unless someone comes to bother me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: जब तक कोई मुझे परेशान करने नहीं आता
बस यह सुनिश्चित कर रही हूँ कि तुम याद रखो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I was a little worried you’d wake up and pretend it never happened
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: मुझे थोड़ा डर था कि तुम जागोगी और यह कभी नहीं हुआ ऐसा दिखाओगी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm presenting today and suddenly my introduction looks unfamiliar 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं आज प्रस्तुति दे रही हूँ और अचानक मेरी परिचय अजीब लग रही है 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'd prefer having just you in the audience again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं चाहूँगी कि सिर्फ तुम ही फिर से दर्शकों में रहो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I might be biased
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं शायद पक्षपाती हूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're very biased. I like it ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुम बहुत पक्षपाती हो। मुझे ये पसंद है ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I still listened properly
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैंने फिर भी सही से सुना

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You did. That's why I'm messaging you instead of rewriting the whole thing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुमने किया। इसी लिए मैं तुम्हें मैसेज कर रही हूँ बजाय इसके कि सब कुछ फिर से लिखूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready. Notes checked, laptop charged, no bags left at your place
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तैयार। नोट्स चेक कर लिए, लैपटॉप चार्ज है, तुम्हारे घर पर कोई बैग नहीं छोड़ा

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then you're already ahead of yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तो तुम कल से पहले ही आगे हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please don't remind me of the bag situation 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: कृपया मुझे बैग की स्थिति याद न दिलाओ 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You look good. Now go show them you know your subject
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुम अच्छी लग रही हो। अब जाओ और उन्हें दिखाओ कि तुम अपने विषय को जानती हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The same one you got through without your notes last night?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: क्या वही है जिसे तुमने बिना नोट्स के कल रात पूरा किया था?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll tell you how it goes later
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं तुम्हें बाद में बताऊँगी कि कैसे हुआ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be waiting. Good luck, love ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मैं इंतज़ार करूँगी। शुभकामनाएँ, प्यार ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Thank you. Love you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: धन्यवाद। तुमसे प्यार है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. My brain has chosen a very inconvenient time to doubt it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: हाँ। मेरे दिमाग ने इसे संदेह करने के लिए बहुत ही असुविधाजनक समय चुना है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You explained it clearly yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तुमने इसे कल साफ-साफ समझाया था

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And you answered my questions without having to search through the slides
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: और तुमने मेरी सवालों का जवाब बिना स्लाइड्स में खोजे दिया

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. It's just different with everyone looking at me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: मुझे पता है। जब सब लोग मुझे देख रहे होते हैं तो ये बस अलग होता है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Take a second before you start. You don't have to rush into the first sentence
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: शुरू करने से पहले एक सेकंड लो। तुम्हें पहले वाक्य में जल्दी नहीं करनी है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I do rush when I'm nervous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: जब मैं नर्वस होती हूँ तो मैं जल्दी कर देती हूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then keep the cafe example in mind. You knew exactly how to explain that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: तो कैफे का उदाहरण याद रखो। तुम जानते थे कि उसे कैसे समझाना है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay. Slow down and start with the example
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ठीक है। धीरे चलो और उदाहरण से शुरू करो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then I’ll come by later tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: फिर मैं आज रात बाद में आऊँगी।
नहीं। मैं आज रात बाद में आ रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Fine. Can I come over later tonight?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ठीक है। क्या मैं आज रात बाद में आ सकती हूँ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now you’re asking after already deciding
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: अब तुम पहले से ही तय करने के बाद पूछ रही हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The door will be unlocked when you come over tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: जब तुम आज रात आओगे, दरवाजा खुला रहेगा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Text me when you’re ready to come over
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: जब तुम आने के लिए तैयार हो, मुझे टेक्स्ट करो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thinking about coming to your room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुम्हारे कमरे में आने के बारे में सोच रही हूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just so you know what you’re walking into
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: बस तुम्हें पता हो कि तुम किसमें आ रहे हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Your not talking about the room are you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुम कमरे के बारे में बात नहीं कर रहे हो, है ना?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What happened to the calm version of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: तुम्हारे शांत संस्करण का क्या हुआ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: He just decided to enjoy life too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: उसने भी जीवन का आनंद लेने का फैसला किया

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It's done. And it went well 😭❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ये हो गया। और ये अच्छा हुआ 😭❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very familiar 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: बहुत परिचित 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I almost laughed because we'd talked about exactly that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैं लगभग हंस पड़ा क्योंकि हमने ठीक इसी बारे में बात की थी।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I could answer without looking at my notes
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैं बिना अपने नोट्स देखे जवाब दे सकता था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's great. You knew it already, you just needed to practise saying it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: यह शानदार है। तुम पहले से ही जानते थे, तुम्हें बस इसे बोलने का अभ्यास करना था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Apparently so
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ऐसा लगता है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It wasn't flawless, though
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: हालांकि, यह बिना खामी का नहीं था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: What happened?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: क्या हुआ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I clicked to the next slide while I was still explaining the first one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैंने पहले स्लाइड को समझाते समय अगली स्लाइड पर क्लिक कर दिया।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then clicked back too far
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: फिर मैंने बहुत पीछे क्लिक कर दिया।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A surprise tour of the presentation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: प्रस्तुति का एक आश्चर्यजनक दौरा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There she is. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: वो रही। तुम कैसी महसूस कर रही हो?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Exactly. Everyone got to admire the title twice 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: बिल्कुल। सभी ने शीर्षक की दो बार प्रशंसा की 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you find the right slide again?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: क्या तुमने सही स्लाइड फिर से ढूंढ ली?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I said the laptop was more impatient than I was
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: हाँ। मैंने कहा कि लैपटॉप मुझसे ज्यादा अधीर था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A few people laughed. Then I carried on
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: कुछ लोगों ने हंस दिया। फिर मैंने आगे बढ़ा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's a pretty good recovery
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: यह एक अच्छी रिकवरी है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I thought so too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मुझे भी ऐसा ही लगा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I don't have the grade yet, but the professor said the examples were clear
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मेरे पास अभी ग्रेड नहीं है, लेकिन प्रोफेसर ने कहा कि उदाहरण स्पष्ट थे।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should be pleased with that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: तुम्हें इससे खुश होना चाहिए।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I am ❤️ And I'm glad you helped me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मैं खुश हूँ ❤️ और मुझे खुशी है कि तुमने कल मेरी मदद की।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm happy it helped. You did the presentation yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: मुझे खुशी है कि यह मददगार रहा। तुमने खुद प्रस्तुति दी।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Relieved. I think I was holding my breath before I started
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: आराम मिला। मुझे लगता है कि मैं शुरू करने से पहले अपनी सांस रोक रही थी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now I can stop rehearsing sentences every time I have a quiet minute
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: अब मैं हर बार जब मुझे एक शांत मिनट मिलता है, वाक्य दोहराना बंद कर सकता हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy the quiet minute, then
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: तो फिर उस शांत मिनट का आनंद लो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: With lunch this time. A proper one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: इस बार लंच के साथ। एक सही लंच।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: An excellent follow-up to your academic success
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: तुम्हारी शैक्षणिक सफलता का एक बेहतरीन फॉलो-अप।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Talk tonight? I want to hear about your day too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: आज रात बात करें? मैं तुम्हारे दिन के बारे में भी सुनना चाहती हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. Enjoy your lunch, love
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: बिल्कुल। अपना लंच एन्जॉय करो, जान।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I will ❤️
Did the introduction come back to you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: क्या तुम्हें परिचय याद आया?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I slowed down like you said
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: हाँ। मैंने तुम्हारी बात मानकर धीरे किया।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then once I got into the cafe example, it felt much easier
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: फिर जब मैं कैफे के उदाहरण में गया, तो यह बहुत आसान लगने लगा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. What about questions?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: अच्छा। सवालों का क्या?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You'll like this
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: तुम्हें यह पसंद आएगा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The professor asked what would make someone choose between two places with similar products and prices
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: प्रोफेसर ने पूछा कि किसी को समान उत्पादों और कीमतों वाले दो स्थानों के बीच क्या चुनने पर मजबूर करेगा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: यह परिचित लगता है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: {{name:hailey}} lowers her phone and looks at you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: {{name:hailey}} अपना फोन नीचे रखती है और तुम्हारी ओर देखती है
तुम आज सच में अलग हो
तुम अब आदेश दे रही हो?
मुझे 100% यकीन नहीं था कि तुम करोगे।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate proximity in private room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने निजी कमरे में करीबी संपर्क का सबूत संग्रहित किया

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one pressing against me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम ही हो जो मुझसे चिपके हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to kiss you again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: अगर तुम मुझसे ऐसे देखते रहे तो मैं तुम्हें फिर से चूम लूंगी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Why are you still texting me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम अभी भी मुझे टेक्स्ट क्यों कर रहे हो?
मैं इस तनाव का मज़ा ले रही हूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate kiss in private setting
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ने निजी सेटिंग में करीबी चुम्बन का सबूत संग्रहित किया

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: That one was even better than yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: यह कल से भी बेहतर था
क्या तुम स्कोर रख रहे हो?
लेकिन हमें यहाँ रुक जाना चाहिए

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If we keep going I won’t want to stop
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: अगर हम और आगे बढ़े तो मैं रुकना नहीं चाहूंगी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And if I don’t want to stop either?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: और अगर मैं भी रुकना नहीं चाहती?
जब तुम इतनी करीब हो तो नहीं

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Go back to your room before I change my mind
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: अपने कमरे में वापस जाओ, वरना मैं अपना मन बदल दूंगी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If I talk out loud right now I’m going to get all weird
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: अगर मैं अभी जोर से बोलूंगी तो मैं अजीब हो जाऊंगी।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Just… let me text for a bit
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: बस... मुझे थोड़ी देर टेक्स्ट करने दो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re standing there like you don’t know what to do
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: तुम वहाँ खड़े हो जैसे तुम्हें पता नहीं क्या करना है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home, and I'm putting those slides away for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं घर पर हूँ, और मैं उन स्लाइड्स को आज रात के लिए रख रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you come over and stay the night with me?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: क्या तुम मेरे पास आओगी और रात बिताओगी?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Dinner, time together, and no having to leave at the end
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: डिनर, साथ में समय, और अंत में जाने की जरूरत नहीं

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes ❤️
YesYesYesYesYesYesYes❤️
I'd really like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे यह बहुत पसंद है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought about asking yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने कल पूछने का सोचा था

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You should have. I would've been tempted
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हें पूछना चाहिए था। मैं ललचाती

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: लेकिन कल बेहतर है। मैं जो चाहिए वो लाकर आ सकती हूँ, बिना इम्प्रोवाइज किए

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: When can you come?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम कब आ सकती हो?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My afternoon is free after university
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मेरी दोपहर विश्वविद्यालय के बाद फ्री है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: अच्छा कमाया। तुम्हारा बाकी दिन कैसा रहा?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I can go home, get my things and come over around five
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं घर जा सकती हूँ, अपनी चीज़ें ले आऊँगी और लगभग पाँच बजे आऊँगी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Five sounds good
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: पाँच बजे ठीक है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: और इस बार, जब तुम मुझे पास आने के लिए कहोगी, मैं रुक जाऊँगी 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I'm looking forward to
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: इसी का मुझे इंतज़ार है

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे भी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: रुको। मैं अपना बैग ले रही हूँ, पहले कि मैं कुछ भूल जाऊँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: कुछ मिनट बाद

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: टूथब्रश, गुरुवार के लिए साफ कपड़े, चार्जर

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very organised
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बहुत व्यवस्थित

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं कोशिश कर रही हूँ। क्या मैं सोने के लिए एक टी-शर्ट उधार ले सकती हूँ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है। जब मैं प्रस्तुति के बारे में नहीं सोच रही थी, तो बहुत आसान हो गया।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. You've looked good in mine before
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बिल्कुल। तुम मेरी टी-शर्ट में पहले भी अच्छी लग चुकी हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll let you choose one for me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तो मैं तुम्हें मेरे लिए एक चुनने दूँगी

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Consider it ready
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: इसे तैयार समझो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I hope you know I might get attached to it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे उम्मीद है तुम जानती हो कि मैं इससे जुड़ सकती हूँ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं जोखिम उठाऊँगा

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Almost packed
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: वहाँ। लगभग पैक हो गया

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased about that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम इस बारे में बहुत खुश लग रही हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं हूँ। यह बैग कल तुम्हारे घर पर रहना चाहिए

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Along with its owner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: इसके मालिक के साथ

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What did you do?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुमने क्या किया?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Especially its owner ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: खासकर इसके मालिक ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually, before I finish packing...
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: असल में, पहले कि मैं पैकिंग खत्म करूँ...

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What are you up to?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम क्या कर रही हो?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Giving you a little preview 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हें एक छोटा सा प्रीव्यू दे रही हूँ 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: कुछ मिनट बाद

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What do you think?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हें क्या लगता है?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look gorgeous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम बहुत खूबसूरत लग रही हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: और वह मुस्कान मुझे बताती है कि तुम जानती थी कि तुम क्या कर रही हो

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to distract you a little 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं तुम्हें थोड़ा ध्यान भटकाना चाहती थी 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: कुछ काम, एक छोटी सी टहलने, फिर घर के चारों ओर कुछ चीजें।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. Now I wish you were here
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: यह काम कर गया। अब मैं चाहती हूँ तुम यहाँ होती

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What would you do if I was?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: अगर मैं होती तो तुम क्या करते?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हें करीब खींचकर चूम लूंगी, इससे पहले कि तुम उस बैग को खोलो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: फिर मैं unpacking को बाद में छोड़ दूंगी ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. One more before I change
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: रुको। एक और, पहले कि मैं बदलूं।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A MINUTE LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: एक मिनट बाद

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Your last preview for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: वहाँ। आज रात के लिए तुम्हारा आखिरी प्रिव्यू।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम कल को बहुत खतरनाक बना रहे हो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: जब मैं सच में तुम्हारे सामने खड़ी होंगी, तब तुम्हारा चेहरा देखने का इंतज़ार कर रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was the walk?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: टहलना कैसा रहा?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: इतना करीब आओ कि तुम्हें यह अंदाज़ा लगाने की ज़रूरत न पड़े कि मुझे यह कितना पसंद है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I intend to 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं ऐसा करने का इरादा रखती हूँ 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep those pictures just for yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: उन तस्वीरों को सिर्फ अपने लिए रखो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. They're staying between us
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बिल्कुल। ये हमारे बीच ही रहेंगी।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: अच्छा। कल तुम अपना फोन रख सकते हो और मुझ पर व्यक्तिगत रूप से ध्यान दे सकते हो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हारा पूरा ध्यान मेरे पास होगा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: यही मैं सुनना चाहती थी ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: क्या मुझे तुम्हारे सारे डुवेट चुराने की चिंता करनी चाहिए?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बस अगर तुम मुझसे बहुत दूर सोने का प्लान कर रहे हो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैंने ऐसा प्लान नहीं बनाया था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ठीक है। अभी भी धीरे-धीरे चल रहा हूँ, लेकिन बाहर जाना अच्छा लगा।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तो हम ठीक रहेंगे 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: हालांकि मैं यह वादा नहीं कर सकती कि मैं अपने ठंडे पैर तुम्हारे खिलाफ नहीं रखूंगी।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: यह आमंत्रण में नहीं था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: यह गर्लफ्रेंड के साथ आता है। तुम्हें विवरण पढ़ लेना चाहिए था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: अच्छा। मैं चाहती हूँ कि तुम भी जब मैं जागूं तो वहाँ रहो।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम मुझे वहाँ पाओगे।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: यही वह हिस्सा है जिसके बारे में मैं सोचती रहती हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हारे साथ आराम से रहना और यह नहीं देखना कि मुझे कब घर जाना है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे कल तुम्हारे पास होना पसंद था।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad ❤️
Tomorrow we can stay like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: कल हम ऐसे ही रह सकते हैं।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम इंतज़ार को लंबा महसूस करा रहे हो 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only until tomorrow afternoon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बस कल दोपहर तक।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं पैकिंग खत्म कर लूंगी और समय देखने से रोकने की कोशिश करूंगी।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मुझे बताओ अगर तुम चाहोगे कि मैं रात के खाने के लिए कुछ लाऊं।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: बस तुम और तुम्हारा बैग। खाना मैंने संभाल लिया है।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: इस बार दोनों एक साथ आएंगे 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: शुभ रात्रि, प्यार। मैं कल का इंतज़ार कर रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं भी। शुभ रात्रि ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: मैं तुमसे कल के बारे में कुछ पूछना चाहता था

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: तुम्हारे मन में क्या है?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सुबह ❤️ क्या मेरा बालों का टाई अभी भी सुरक्षित है, या तुम्हारे सोफे ने इसे ले लिया है?
गद्दा बहुत आकर्षक है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हारे बारे में बात कर रही थी, बेवकूफ
मैं इस तारीफ को स्वीकार कर लूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अच्छा, मेरे पास एक और समझाने का समय नहीं है 😌
व्यस्त सुबह है?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: पहले क्लास, फिर काम। मैं बस तैयार हो रही हूँ
आज तुम्हारे बाल खुले हैं?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जब तक तुम्हारा गार्ड बालों की टाई भी नहीं लाए
वह केवल साइट पर काम करता है
खराब सेवा
यह मेरी चाबियों के पास है
वहाँ, इसके बिना तैयार 😊
तुम बहुत खूबसूरत लग रही हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: धन्यवाद सुंदर ❤️ आज तुम क्या कर रहे हो?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कपड़े धोने, फिर मैं वो खेल खत्म करना चाहती हूँ जो मैंने शुरू किया था

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: खेलने से पहले कपड़े लटका दो
मुझे पता है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हारे खेल के बारे में सुनना चाहूंगी, न कि गीले कपड़ों से भरी मशीन के बारे में 😭
मैं पहले इसे कर लूंगी
मैं तुम्हें विश्वास करने का फैसला कर रही हूँ
तुम वो भी खो देते हो 😭
क्या तुम देर तक काम कर रहे हो?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे फिर से पांच बजे खत्म करना चाहिए, फिर सीधे घर
आपका दिन शुभ हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम भी। मैं अभी भी तुम्हारी सोफे पर रहना चाहती, लेकिन बस मेरा इंतज़ार नहीं करेगी
मैं तुम्हारी सीट रख लूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और मेरी बालों की टाई 😌 तुमसे प्यार है
तुमसे भी प्यार है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put a guard on it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं इसके लिए एक गार्ड रखूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: धन्यवाद, इसे सही देखभाल की जरूरत है
क्या तुम अच्छी नींद सोए?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, better than the night before
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हाँ, पिछले रात से बेहतर

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं उस कंबल के नीचे एक और घंटा रह सकती थी
तुम लगभग कर चुकी थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह आरामदायक था, और मुझे तुम्हारी संगत पसंद आई ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or are you afraid of me?
You're going to be punished for that.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: विषय ने शारीरिक संपर्क शुरू किया।
शैक्षणिक सेटिंग पूरी तरह से प्रभावित।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: यह रिश्ता कितना निजी हो गया है, यह देखकर दिल बैठ जाता है।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded the subject initiating digital penetration during the private session after questioning the need for continued revision.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK ने निजी सत्र के दौरान डिजिटल प्रवेश शुरू करते हुए विषय को रिकॉर्ड किया, जब उसने पुनरावृत्ति की आवश्यकता पर सवाल उठाया।
क्या तुम अभी भी पुनरावृत्ति की शिकायत कर रहे हो?
द्वितीयक शारीरिक संपर्क का पता चला।
विषय की प्रतिक्रिया स्वीकार्यता को दर्शाती है।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to know how she actually feels, because HAK's interpretation isn't enough.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मुझे जानना है कि वह सच में कैसा महसूस करती है, क्योंकि HAK की व्याख्या काफी नहीं है।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the stimulation, the professor delivered a firm slap to the subject’s backside. Subject did not pull away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: उत्तेजना के बाद, प्रोफेसर ने विषय की पीठ पर एक जोरदार थप्पड़ मारा। विषय ने पीछे नहीं हटाया।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just making sure you’re still paying attention.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: बस यह सुनिश्चित कर रही थी कि तुम अभी भी ध्यान दे रहे हो।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तुम इसे बहुत ज्यादा इंजॉय कर रहे हो।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं सच में इन निजी पाठों को पसंद करने लगी हूँ।
सावधान। यह लगभग ईमानदार लग रहा था।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: अगर हमारे पास पहले से ही... एक व्यवस्था है तो मुझे क्यों फिर से पढ़ाई करनी है?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Was in the middle of something

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: बस उम्मीद से ज्यादा समय लग गया।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: क्योंकि मुझे अभी भी साबित करना है कि तुम मेरे साथ काम कर रहे हो।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तो यह सिर्फ कागजी कार्रवाई के लिए है?
किसी को तो होना ही चाहिए।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//लाइव ट्रांसक्रिप्शन

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look good with your hair down
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम खुले बालों में अच्छे लग रहे हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
