story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तुम्हें देख सकती हूँ और एक कार्यक्रम पढ़ सकती हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो फिर दूसरा करने की कोशिश करो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A big improvement
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक बड़ा सुधार

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less interesting
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बहुत कम दिलचस्प

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अगर तुम मुझ पर ही देखते रहोगे, तो और भी ज्यादा समय लगेगा

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम तो बिलकुल भी चतुर नहीं थे

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं ऐसा करने की कोशिश नहीं कर रही थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: स्पष्ट रूप से

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कल आना। मैं डिनर बनाऊंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To your place?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हारे घर?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वही तो मेरी रसोई है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम जानते हो मैं क्यों पूछ रही हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: और तुम जानते हो कि मैं तुम्हें काम पर चर्चा करने के लिए नहीं बुला रही

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: यह बैकग्राउंड शोर भी बहुत बेहतर बनाता है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about this yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हमने इस बारे में कल बात की थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कल तुम्हारे पास योजनाएँ थीं। मैं कल के बारे में पूछ रही हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं उस बातचीत के बाकी हिस्से की बात कर रही थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I had a really good evening with him
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मेरे साथ उसकी शाम बहुत अच्छी थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sure you did
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे यकीन है कि तुमने भी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो फिर ऐसा मत करो जैसे कुछ कमी है जिसे तुम ठीक करने वाले हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं कुछ ठीक करने की पेशकश नहीं कर रही। मैं तुम्हारे साथ एक और शाम बिताना चाहती हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम सब कुछ इतना आसान बना देते हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: डिनर आसान है। तुम उसके बाद की सब चीज़ों के बारे में सोच रहे हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं सोच रही हूँ कि क्या मुझे वहाँ होना चाहिए

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम्हारे पास क्या है?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You enjoyed the other night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुमने उस रात का मज़ा लिया

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: और मुझे उसके बाद बहुत बुरा लगा। तुम उस हिस्से को छोड़ते जा रहे हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे तुम्हें एक शाम अपने लिए पाना अच्छा लगा। मैं इसे फिर से करना चाहती हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं तुम्हें अभी जवाब नहीं दे रही

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो इस पर सोचो। अगर तुम आना तय करते हो, तो सात बजे

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me finish this first
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: पहले मुझे यह खत्म करने दो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} डेस्क पर खुले शेड्यूल की ओर मुड़ती है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसका मैनेजर दूसरी तरफ से उसकी पीठ देखता है, अपनी कुर्सी पर झुककर

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: दृश्य कैप्चर संग्रहित

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: वह सामने रखे काम के बजाय उसे देख रहा है। यह महसूस करना बुरा लगता है कि सिर्फ मैं ही इसे रुकते देखना चाहता हूँ।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक निमंत्रण

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: पाँच बजे से थोड़ी देर पहले, शेड्यूल चेक किया गया और आखिरी पन्ना साइन किया गया...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's everything. I'll put these with the others
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बस इतना ही। मैं इन्हें दूसरों के साथ रख दूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक रैप और एक सेब। कुछ खास नहीं

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leave them there, I'll take them out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उन्हें वहीं छोड़ दो, मैं उन्हें निकाल लूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have said that before I sorted them
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम यह पहले कह सकते थे जब मैंने उन्हें सॉर्ट किया

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: अब वे सॉर्ट हो गए हैं

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really do enjoy being in charge
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम सच में जिम्मेदारी लेना पसंद करते हो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक सेकंड के लिए मेरी तरफ देखो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: क्या?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want another kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं एक और किस चाहती हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm hesitating
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तुम जानते हो मैं क्यों हिचकिचा रही हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे पता है। मैं पूछ रही हूँ कि क्या तुम भी चाहोगे

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay... just a kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है... बस एक किस

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: उसके जवाब के बाद, मैनेजर उठता है और {{name:lena}} के करीब आता है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: दृश्य कैप्चर संग्रहित

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक और चुंबन, और वह भी उसे चूम रही है। साथ बिताई शाम अब भी मेरे लिए मायने रखती है, पर अभी वह दर्दनाक हद तक दूर लगती है।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another Kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: एक और चुम्बन

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, that's enough
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है, बस इतना ही

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked that better than the paperwork
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे यह कागजी काम से ज्यादा अच्छा लगा

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने कल खुद से कहा कि ऐसा फिर नहीं होगा

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I preferred today's decision
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे आज के फैसले में ज्यादा पसंद आया

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: बिल्कुल, तुमने किया। तुम वो नहीं हो जो घर जाकर अपराधबोध महसूस कर रहा है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मुझे तुम्हें चूमना पसंद था। मैं ये नहीं कहने वाली कि मुझे पसंद नहीं आया

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं अब जा रही हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you about dinner later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं बाद में तुम्हें डिनर के बारे में मैसेज करूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks peaceful
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: शांत लग रहा है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still haven't agreed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने अभी तक सहमति नहीं दी है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I heard you. Think about it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैंने तुम्हें सुना। इसके बारे में सोचो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: काम से निकलने के बाद, बस स्टॉप की ओर जाते हुए...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: मैं बाहर हूँ ❤️ अब घर जा रही हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: सब कुछ खत्म?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ, कल का शेड्यूल आखिरकार खत्म हो गया है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: कुछ ऐसा जो तुम्हें आज रात चिंता करने की जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: हाँ, एक चीज कम

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब मैं अंदर हो जाऊँगी, तो तुम्हें मैसेज कर दूँगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ठीक है, थोड़ी देर में बात करते हैं

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: है। मुझे दस मिनट तक यह नहीं पूछा जा रहा है कि कुछ कहाँ है, यह अच्छा लग रहा है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: तो तुम्हारा कपड़े धोने का सुपरवाइजर छुट्टी पर है?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only if it's actually hanging up
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: जब तक यह सच में लटका हुआ है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: तुम हाल ही में इन निजी पाठों के बारे में बहुत खुश लग रहे हो।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: अब तो मैं उसे देखने का इंतज़ार करती हूँ।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: तू हर एक्स्ट्रा सेशन के बारे में शिकायत करती थी।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: या शायद मैंने पढ़ाई का एक बेहतर तरीका ढूंढ लिया।
तू मुझ पर विश्वास नहीं करती।
तुम ऐसा क्यों कह रहे हो?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: अब मुझसे पूछताछ करना बंद कर और सो जा।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: तुम अच्छे मूड में हो और जब घर आते हो तो मुस्कुरा रहे हो।
तू उस चेहरे की बात कर रही है?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: किसी को मेरे प्रोफेसर से जलन लगती लगती है।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: वह जो करता है, उसमें बहुत अच्छा है।

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हे ❤️ मैं घर आ गई हूँ। क्या तुम अपना गेम खत्म कर पाए?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत ही ग्लैमरस शाम की योजना बनाई है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आप आरामदायक लग रहे हैं

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं हूँ ❤️ हालाँकि तुम्हारे सोफे पर बेहतर कंपनी थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने वो फोटो सेव कर ली जो तुमने कल रात ली थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
It was nice having you here
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यहाँ तुम्हारा होना अच्छा लगा

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It really was. I'd missed that
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वास्तव में ऐसा था। मुझे वो याद आ रहा था

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अगली बार मैं देखने के लिए कुछ बेहतर ढूंढूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे फिल्म इतनी बुरी नहीं लगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा गलत हिस्सों पर हंसना तो आधा मनोरंजन था

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अभी तक नहीं, मैं एक ही जगह पर एक घंटे से अटकी हुई हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगता है कि अब यही मेरी भूमिका है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're very good at it 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम इसमें बहुत अच्छे हो 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: थोड़ी देर बाद, उसका मैनेजर एक संदेश भेजता है...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कुछ मिनट बाद, तुम्हारी बातचीत में वापस...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ओह, मैं कल थोड़ा देर से घर आ सकती हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: काम से कुछ लोग डिनर कर रहे हैं

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हारा मैनेजर भी?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
A group thing this time?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इस बार ग्रुप में कुछ है?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, a few of us
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ, हम में से कुछ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने कुछ अलग करने की कोशिश की? 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, just let me know when you're back
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है, जब तुम वापस आओ तो मुझे बता देना

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पूरी शाम अपना फोन चेक करने की जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें टेक्स्ट करना नहीं भूलूंगी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ठीक है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I did have a lovely time yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और कल मेरा बहुत अच्छा समय बीता

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already told me 😊
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने मुझे पहले ही बता दिया 😊

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to say it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है, मैं बस फिर से कहना चाहती थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अपना प्लेट रखकर बिस्तर में जाने वाली हूँ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कुछ चीजें

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छी नींद लो

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. Love you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम भी खूबसूरत हो। प्यार तुमसे ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमसे भी प्यार है

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Including blaming the controller?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुमने कंट्रोलर को दोष देने की कोशिश की?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the first thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह पहली चीज थी

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very thorough 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत ही विस्तृत 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम क्या कर रहे हो?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पहले ही बदल लिया। कुछ जल्दी बना रही हूँ, फिर मैं ज्यादा नहीं हिलने वाली

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ठीक है, मैं तुम्हें बिस्तर से खींचने आ रही हूँ
विषय को बलात्कारी तरीके से जगाया गया

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}} ने कई अनदेखे संदेशों के बाद {{name:hailey}} को बिस्तर से खींच लिया
यह पहले से ही 10 बजे है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: और फिर भी तुम बिस्तर में हो
मुझे तुमसे सच में नफरत है 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: और थोड़ा और कपड़े पहन लो

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Don’t make me come up there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: मुझे वहाँ आने पर मजबूर मत करो

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हे 😊 आज कोई अलार्म नहीं, और मैंने तय किया है कि कपड़े पहनना नाश्ते के बाद तक इंतज़ार कर सकता है ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने इसे सुबह से ही संभाल कर रखा है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: जब वह घर से निकले।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ठीक है, मेरे पास खाना, फिल्म और वो ढक्कन है जो इस बार सही बैठता है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने एक छोटी सी यात्रा के लिए सामान पैक किया है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बस इसलिए क्योंकि तुम पर भरोसा नहीं किया जा सकता कि तुम पर्याप्त नैपकिन रखोगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बस खुद को लाओ। बाकी सब बात की जा सकती है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह इतना अच्छा था कि मैंने शिकायत करना बंद कर दिया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं चुप्पी का आनंद लूँगा जब तक यह चलती है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ज्यादा देर नहीं। मैं रास्ते में हूँ ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अगले बीस मिनट के लिए, बिल्कुल 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसके बाद मैं बेकरी के पास छोटे बाजार जा रहा हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हें कुछ चाहिए?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे एक बार बिना वही रास्ता लिए घर से निकलना है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और मुझे तुम्हारे साथ बाद में कुछ अच्छा खाने की ज़रूरत है ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे लगा कि पास्ता कुछ अच्छा था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: है। लेकिन पास्ता मिठाई नहीं है, चाहे तुम इसकी कितनी भी तारीफ करो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तो मेरा दोपहर का प्लान तो गया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हें वो फिल्म भी देखनी है जो मैंने चुनी है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे याद है। मैंने कोई रहस्यमय बिजली कटौती नहीं की है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह एक छुट्टी के दिन की तरह लग रहा है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हें ऐसा नहीं करना चाहिए। मैंने आखिरकार एक फिल्म पाई है जिसका तुमने मुझे अंत नहीं बताया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक बार ऐसा हुआ था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने कहा था कि भाई ने बोलने से पहले ही संदिग्ध लग रहा था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वह अंदर दस्ताने पहने हुए था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वह बर्तन धो रहा था 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक भरोसेमंद भेष।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: आज तुम अपनी जासूसी खुद तक रख सकती हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह है 😌 आज सुबह कोई शिफ्ट नहीं, कहीं जल्दी नहीं

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और मैं सच में तुम्हारा चेहरा देखने का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ, न कि यह सोचने का कि संदेशों के बीच का ठहराव क्या मतलब रखता है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ठहराव ज्यादातर मेरे सही शब्द खोजने की कोशिश थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मुझे पता है। आज तुम सामान्य इंसान की तरह मुंह भरा हुआ बात कर सकती हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह मैं कर सकता हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मैं तुम्हारे साथ एक अच्छा दोपहर बिताना चाहता हूँ, न कि एक और गंभीर बैठक।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम कल रात इतनी खुश लग रही थी कि मैं बस तुम्हारा चेहरा देखने के लिए आ ही जाती।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम इसे आज दोपहर देख सकती हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने खिड़की खोल दी है और मैं अपना कॉफी पी रहा हूँ जब तक कि यह गर्म है ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं ऐसा ही करने वाली हूँ। बहुत करीब से।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं कोशिश करूँगी कि बहुत घमंडी न लगूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ये तो एक प्यारा बदलाव होगा 😌।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या तुम उसके बाद घर पर ही रहोगी?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने अभी तक पूरी शाम का फैसला नहीं किया है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: आज के बारे में मुझे यही पसंद है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक अज्ञात अनुभव

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} ने मुझे पहले एक आर्केड साइन की तस्वीर भेजी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: क्या उसने हारने की शिकायत करने के लिए कहीं और ढूंढ लिया?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: लगता है कि वह बस मेरे दिन की छुट्टी के लिए एक मददगार सुझाव दे रहा था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यही तो उसकी चाल है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने उसे बताया कि आज दोपहर मेरे पास तुम्हारे साथ पहले से ही योजनाएँ हैं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसने कहा कि तुमसे पूछो कि क्या एयर हॉकी टेबल को तटस्थ मैदान माना जाता है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बस तब तक जब तक वह हारता नहीं। फिर टेबल एक साजिश में शामिल हो जाती है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं बाद में जा सकती हूँ। मुझे उसे यह समझाते हुए देखना मजेदार लगेगा।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अगर तुम पहले ही जीत चुकी हो तो तीन में से एक भी मत स्वीकार करो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: बहुत। अगर मैं इसकी आदत डाल लूँ, तो मैं रहना मुश्किल हो सकता हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं यह लिख रही हूँ 😌📝।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कल वाला लड़का मुझे उस किताब के बारे में एक संदेश भेजा जो हमने देखी थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वही जो दुकान से थी?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हाँ। लगता है पहली पन्ना घर आने के लिए काबिल था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने सिर्फ पीछे का कवर पढ़ा है, इसलिए मैंने उसे कहा कि अभी घमंड न करे।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक किताब क्लब के लिए एक आशाजनक शुरुआत।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ज्यादातर हम नए तरीके खोज रहे हैं कि कैसे कहें कि हम बात करना चाहते हैं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तो तुमने नोटिस किया है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: शायद?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: शायद मैं बाद में सीधा हो जाऊं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अभी के लिए मैंने उसे बताया कि मैं तुम्हारे साथ दोपहर बिता रही हूँ। हम शाम को बात करेंगे 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मुझे अपने बेहतरीन फिल्म कमेंट्री को फोन के साथ साझा करना पसंद नहीं है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं इसे अपने बैग में छोड़ रही हूँ। कमेंट्री के लिए, तुम्हारे लिए नहीं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सही है, मुझे असली कपड़े पहनने चाहिए इससे पहले कि बेकरी सब कुछ बेच दे जो मैं चाहती हूँ 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुमने तो यह भी तय नहीं किया कि तुम क्या चाहते हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: इसीलिए मुझे विकल्पों की जरूरत है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं जांच का इंतज़ार करूंगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मेरे आने से पहले अपने सारे नाश्ते मत खा लेना।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: सावधान, मैं अभी भी यह तय कर रहा हूँ कि तुम्हारे लिए क्या लाना है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उस सुबह बाद में

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: छोटी सी अपडेट: बेकरी वाली ने मुझे याद किया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह अच्छा लगता है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसे याद है कि मैं हमेशा कहती हूँ कि मैं सिर्फ रोटी खरीद रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हारी रक्षा के लिए यह कम अच्छा है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: उसने पहले ही एक बड़े बैग के लिए हाथ बढ़ाया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: यह तो निश्चित रूप से सिर्फ रोटी नहीं है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: वहाँ रोटी है। कहीं न कहीं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैंने हमारे लिए दो सेब की पेस्ट्री ली हैं, और घर लौटने के लिए और भी चीजें हैं जो इसे मजेदार बना देंगी 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम खुश लग रहे हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं हूँ। मैंने दस मिनट फूलों को देखकर बिताए बिना यह सोचे कि मुझे अगली जगह कहाँ होना चाहिए।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: कुछ नहीं खरीदा। बस वहाँ रहकर मजा लिया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हमें ऐसे और दिन बिताने चाहिए।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: हाँ, हमें चाहिए।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं घर जा रही हूँ कंटेनर लेने, फिर दोपहर के खाने के बाद आऊँगी जैसे हमने कहा था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: एक बजे के बाद ठीक है?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: संपूर्ण

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: मैं ड्रिंक्स फ्रिज में रख दूँगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: और अपने सोफे का हिस्सा साफ छोड़ देना।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा ऐसा लग रहा है जैसे तुमने कुछ न करने के लिए पहले ही समझौता कर लिया है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: क्या तुमने देखा कि इसमें मेरी गांड कैसी लग रही है? 😌
तुम भी इसका मजा ले रही हो
ठीक है, हम जा सकते हैं

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: जिम या तुम्हारे कोच के साथ डेट पर?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: तुम्हें दूसरी बेकार ड्रेस की तलाश नहीं करनी चाहिए

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: मैं कुछ दोस्तों के साथ दोपहर बिताने वाली हूँ
और अपने पैरों को थोड़ा स्ट्रेच करूँगी

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हे ❤️ मैं अभी सड़क पर ही हूँ और मैंने तुम्हारी फिल्म के बारे में थ्योरी का एक और कारण सोच लिया है कि यह बेकार है 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अब आगे क्या?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फोटो बूथ लुभावना है 😊।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या मेरी हार के सबूत को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं, क्योंकि मैं देखना चाहता हूँ कि क्या तुम बिना चेहरा बनाए चार तस्वीरें ले सकते हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: संभव नहीं। ये तो बहुत ही अन्यायपूर्ण चुनौती है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कुछ मिनट बाद, फोटो बूथ में।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें पता है कि मैं इनमें से कम से कम एक को बर्बाद करने वाला हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कम से कम एक? ये तो आशावादी है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो पास आओ। मुझे हर संभव फायदा चाहिए।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फोटो बूथ ऐसे काम नहीं करते।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने इसका ज्यादातर हिस्सा अपने साथ लाया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत देर हो गई। काउंटडाउन शुरू हो चुका है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: विषय फोटो बूथ में प्रवेश करते हैं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: व्यक्तिगत तस्वीरों की एक श्रृंखला कैद की गई

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं चाहता हूँ कि वह शाम का मज़ा ले, और यह मान सकता हूँ कि उनकी बढ़ती नज़दीकी को लेकर मुझे जिज्ञासा है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फोटो बूथ स्ट्रिप I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फोटो बूथ स्ट्रिप II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने पहले वाले में एक चेहरा बनाया

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम सब में मुस्कुराए, तो मैं अभी भी सोचता हूँ कि मैं जीत गया

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये जीतने का तरीका नहीं है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो आखिरी तस्वीर समझाओ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने मुझसे फ्लैश से पहले किस किया 😳

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और अब ये हमेशा के लिए सुरक्षित है। तुम्हारा स्वागत है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उस हिस्से की बात कर रही थी जहाँ हम बात करना बंद कर दिए और बस साथ में बैठे।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम तो नामुमकिन हो 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम इसके बाद भी पिनबॉल चुनोगे?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। और मैं अभी भी पूरे शाम स्कोर रखने में नहीं बिताने वाली हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उस पर भी सच में एक स्कोर है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम अपना स्कोर अपने पास रख सकते हो

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बाद में, बाहर

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं भूल गई थी कि सड़क कितनी तेज़ हो सकती है जब ये शांत लगती है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरे कान अभी भी अंदर रेसिंग गेम खेल रहे हैं

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारी गरिमा भी कहीं अंदर है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे अच्छा समय मिला

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे तब तक एहसास नहीं हुआ कि मुझे तुम्हारे पास होने की कितनी याद आई जब मैं वहाँ थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हालांकि मैं जीत गई?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हालाँकि तुम इसे कभी नहीं छोड़ने वाले हो

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे भी अच्छा समय मिला

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या मैं थोड़ी देर तुम्हारे साथ चलूँ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। मैं सोच रही थी कि जब मैं वापस आऊँगी तो चाय बनाऊँगी

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह तो समझदारी की बात है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह तो लगभग एक निमंत्रण था

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगभग?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम चाय के लिए आना चाहोगे? हमारे पास अभी भी वो पेस्ट्री है जिसे तुमने अपनी बड़ी परफॉर्मेंस से पहले खाने से मना कर दिया था

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे वो पसंद है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे यह भी पसंद आया। यहाँ तक कि जब तुम्हारा कोहनी मेरी पसलियों पर लगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और नहीं पूछना कि मैं दूसरा कंट्रोलर कहाँ रखती हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इसे तो नहीं ही कहने वाली

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं घर जा रही हूँ और थोड़ी देर के लिए सोफे पर अपना हक जमा रही हूँ 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम फिल्म की टिप्पणी को पहले ही याद कर रहे हो?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तो बच जाऊँगी। मेरे पास एक किताब है और कोई है जिसने शायद मुझसे आगे पढ़ लिया है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारा नया संपर्क?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। जब से मैं तुम्हारे घर से गई हूँ, हम छोटे-छोटे संदेशों का आदान-प्रदान कर रहे हैं

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसे याद था कि मैं तुमसे मिल रही हूँ और उसने तब तक इंतज़ार किया जब तक मैंने नहीं कहा कि मैं फ्री हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने तकिया बहुत ले लिया था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मैं उसे महत्वपूर्ण कुशन विवाद में हस्तक्षेप करने के लिए आपत्ति करने वाली थी

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिना कई तस्वीरों के कोई भी इसे नहीं समझता

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अफसोस है कि कोई डॉक्यूमेंट्री नहीं है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे प्रोत्साहित मत करो

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: घर पर वापस

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरी किताब में जगह मिल गई। वो वही बुकमार्क था जो दुकान पर डाला था 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये ज्यादा प्रगति नहीं है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने पढ़ाई से ज्यादा बातचीत में प्रगति की है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उसे सही से जवाब देने वाली हूँ, ये दिखाने के बजाय कि मैं दोनों कर सकती हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर बात करते हैं

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ ❤️ ये तस्वीर तुम्हारे लिए थी, वैसे। उसने शर्मनाक बुकमार्क की कहानी नहीं कमाई है 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उस शाम बाद

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तस्वीरों में एक जवाब

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मेरे पास दो तस्वीरें हैं जो तुम्हें पसंद आ सकती हैं। उसने कहा कि तुम्हें उसकी एक भी दिखाना ठीक है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम तस्वीरें शेयर कर रहे हो?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। यह वह मुस्कान है जो उसने मांगी थी

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छे रहो। मैंने इस बार तुम्हारे लिए असली बचे हुए छोड़े हैं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और यह वह तस्वीर है जो उसने अपनी रसोई में ली थी। मैं इसे फॉरवर्ड कर रही हूँ, कैमरा काम का दावा नहीं कर रही 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या एप्रन उसकी योग्यताओं को साबित करने के लिए था?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: लगता है कि डिनर कैमरे के लिए मुस्कुरा नहीं सका

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये एक ऐसा जवाब है जो तुम्हें पसंद आएगा

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल। मैं हंस पड़ी इससे पहले कि मैं दिखावा कर सकूं कि नहीं हंस रही

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वैसे, तुम्हारी फोटो बहुत खूबसूरत है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे पता था कि तुम सबसे पहले उसी पर ध्यान दोगी ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और तुम्हारी चम्मच।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इसे सुरक्षित रखो। मैं एक नाटकीय पुनर्मिलन की उम्मीद करूँगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे पास मुझे बताने के लिए दो घंटे थे।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं घर पर कंटेनर छोड़ने के बाद {{name:aiden}} से मिलने जा रही हूँ 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आर्केड?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: हाँ। उसने कहा कि तुम्हारी विशेषज्ञ सलाह को बर्बाद करना शर्म की बात होगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसे इसका आधा भी नहीं पता।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने मुझे पहले ही चेतावनी दी है कि एक मशीन सिक्के खा जाती है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: काम की बात। तुम्हारे आने से पहले एक बहाना तैयार है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उसे बस एक ही बहाना देने वाली हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं इसे देखने में व्यस्त थी जबकि तुम सबको किसी न किसी चीज़ का दोषी ठहरा रहे थे।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उदार।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उसे फिर से देखना चाहती थी, और कुछ करना कॉफी पर एक और सावधानीपूर्वक बातचीत से बेहतर लगा।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जाओ, मज़े करो। तुम्हें मुझसे और कोई ब्रीफिंग की ज़रूरत नहीं है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: अच्छा। मुझे सोफे पर बैठे जासूस से काफी निर्देश मिल चुके हैं 😌।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: शाम का समय, आर्केड के बाहर

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: पहुंच गई 🎮 तुम इस जगह की आवाज़ फुटपाथ से सुन सकते हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसे हर खेल चुनने मत देना।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वह अभी आया है और एक रेसिंग मशीन की ओर इशारा किया है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल, उसने किया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं एक व्यक्ति के बारे में सही थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अपना फोन रख रही हूँ। मेरे लिए शुभकामनाएँ 😌।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें इसकी ज़रूरत नहीं पड़ेगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: आर्केड के अंदर

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम तैयार होकर आए हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: किसके लिए?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: समझदारी के जूते। ये तो किसी के जीतने की उम्मीद करने का संकेत है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये वो है जिसने आज सुबह बाजार में चक्कर लगाया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हारे लिए कुछ लाई हूँ, सच में।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या ये पहले से ही सांत्वना पुरस्कार है?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक पेस्ट्री। मैं इसे खुद भी खा सकती हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उनमें से सभी सात को दोषी ठहराने के बाद।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं, मैं पहले से ही माफी स्वीकार कर लूंगी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हारे कारण सोचना बहुत मुश्किल हो रहा है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: धन्यवाद। ये तुम्हारी तरफ से बहुत अच्छा था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वहाँ। देखो, इसमें कितना कम प्रयास लगा?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम आज रात हर वाक्य की निगरानी करोगे?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सिर्फ वही जो परेशान करने वाले हैं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ये तो मेरे अधिकांश सामग्री है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम्हें खुद से कुछ करना पड़ेगा।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उनके पहले खेल के बाद

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वो पहला अंक नहीं गिना गया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: गहन जासूसी का काम।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मशीन सहमत नहीं है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने इसे मारा जब मैं तैयार नहीं थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम बता रहे थे कि ये कितना आसान होने वाला है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तो स्वागत कर रही थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने कहा था कि तुम मेरे साथ आसान रहोगे।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: और ये तो स्पष्ट रूप से एक गलती थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तो तुम मानती हो कि मैंने जीत लिया?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं मानता हूँ कि एक और खेल के लिए जगह है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: नहीं। तुमने पहली मशीन चुनी। मैं अगली चुनता हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: खेल खत्म

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} पहले राउंड में जीत गई

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: फिर भी तुमने यह नहीं देखा कि मैं तुम्हारी पेस्ट्री का आखिरी कौर चुरा रही थी।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत बुरा हारने वाला

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:player}} ने तुम्हें ऐसा करने को कहा था

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने मुझे चेतावनी दी थी कि अगर तुम हार गई तो तुम एक और राउंड मांगोगी

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उससे बात करने जा रहा हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या तुम्हें बहुत अच्छे से जानने के बारे में?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: विपक्ष को कोचिंग देने के बारे में

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने बिना तुम दोनों की मदद के एक पक को हिट कर लिया

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुमने किया। वो आखिरी शॉट अच्छा था

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: सॉरी, क्या तुम वो दोहरा सकते हो? मशीन शोर कर रही थी

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ज्यादा मत बढ़ाओ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैंने देखा। मैंने तुम्हें इसे लेने दिया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मुझे इसे सराहने के लिए एक पल चाहिए हो सकता है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं तुम्हें पांच सेकंड दूंगा

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: तुम सच में सब कुछ गिनती हो

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: क्या मैं तुम्हारे साथ एक तस्वीर ले सकता हूँ? मैं उसे एक भेजना चाहूँगा

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बिल्कुल। क्या स्कोरबोर्ड इसमें होगा?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: यह नहीं था। शानदार सुझाव

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: कम से कम मुझे एक सेकंड दो ताकि मैं कम हारने वाला दिखूं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं यही मानने का फैसला कर रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: बहुत देर हो गई। यही चेहरा मुझे चाहिए।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: एक पल बाद

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसने फोटो के लिए हां कहा। ये एक्सप्रेशन पूरी तरह से उसकी अपनी मेहनत है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं उस चेहरे को पहचानता हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: वह तुम्हें मेरी चेतावनी देने के लिए दोषी ठहरा रहा है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: उसे बताना कि मैं उसकी बहानों को सुनने से रिटायरमेंट का मजा ले रहा हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: मैं अभी के लिए उसे वो छोड़ दूंगी 😌।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: जब उसने अपना फोन रख लिया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: इस दोपहर के लिए धन्यवाद ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: और मैं तुम पर भरोसा करता हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: मुझे पता है तुम उसे चोट नहीं पहुँचाओगे
ये सच में मेरे लिए बहुत मायने रखता है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: लेकिन क्या ये तुम्हारे लिए अजीब नहीं है?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: असल में ये चीजें आसान बनाता है
छिपाने की कोई जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: मैंने इसे लेने से खुद को रोक नहीं पाया 😭
उसे तो खेलों की भी जरूरत नहीं है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: उसे तो कार्डियो सबसे ज्यादा चाहिए 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: मुझे इस पर बहुत खुशी है 🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: उसे अपने पैसे का पूरा फायदा मिलेगा 😂

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: जब हम लॉकर रूम से निकल रहे थे, तब कुछ हुआ
तुम्हें तो हमेशा लग रहा था

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: उसे थोड़ी और सेशन जारी रखना था

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: तो मुझे उसकी देखभाल करनी पड़ी 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: यार, मैंने कभी नहीं सोचा था कि मैं तुम्हारे साथ {{name:hailey}} के बारे में ऐसी बात करूंगा 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: लेकिन अगर यह अजीब है... तो यह थोड़ा कूल है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: मैं कल गेम के लिए आ रहा हूँ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: मुझे पता है तुम दोनों एक-दूसरे पर क्रश हो

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: हे 😊 मुझे तुम्हें एक कंटेनर का ढक्कन लौटाना है। किसी तरह मैं वो भी घर ले आई 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: यह आर्केड से काफी कम शोर है

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: तुम्हें कोई आइडिया नहीं है। मेरी सुनने की क्षमता लगभग वापस आ गई है। मेरे अन्य हिस्से कम शांत हैं

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: तुम खुश लग रहे हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: मैं ❤️ थोड़ी देर के लिए फोन को छोड़ने जा रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: बाद में बात करते हैं।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: जब उसने अपना फोन रख लिया।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: उस रात बाद में

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: अगर मैं ऐसे और देर तक रुक गई, तो मैं भूल जाऊँगी कि मुझे जाना था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: यह कोई दुर्घटना नहीं है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: तेरी शर्ट ऊपर खिसक गई है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: मैंने देखा। तुम वहाँ अपना हाथ रख सकते हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: तुम पहले उठने में बहुत मुश्किल कर रहे हो।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: तो मुझे एक बार और चूमो और फिर उठो। मैं तुम्हें आज रात बिस्तर पर नहीं ले जा रही।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: मैं पूछने वाला नहीं था।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: तुम सोच रहे थे। मैं भी। इसलिए मैं अब यह कह रही हूँ।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: सोफे पर एक आखिरी गहरा चुम्बन।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: उसका हाथ उसकी कमर पर, और उसका हाथ उसकी शर्ट के हेम के नीचे।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: यह तेजी से आगे बढ़ रहा है, और मैं चाहता हूँ कि हम खुलकर बात करते रहें कि क्या सही महसूस होता है।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//सूचना

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: मुझे आज रात पसंद आई।

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: क्या शांत हिस्सा भी?
